## 08.3 Relationship map (Phase B)

```text
P5 Identity/RBAC ───────────────┐
P5 Audit / Event Outbox ───────┤
P5 Assets (preparation links) ──┤
P6 Import/Raw Archive/Handoff ─┤
P7 Countries/Cities/Languages/ ├──> P9 International Test Owner
   Currency Resolver ──────────┤       ├─ test identity/provider/family
P8 Academic Taxonomy /         │       ├─ version + raw/evidence
   Degree Levels ──────────────┘       ├─ canonical links and profile
                                     └─ reviewed publication projection
                                          │
                          ┌───────────────┼─────────────────┐
                          ↓               ↓                 ↓
                    P11 Universities  P12 Scholarships  Public catalog
                     admissions        eligibility       Search / Student
                          └───────────────┴─────────────────┘
```

**Actually implemented:** P6 handoff explicitly creates staging candidates and refuses automatic promote/publication (`InternationalTestImportHandoffService.ts:48-55,82-100`); import change gateway supports transactional approvals/reconciliation and rollback with source receipts (`PrismaInternationalTestImportChangeGateway.ts:56-141,250-258`). P7 currency resolution verifies active canonical currency; P7 availability checks active country/city IDs; P8 taxonomy and degree relationships check active referenced nodes (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:447-505`; `InternationalTestCanonicalRelationshipService.ts:50-128`). Asset references run through policy (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:513-521`). University admission, scholarship eligibility and course preparation have actual Prisma relationship fields (`schema.prisma:2207-2210`). These foundations must be **preserved**.

**Cross-owner principle:** the Test domain owns the existence, scoring nomenclature and publication of a test. Universities/Scholarships own their admissions/eligibility rules and may reference a stable published test/version. Do not copy the Test as the canonical university requirement, and do not give P7/P8 direct upward dependencies on P9.

## 08.4 Findings — overall classification

| ID | Severity | Category | Verified source finding / impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| ITEST-ADM-001 | 🔴 P0 | Publish / Admin ↔ Public | `publish` only flips `status/isPubliclyVisible`; no frozen publication snapshot/atomic `currentPublishedVersionId`; public list/detail return mutable current root. Current edits can alter published content without a publish event. |
| ITEST-ADM-002 | 🔴 P1 | Security / cross-owner | Child `update({where:{id:data.id}})` on variants/sections/fees/links/materials ignores route `testId`; mutation can modify child of a different test despite passing an authorized parent route. |
| ITEST-ADM-003 | 🔴 P1 | Public data minimization | Public repository returns admin-shaped root with `importEvidence`, `optionalFields`, administrative notes and other internal metadata; no explicit whitelisted public DTO. |
| ITEST-ADM-004 | 🔴 P1 | State transitions/concurrency | Publish/readiness checked before mutation transaction; general update & child update have no expected revision; no formal status transition invariant. Race can invalidate approval or cause lost edits. |
| ITEST-ADM-005 | 🔴 P1 | Evidence integrity | `InternationalTestEvidence` is 1:1 with test and `addEvidence` UPSERT overwrites older provenance. Self-entered `HIGH/AUTHORITATIVE` + URL suffices for `verifySource`; no protection against stale verification after evidence updates. |
| ITEST-ADM-006 | 🔴 P1 | AR/EN contract | Public localization service strips `localizedNameAr/En` but shared mapper reads both; public shared ExamDetails forces RTL and Arabic captions even in EN mode. Translated names/presentation can diverge from requested locale. |
| ITEST-ADM-007 | 🟡 P1 | Review workflow | `InternationalTestContentBlock.reviewStatus` supports APPROVED/MAPPED/IGNORED/NEEDS_REVIEW, but current admin viewer chiefly displays review badges; no section-block review mutation in P9 admin router, and publication readiness does not require reviewed blocks or approved version. |
| ITEST-ADM-008 | 🟡 P1 | Domain contract/admin lifecycle | Local UI status union contains `INCOMPLETE` not present in canonical `InternationalTestStatus`; API create accepts explicit arbitrary lifecycle status; `markReadyToPublish` can jump directly to publishable without reviewer sign-off. |
| ITEST-ADM-009 | 🟡 P1 | Profile ownership | Schema contains sessions, test centers, requirements, policies, equivalencies and version-level score profiles but current P9 admin router lacks editorial CRUD/readiness for those objects; Public mapper does not project these into dedicated sections. |
| ITEST-ADM-010 | 🟡 P1 | Public semantics | `mapInternationalTestToExam` maps `availability.testingWindowsNotes` into `recognitionSummary`; unrelated concept surfaces as recognition. Related universities/scholarships fields exist in public presentation model but are not populated by mapper. |
| ITEST-ADM-011 | 🟡 P2 | Metrics/list correctness | Published/review/incomplete dashboard counters are computed from **only current page** while the result has global `total`; gives false cross-page metrics. Sorting limited to createdAt-desc; no deterministic ID tie-breaker. |
| ITEST-ADM-012 | 🟡 P2 | Reference UX | Availability editor asks administrators to type comma-separated country/city IDs, while backend expects active **canonical IDs**, and displayed placeholder shows ISO codes. Unhelpful for reliable operation. |
| ITEST-ADM-013 | 🟡 P1 | Relations/write identity | Root update of country/language/taxonomy/degree relationships deletes all and recreates whenever supplied (`deleteMany:{}`), causing unnecessary relationship identity churn / potential external dependency drift. |
| ITEST-ADM-014 | 🟡 P2 | Create vs localization | Manual create schema accepts localized names while `createTest` rejects translation payload fields; generic update schema does not accept localized names; dedicated name-review path requires a prior import version/hash. Non-imported test localization lacks an operable route. |
| ITEST-ADM-015 | 🟡 P2 | API errors/validation | Admin router responds `400` with raw thrown message for non-404 errors, including consistency conflicts; no normalized `409` optimistic conflict or stable business error code. URL and provider source verification need explicit trusted authority policies, without network SSRF. |
| ITEST-ADM-016 | 🟡 P2 | Scalability/versions | Provider selector fixed max 250; root list uses offset & `createdAt` order only; import version numbering uses last+1 with `@@unique([testId, versionNumber])` but no explicit retry policy on concurrent conflict. Public frontend loads all published pages before client-side filtering. |
| ITEST-ADM-017 | 🟡 P2 | UI/history & observability | “Sources & History” lists sources and import versions, not a true chronological audit/status/approval trail; missing per-field change actor/date and trace to publication snapshot. |

The 🔴 symbols mean **source-established defects**; P0/P1/P2 independently rank remediation urgency. Observed security boundary facts are not a live exploit demonstration.

## 08.5 Product/UX findings and functional gaps (Phase A)

**List page — 🟢 implemented:** searchable card/table list, status/category filters, server-side paginated `total`, per-test operations, loading/error/empty and archive confirmation. **🟡 needs remediation:** counters misleading across pages (`InternationalTestsAdminPage.tsx:276-278`); no sort/filter for provider ID, verification, readiness reason, country, lastUpdated; category/status subsets not shareable; no multi-select draft triage; selection dropdown limits (provider list max 250); typed status diverges from domain (`:7`). A per-test review queue or “Needs Review” shortcut is worth prioritizing; mass publish is **not** required.

**Detail — 🟢 implemented:** four tabs, score, sections, variants, fees, official links, availability, preparation materials, evidence, canonical relationships and source-import versions (`InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx:216-220,330-446,733-777`). **🟡 needs remediation:** status/readiness/editorial workflow not integrated with source-section signoff; test center/session/requirement/policy/equivalence fields lack normal editor; manual comma-delimited canonical IDs confuse operators (`:2062-2094,2192-2220`); source evidence over-writes; no audit timeline. Avoid adding many top-level tabs: prefer subsections nested in the existing four tabs.

**Needs-review lifecycle:** `IMPORTED → READY_TO_REVIEW → NEEDS_REVIEW → READY_TO_PUBLISH → PUBLISHED → ...` is represented in enum (`enums.ts:1-9`), but no complete typed transition use cases for review acceptance/rejection and reviewer responsibility. Current `/mark-publishable` changes to ready when readiness passes without a version/field sign-off (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:170-180`). A dashboard readiness report is not itself reviewer approval. Add minimal maker/checker gates only for privileged verification/approval/publication; retain role and audit governance.

**Source provenance:** new evidence form permits operator-selected high trust; `verifySource` tests presence of a URL and an asserted trust enum, not actual authority. Verification should be a recorded human attestation tied to a specific immutable evidence hash/source version/actor; remote URL liveness is advisory and **RUNTIME PENDING**, not a gate based on website scraping.

**Comparison with mature testing providers/catalogs:** mature testing programs distinguish exam family vs variant (paper/computer, academic/general), scoring revision/effective validity, fee jurisdiction, official registration source, delivery windows, accessibility policies and change date; mature CMS separates draft, review, approval, immutable public release. MANARATAK already has several corresponding fields and relational models. The enterprise gap is primarily **governance, publication consistency and editor coverage**, not lack of dozens of new bells and whistles.

## 08.6 Admin ↔ API ↔ Domain ↔ Prisma ↔ Public trace (Phase C)

| Path | Actual source implementation | Review |
|---|---|---|
| List | `InternationalTestsAdminPage` → `/admin/international-tests` → use case `.list` → repository `.list` → `InternationalTest` + normalized children | 🟢 functional; 🟡 stats/sort/scale |
| Edit root | detail `adminApiClient.updateInternationalTest` → `PATCH /:id` → `updateTest` → transactional `repository.update` → Prisma root + nested relations | 🔴 missing version/immutable published boundary |
| Child edit | detail editor → `/:id/variants\|sections\|fees\|official-links\|preparation-materials` → admin use case → Prisma child `.update(where:{id})` | 🔴 missing `testId` child owner predicate |
| P6 handoff | dispatcher `TESTS/INTERNATIONAL_TESTS` → staging service → import promotion/change set → source version and root | 🟢 staging/atomic import support; ⚪ runtime evidence needed |
| Provenance | admin `POST /:id/evidence` → `addEvidence` → `PrismaInternationalTestEvidence.upsert(where:{testId})` | 🔴 prior evidence replaced, verification linkage weak |
| Ready/publish | readiness policy + `/mark-publishable` → `publish` → `repository.update` status `PUBLISHED`, visible true | 🔴 no frozen version, recheck under lock or expected revision |
| Published list | `/public/international-tests` → localized public use case → `repository.listPublished` → ORM filtered `PUBLISHED` and visible | 🟢 predicate at SQL layer; 🔴 same mutable root/admin-shaped DTO |
| Published detail | `/:slug` → repository `findPublishedBySlug` requires status PUBLISHED + visibility true | 🟢 SQL visibility; 🔴 mutable content and internal evidence projection |
| Website | `publicLiveDataSource.loadPublishedExams` → `ApiClient.getInternationalTests` → `mapInternationalTestToExam` → `ExamsSearchPage`/`ExamDetails` | 🟢 real public API integration; 🟡 locale/semantics/scalability |
| Downstream | `UniversityProgramAdmissionRequirement`, scholarship eligibility, course test references in Prisma | 🟢 relational slots exist; ⚪ confirm consumer response and version policy in E2E |

**Publication invariant to implement:** the public API should read a **published immutable snapshot/version** for a test and no draft/admin-only field. A valid edit while test is published must create/edit a **separate draft or fail**; it must not silently modify the currently visible snapshot. Tying versions only to imported raw content is insufficient if live structured profile remains mutable. Publish creates/verifies/atomically selects a frozen read model; unpublish hides it without deleting history. Enforce `testId` match for `currentPublishedVersionId` under the same transaction (schema relation alone does not encode same-owner equality).

**Sensitive DTO exposure:** `defaultInclude` includes `evidence` and other children (`PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:75-88`); `mapToDto` spreads `...safeOptionalFields, ...rest` and puts `importEvidence` back (`:1527-1569`); `LocalizedInternationalTestPublicUseCases.ts:16-42` returns that DTO. Public allowlisting is required to exclude `evidenceSnippet`, `contentHash`, `mergeSuggestions`, internal administrative notes and future sensitive optional keys. This is a source-level data-minimization flaw; severity depends on real stored data **RUNTIME PENDING**.

## 08.7 Architecture/ownership/domain findings (Phase B/D)

1. **Current public state is mutable, not a contracted projection** (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:187-205`; `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:236-245,618-626`), despite presence of versions and `currentPublishedVersionId` in Prisma (`schema.prisma:2168,2265-2302`). An immutable snapshot is the smallest correct fix; do not duplicate the entire owner aggregate ungoverned.
2. **Core profile vs imported versions:** import version holds `contentBlocks` with `reviewStatus`, but the core `InternationalTest` maintains editable sections, links, scale, variants independently. Readiness policy checks general fields, score and link, not imported `contentBlocks` review or `approvedBy` (`InternationalTestPublicationReadinessPolicy.ts:17-66`). Link approved source profile to publication candidate and reject stale approvals.
3. **Canonical relationships:** `InternationalTestCanonicalRelationshipService` validates P7/P8 IDs & active status; dedicated `addCanonicalRelationship` does lock-based owner + reference locking (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:108-149`). However generic root `repository.update` still wholesale replaces relationship rows when arrays are supplied (`PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:471-510`). Canonical relationship service should be preferred for incremental governed edits.
4. **Cross-aggregate ownership:** references to universities/scholarships belong to those owners, not to public Test `optionalFields`. Avoid direct imports from P9 persistence into P11/P12; use read contracts/gateways and version event references.
5. **Score semantics:** source contains `score-policy.ts` and `InternationalTestScoreScale` singleton plus `InternationalTestVersionScoreScale`; avoid treating all exams as CEFR-language assessments. Only applicable tests should have CEFR mapping; general pass thresholds and exam equivalencies require source/date/scope and review.
6. **Localized naming:** `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:285-315` deliberately strips `localizedNameAr/En`; `packages/ui/src/public-tests/presentation.ts:140-145` expects them. Contract alignment should be decided in one place and tested at both Arabic and English public entrypoints.

## 08.8 API / validation / persistence findings (Phase D)

**API:** `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:55-81` query pagination has max 100; root create :121-138 allows client-selected status; `rootUpdateSchema:139-157` lacks expected version and name translations; operational actions :330-466 use `req.authUserId` actor but only inherited coarse RBAC; error handler :468-473 returns raw messages as 400. Positive: strict per-payload Zod validation and parent auth boundary exist.

**Application:** `createTest/updateTest` use domain validation and canonical provider/relationship canonicalization (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:80-105`); source-name review and draft identity corrections have source hash/expected value/locking (`:244-411`). Strong existing mechanisms should be reused. General `updateTest`, `publish`, `unpublish`, `archive`, child upserts lack equivalent revision guards and publish-time source snapshot guarantee (`:170-205,419-521`). Current source verification `:231-242` is not anchored to immutable evidence.

**Prisma:** root/test version/provider/family/variant/section/score/fee/link/availability/material/evidence and consumer FKs are real schema models (`schema.prisma:2155-2733`); countries/languages/taxonomy/degree owner canonical FKs exist. Child `update` path uses globally unique child ID only, rather than owner-constrained predicate (`PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:741-752,781-794,842-854,875-883,945-955`). Evidence `upsert` overwrites singleton (`:971-1007`). List uses count and offset `createdAt desc` (`:599-615`). Availability JSON stores canonical country/city ID arrays (`schema.prisma:2423-2437`), so FK/on-delete reference enforcement is application-only; separately validate city-country membership, deduplication and lifecycle.

**Source/import concurrency:** `createImportDraftVersion` increments latest `versionNumber` under SERIALIZABLE transaction context and DB unique constraint (`PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:1010-1043`; schema `@@unique([testId, versionNumber])` at :2297). This has some protection; verify retry behavior on serialization/uniqueness conflict rather than claiming guaranteed corruption.

## 08.9 Security / RBAC (Phase E)

**🟢 implemented:** `apps/api/src/app.ts:746-755,781-783` mounts authenticated `/admin` with admin permission + idempotency middleware + generic mutation audit; public routes are separately mounted; SQL published predicate enforces `PUBLISHED AND isPubliclyVisible` at repository level (`PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:236-245,618-626`). Tests/admin UI must not be taken as a replacement for API guard, but this guard is present.

**🔴 confirmed issues:** (1) authorized user can update a different test's child via forged child ID in another test's upsert request, since Prisma ignores route parent on UPDATE; fix for strict ownership even without multi-tenancy. (2) public returns internal evidence/optionalFields/admin notes; public DTO minimality must be explicit. (3) publish has time-of-check/time-of-use exposure with concurrent edits.

**🟡 governance/security:** no distinct `view/edit/source-verify/approve/publish/archive` authorization; a single manage capability may be intentionally sufficient for small initial teams, but high-impact approve/publish or source verification should be assigned explicit policy; choose compact role scopes, not dozens of permissions. Official links accept HTTP(S) URI syntax; do not presume provider affiliation from URL scheme alone. If a crawler is later added, guard against SSRF/redirects by P6 provider-allowlist policy. Avoid exposing internal stack/error details, and use typed 409 conflicts. Preserve authorization/access tests, not UI hiding.

## 08.10 Audit / events / outbox (Phase F)

**🟢 real atomic path verified:** `apps/api/src/infrastructure/di/container.ts:779-790` injects `AtomicDomainMutationCoordinator`; `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:575-581` uses transactional repository `withTransaction`; `AtomicDomainMutationCoordinator.ts:30-64` produces actor/correlation audit and outbox event; `AtomicAuditedOutboxMutationExecutor.ts:23-27` stores business mutation, audit and event in one Unit of Work. P6 change-set gateway likewise uses an atomic audited outbox executor (`PrismaInternationalTestImportChangeGateway.ts:250-258`). **Do not “fix” by adding duplicate separate audit/outbox writes.**

**Gaps to review/fix:** `publish` event currently communicates status flag but not immutable published version, review evidence and revision; `unpublish/archive` likewise lack public-snapshot transition contract. `createTest` audit aggregate ID can use canonicalName/slug before generated UUID (`InternationalTestUseCases.ts:89-91`); verify target identity correlation and prefer persisted ID whenever available. Consumer idempotency/rehydration after published version replacement is **RUNTIME PENDING**. Admin “History” view does not query or display canonical audit timeline for test-specific actions even though audit infrastructure exists.

## 08.11 Test coverage/gaps (Phase G)

**Existing suites, do not erase:** unit tests prove portions of create/update validation, publish readiness, child method delegation, source-name conflict handling and canonical fee currency (`packages/application/tests/tests-platform/InternationalTestAdminUseCases.spec.ts:66-224,409-511`); Prisma tests cover canonical JSON shadowing, SQL published visibility, filters and some child CRUD (`packages/infrastructure/tests/international-tests/PrismaInternationalTestRepository.spec.ts:63-219,265-427`); API router tests cover standard operations and validation (`apps/api/tests/presentation/api/router/InternationalTestAdminRouter.spec.ts:48-323`); public router tests inspect displayName localization (`InternationalTestPublicRouter.spec.ts:19-33`). These are tests *present in source*; no tests were executed here.

**Required additions:**
- Cross-owner child-ID write **negative tests** for each writable child kind, including parent exists but child belongs elsewhere.
- Concurrent publish/edit/review-source/evidence/child mutations: immutable version, conflict 409, no stale reviewed hash, no lost updates.
- Published data equality across get/list/slug and unchanged visible data after draft edits; unpublish restores invisibility.
- Public DTO whitelist tests assert no `importEvidence`, `contentHash`, `evidenceSnippet`, `mergeSuggestions`, admin notes and raw `optionalFields` secrets.
- Locale contract tests through real projection + `mapInternationalTestToExam` + English/Arabic public visual text/dir.
- Evidence revision history, reviewed-source trust and invalidation on evidence/source changes.
- Version-block approval/readiness negative path and rejection/restore/archiving lifecycle transitions.
- P7 currency/availability bad IDs, city outside country, P8 inactive degrees/taxonomy; importer staging and ownership/collision.
- Honest aggregate metrics across pagination, deterministic sort and 250+ provider selection.
- Permission isolation: viewer vs editor vs approver if role split approved; mutation audit/outbox exactly once on success, none on failure.
- Browser E2E only after runtime/provisioned test DB is explicitly approved; no DB migrations, seeds or writes in this review.

## 08.13 Prioritized Codex implementation tasks (Phase D–G)

> **Execution guard:** All tasks below are **plans only**. No source edits or database operations were performed. Codex should use current `main` anew before implementation, inspect migrations/ADRs first, and isolate destructive DB operations behind an explicit Database Mutation Gate. Order depends on code contracts, not arbitrary refactoring.

### ITEST-ADM-001 — Atomic Published Snapshot / Read-model Contract
- **Priority:** **P0 / Critical**.
- **Problem:** publish toggles flags without immutable selection; public reads current mutable root and normalized child relations.
- **Evidence / Files:** `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:170-205`; `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:236-245,618-626`; `schema.prisma:2168,2188,2265-2302`; `InternationalTestPublicRouter.ts:21-28`.
- **Required Change:** design a minimal versioned, immutable, reviewed canonical publication payload; in one transaction re-check status/readiness/revision/source hash, create/freeze snapshot, bind `currentPublishedVersionId` to same test, atomically set visibility; public list/detail must load **that snapshot**; unpublish/archive hide while retaining history. Explicit mapping for all public structured fields and locale. Use existing Outbox with version ID.
- **Architecture Constraints:** P9 owns snapshots; P6 raw archive remains external/source immutable; consumers use read contract/versioned event. No cross-domain table writes as a substitute.
- **Do Not Change:** already-approved source versions; P7/P8 canonical owner identities; existing stable slugs/public IDs; legacy published content without a safe transition plan.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** editing root/child as draft does not change public response until subsequent approved publish; published version belongs to owner; public get/list return same version; unpublish removes it immediately; archive retains old snapshots.
- **Required Tests:** two-release integration, concurrent publish+edit, public detail/list consistency, failed transaction audit/outbox rollback, missing/mismatched version negative.

### ITEST-ADM-002 — Enforce Parent Ownership for Child Upserts
- **Priority:** **P1 / High (security/data integrity)**.
- **Problem:** child input UUID can update a row owned by a different test.
- **Evidence / Files:** `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:736-764,775-808,837-867,870-894,940-968`; `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:386-457`.
- **Required Change:** restrict update by `(id,testId)` in an atomic checked owner operation (`updateMany` + affected row check, or pre-check with locking) for variant, section, fee, link and material; reject mismatches with canonical 404/403/409 policy. Ensure repository contract requires parent on all child writes.
- **Architecture Constraints:** no unauthorized cross-owner edits; preserve atomic audit/outbox of successful parent mutation.
- **Do Not Change:** ability to create new child without client ID; existing IDs; physical deletion of unrelated records.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** attempt with parent A and child B cannot alter B even for an admin with P9 manage; legitimate A update succeeds exactly once.
- **Required Tests:** per-child cross-owner negative API+Prisma cases, transaction rollback, audit of rejected attempt as per security policy.

### ITEST-ADM-003 — Public DTO Allowlist and Internal Metadata Isolation
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** Public routes return root DTO with import evidence, optional/admin notes and internal source tracking.
- **Evidence / Files:** `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:75-88,1527-1569,1703-1717`; `LocalizedInternationalTestPublicUseCases.ts:16-42`.
- **Required Change:** define explicit PublicInternationalTest DTO/read mapper from **published snapshot only** with allowlisted names, versions, score, price, official links and safe summaries; never serialize evidence contentHash/evidenceSnippet/conflicts/merge metadata or internal notes; keep Admin DTO unchanged.
- **Architecture Constraints:** public boundary in application/read repository; fail closed for newly added admin columns.
- **Do Not Change:** canonical Admin evidence/history; actual official registration/source URLs intentionally approved for public display.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** public response keys strictly conform to public schema and exclude internal admin fields; no `optionalFields` unreviewed pass-through.
- **Required Tests:** serialization regression with realistic private metadata and new unexpected DB fields.

### ITEST-ADM-004 — Lifecycle State Machine and Compare-and-Swap Edits
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** transitions/readiness check outside mutation transaction; generic editor update lacks revision and published-draft guard.
- **Evidence / Files:** `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:94-105,170-205,575-581`; `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:139-157,352-384`; `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:374-515`.
- **Required Change:** centralize valid transitions; require `expectedRevision`/`If-Match` on root/child/approve/publish operations, transaction revalidation, conflict errors; immutable live version while drafting. Existing lock/hash source-name review must be preserved, not bypassed.
- **Architecture Constraints:** one P9 lifecycle policy, existing AtomicDomainMutationCoordinator; no generic mutable `PUBLISHED` edits.
- **Do Not Change:** meaningful statuses `IMPORTED`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`, `REJECTED`, `ARCHIVED`, or source-hash compare.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** stale update rejected; no silent lost work, no publish-after-change when previous approval is stale, invalid transition rejected without write.
- **Required Tests:** two-editor stale conflict, publish/edit race, rejected/archived transition negative, concurrent approval and rollback.

### ITEST-ADM-005 — Append-only Evidence and Verifiable Source Attestation
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** single evidence row overwritten; HIGH/AUTHORITATIVE string + URL marks verified without review-bound immutability.
- **Evidence / Files:** `schema.prisma:2457-2481`; `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:971-1007`; `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:231-242`; `InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx:2490-2670,2747-2755`.
- **Required Change:** represent evidence/retrieval attestation as append-only versioned records (or new version-bound evidence if migration approved), attribution, captured sourceHash, reviewedBy/reviewedAt/reviewReason, authoritative source domain checks; invalidate verification when material source changes; add approve/revoke with explicit permission. Retain prior evidence.
- **Architecture Constraints:** no provider crawling/SSRF; no deletion of historical evidence; migration is design-only pending explicit DB gate.
- **Do Not Change:** P6 raw archive, original import hashes, provider ownership.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** old evidence available after new submission, publish uses currently verified hash and reviewer, invalid/stale/trust downgrade blocks publication.
- **Required Tests:** evidence history, untrusted domain, stale hash, concurrent supersession, revocation and publish-negative.

### ITEST-ADM-006 — Canonical AR/EN Projection and Bidirectional UI
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** public app/localizer name fields disagree, public exam detail hardcodes RTL and Arabic labels.
- **Evidence / Files:** `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:285-315`; `packages/ui/src/public-tests/presentation.ts:112-167`; `packages/ui/src/public-tests/ExamDetails.tsx:56-97`; `InternationalTestPublicRouter.ts:13-28`.
- **Required Change:** build explicit localized public presentation contract keyed to requested locale; preserve correct localized source fields in adapter or map canonical `displayName` to locale-specific names; translate labels, date/number formats and `dir` per locale, with disciplined fallback metadata.
- **Architecture Constraints:** reuse existing Localization platform; do not hardcode translation pairs in new P9-only infrastructure; retain Arabic-first branding.
- **Do Not Change:** source canonical names or official proper nouns as a translation side effect.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** /?locale=ar and /?locale=en show correct distinct names/text/direction where supplied; admin preview and published public use consistent adapter.
- **Required Tests:** full service→mapper→render AR and EN contract, missing translation fallback, mixed LTR score/link formatting.

### ITEST-ADM-007 — Source Blocks/Version Approval Integrated into Readiness
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** imported sections display review badge, but no complete approve/ignore/map mutation + reviewed-version requirement before release.
- **Evidence / Files:** `InternationalTestSourceSectionsViewer.tsx:113-116,415-443`; `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:312-327,459-465`; `InternationalTestPublicationReadinessPolicy.ts:17-66`; `schema.prisma:2265-2302,2713-2733`.
- **Required Change:** add source-section review commands (approved/ignored/mapped with reason), review-complete version state/checker and provenance; tie readiness to approved candidate; present actionable blockers/section counts; ensure imported raw immutable, review decisions separate.
- **Architecture Constraints:** P9 owns semantic mapping, P6 raw content remains archive. No automatic publication from import.
- **Do Not Change:** historical version content, `sourceHash`, source file blobs.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** outstanding required block blocks publish; reviewer approval recorded per version; changed source hash requires renewed review; non-applicable blocks may be explicitly ignored with reason.
- **Required Tests:** version hash guard, status transition, partial review, concurrency, audit/outbox.

### ITEST-ADM-008 — Align Canonical Statuses and Approval Semantics
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** admin type declares status `INCOMPLETE` not in domain enum; create can request PUBLISHED directly; approve step not explicit.
- **Evidence / Files:** `enums.ts:1-9,27-31`; `InternationalTestsAdminPage.tsx:7`; `InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx:34`; `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:121-138`; `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:170-180`.
- **Required Change:** single status import/type; keep `INCOMPLETE` only in completeness dimension; ignore/forbid externally requested lifecycle on create except safe draft states; typed `submitForReview`, `requestChanges`, `reject`, `approve` commands with review actor and source-bound approval.
- **Architecture Constraints:** small lifecycle model, compatible migration for existing records if approved separately.
- **Do Not Change:** values without exhaustive data/consumer impact review.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** no status contradiction; direct create cannot bypass review; approval cannot be self-asserted by arbitrary payload.
- **Required Tests:** enum exhaustive compile guard, API invalid transitions, approval-negative.

### ITEST-ADM-009 — Complete Priority 1 Test Profile Editorial Coverage
- **Priority:** **P1 / High for applicable data; P2 for less common fields**.
- **Problem:** session, center, requirement, policy, version-scale, equivalency models exist but are not exposed via dedicated canonical P9 admin workflow or student-facing projection.

- **Required Change:** prioritize version applicability, result-validity, major sections/timing, real center/location, policy/registration, and independently sourced CEFR for eligible language exams; establish minimal validators and app use cases then expose within existing four detail tabs; keep special professional exams optional.
- **Architecture Constraints:** no dynamic booking/payments; P7 normalized country/city/currency; qualified equivalency is reference info, not automatic admission decision.
- **Do Not Change:** all test types into one mandatory form with inapplicable CEFR / venue fields.

### ITEST-ADM-010 — Correct Public Recognition and Consumer Links

Do not imply an institution accepts a test unless its admission policy states so.

### ITEST-ADM-011 — Accurate List Metrics and Stable Pagination
- **Priority:** **P2 / Medium**.
- **Problem:** dashboard status counters reflect current 20 rows, misleading when total larger; results sort on `createdAt` only.
- **Evidence / Files:** `InternationalTestsAdminPage.tsx:125-181,276-278,565-583`; `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:529-615`.
- **Required Change:** API aggregated counts for full filter-set (explicit whether stats global/filtered); stable sort `createdAt DESC,id DESC`, whitelisted sort direction and updatedAt/name options, preserve `total` and page semantics. Cache/debounce search where useful.

### ITEST-ADM-012 — P7 Canonical Availability Selectors
- **Priority:** **P2 / Medium**.
- **Problem:** editor requires raw IDs/codes; placeholder ISO codes contradicts backend ID lookup.
- **Evidence / Files:** `InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx:2062-2094,2192-2220`; `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:492-505`; `schema.prisma:2423-2437`.
- **Required Change:** P7-backed searchable country/city multiselect showing human names, code and canonical ID; submit IDs only; validate city-country membership, duplicate entries, region membership and active status server-side.
- **Architecture Constraints:** P7 retains identity; no free-text duplicate country database.

### ITEST-ADM-013 — Incremental Canonical Relationship Writes
- **Priority:** **P1 / High**.
- **Problem:** full replacement of relationships deletes/recreates row identities even when no semantic changes.
- **Evidence / Files:** `PrismaInternationalTestRepository.ts:471-510`; `InternationalTestCanonicalRelationshipService.ts:31-128`; `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:108-149`.
- **Required Change:** treat relation updates as diff/merge with stable unique identity, add/remove explicit audit events, concurrency checks, canonical validators and dependency guards for published relationships; use existing reviewed graph service.
- **Architecture Constraints:** no P7/P8 upward import, no orphaned consumer references, version-bound public graph.
- **Do Not Change:** unrelated existing relationships on a partial update.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** no-op retains row ID; adding one relation does not delete others; invalid/inactive references blocked.
- **Required Tests:** diff no-op, concurrent add, unique conflict, preserve identity, published-draft graph isolation.

### ITEST-ADM-014 — Manual Localization Without Import Version
- **Priority:** **P2 / Medium**.

- **Do Not Change:** imported source-name concurrency locks or immutable canonical IDs.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** manual record can acquire AR/EN names via documented reviewed flow; no silent discard or misleading create validation.
- **Required Tests:** manual names, imported hash conflict, language-specific correction review.

### ITEST-ADM-015 — Structured Error Contract and Official URL Trust Rules
- **Priority:** **P2 / Medium**.
- **Problem:** API collapses business conflict to 400 and echoes raw Error; URL validation checks syntax, not source authority.
- **Evidence / Files:** `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:468-473,117-120`; `InternationalTestPublicationReadinessPolicy.ts:57-77`; `InternationalTestUseCases.ts:231-242`.
- **Required Change:** canonical typed 400/403/404/409/422 problem-details, sanitized error payload and trace ID; policy store official provider/allowed URL origins reviewed, with safe handling of http vs https; reserve network fetching for P6 secure provider execution.
- **Architecture Constraints:** do not expose credentials/stack; no SSRF-prone backend HTTP verification.
- **Do Not Change:** approved legacy routes without compatibility tests.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** stale version 409 with stable code, malformed URL 400, untrusted official source blocks verification, no internal database message disclosed.
- **Required Tests:** API negative codes, link trust and redirect-policy unit, source verification provenance.

### ITEST-ADM-016 — Import Version/Provider Query Concurrency and Bounded Reads
- **Priority:** **P2 / Medium**.

- **Required Change:** safe monotonic per-owner version allocation with well-defined retry on serialization/unique conflicts; paginated provider search with server filters; load/search exams by query and page or maintain an explicit bounded cached discovery index as justified by scale.
- **Architecture Constraints:** preserve idempotent import receipts and P6 manual-promotion behavior; no ad hoc global lock.
- **Do Not Change:** published source hashes/version numbers or importer duplicate keys.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** two simultaneous version requests produce unique sequential committed versions or controlled retry; 251st provider discoverable; public listing remains bounded.
- **Required Tests:** concurrent insertion (transaction-enabled test DB when authorized), 251-provider search, paged public result stability.

### ITEST-ADM-017 — Unified Admin History, Approval and Publication Timeline
- **Priority:** **P2 / Medium**.
- **Problem:** Sources & History tab is version/evidence viewer but no true merged actor/action/time timeline; imported and publication version transitions not apparent.

- **Acceptance Criteria:** reviewers can determine who verified a source, approved a version, published it and subsequently unpublished it; pagination and RBAC work.
- **Required Tests:** read projection ordering, multiple releases, denied audit viewer, correlation, immutable event history.

## 08.14 Recommended implementation order (no fixes in this review)

4. **Admin operability:** 009 missing profile editors as applicable, 011 metrics, 012 P7 pickers, 014 manual localized naming, 015 error contract, 017 history, 016 bounded provider/search/version operations.

## 08.FG — Deep Functional & Feature Gap Audit (ملحق جديد؛ قبل تنفيذ الإصلاحات)

**Baseline:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-@bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca`، مراجعة Source-only؛ لا تدعي إجراء Browser E2E أو DB runtime.
**Inventory التفصيلي:** `InternationalTestsAdminPage.tsx` (cards/table, status/category/search, pagination); `InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx` (details, relationships, readiness, sources/history, variants/fees/score/availability/provider); `InternationalTestSourceSectionsViewer.tsx`.
**موجود ويجب عدم تكراره:** توجد actual editors للـscore scale والvariants والavailability والمصادر وprovider creation وإدارة النشر؛ مشكلات مطابقة snapshots/public DTO والمحررات الناقصة عند المصدر موثقة في 08.
**معيار مقارنة منضبط:** DAAD/UCAS programme discovery — فلاتر صالحة بحسب الجغرافيا/متطلبات القبول وربط exam acceptance، لا إعادة بناء منصة التسجيل للاختبارات.
**مصادر المقارنة الخارجية:** [www.daad.de](https://www.daad.de/en/studying-in-germany/universities/all-degree-programmes/). هذه benchmarks لا تثبت نقص المشروع بحد ذاتها؛ الدليل هو مسار Source الموضّح بكل مهمة.
**حد تبنّي المقارنة:** نقلنا: أبعاد country/provider/completeness المؤثرة على اكتشاف شروط القبول؛ لا ننشئ حجوزات اختبار أو نتائج اختبار فعلية داخل MANARATAK.
**قرار التسجيل:** جميع المهام أدناه نواقص **جديدة غير مكررة** في سجل هذا القسم، مع فصل `CONFIRMED_UI_GAP` (غياب وظيفة في الصفحات ومسارات المصدر المفحوصة) عن `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED` (تحسين مطلوب وليس bug مثبت). لا تعيد فتح أخطاء المراجعة الأصلية؛ اتبع أرقامها.

| المعرف | أولوية | التصنيف | الوظيفة المطلوبة |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FGA-08-001` | **P2** | `CONFIRMED_UI_GAP` | غياب فلاتر country/provider/completeness من قائمة الاختبارات رغم دعم API |
| `FGA-08-002` | **P1** | `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED` | عرض Reverse Usage قبل تعديل سياسة/درجة اختبار مستخدم في القبول |
| `FGA-08-003` | **P2** | `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED` | مؤشر صلاحية تاريخية للمصادر الرسمية وروابط التسجيل |

### الفجوات والمهام القابلة للتنفيذ — شرط قبول مستقل لكل مهمة

#### FGA-08-001 — P2 — غياب فلاتر country/provider/completeness من قائمة الاختبارات رغم دعم API

- **الحالة والتفسير:** `CONFIRMED_UI_GAP`؛ أهمية P2 وظيفية/معلوماتية بحسب الأثر، وليست إعلان ثغرة أمنية مؤكدة إلا إن أثبت اختبار مستقل ذلك.
- **دليل الكود الحالي:** `InternationalTestsAdminPage.tsx:125-181,218-258` يرسل status + testCategory + searchQuery فقط؛ `InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:47-75` يقبل completenessStatus, providerName, countryIso2Code كذلك، لكن هذه محددات غير موصولة بواجهة القائمة.
- **حالة الاستخدام وسبب الحاجة:** مدير اختبارات يريد تحديد الاختبارات المتاحة في السعودية والصادرة عن مزود معين، أو غير المكتملة فقط، دون فتح عشرات التفاصيل.
- **الإصلاح التقني المحدد:** إضافة canonical CountryPicker مع provider facet server-side وcompletenessStatus؛ ربطها بنفس query schema وURL search params؛ country filter ينطبق على availability canonical وليس provider nationality.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 08:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 9237 من الخطة الأصلية.
- **الأقسام المتأثرة:** P7 Reference Countries / P9 / P11 admission tests.

#### FGA-08-002 — P1 — عرض Reverse Usage قبل تعديل سياسة/درجة اختبار مستخدم في القبول

- **الحالة والتفسير:** `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED`؛ أهمية P1 وظيفية/معلوماتية بحسب الأثر، وليست إعلان ثغرة أمنية مؤكدة إلا إن أثبت اختبار مستقل ذلك.
- **دليل الكود الحالي:** `InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx:215-220,349-403` يملك علاقات الاختبار وتحرير الدرجات؛ `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:273-284` يربط شروط قبول الجامعة بالـinternationalTestId، و`schema.prisma:1322-1344` يملك علاقة Admission Requirements، لكن detail الاختبار لا يظهر قائمة البرامج المستهلكة مع status/minimumScore.
- **حالة الاستخدام وسبب الحاجة:** تغيير scale اختبار مستخدم شرطًا في 120 برنامج قد يغيّر تفسير الحد الأدنى وتوصيات الطلاب؛ مسؤول الاختبار يحتاج معرفة المتأثر قبل النشر.
- **الإصلاح التقني المحدد:** Read-only reverse dependency endpoint من owner University/Search projection (published/draft/status) مع count/cursor، وimpact flag على تغيير نوع scale، وروابط إلى البرامج؛ لا تسمح لـP9 بتحرير متطلبات P11.
- **Acceptance + negative/regression:** اختبار مستخدم في برنامجين يعرضهما بروابط صحيحة وصلاحيات معزولة؛ scale change warning مبني على owner data؛ لا تُكشف جامعات مسودّة لPublic؛ query bounded.
- **الأقسام المتأثرة:** P11 University / P12 Scholarship / Student eligibility.

#### FGA-08-003 — P2 — مؤشر صلاحية تاريخية للمصادر الرسمية وروابط التسجيل

- **الحالة والتفسير:** `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED`؛ أهمية P2 وظيفية/معلوماتية بحسب الأثر، وليست إعلان ثغرة أمنية مؤكدة إلا إن أثبت اختبار مستقل ذلك.
- **دليل الكود الحالي:** `InternationalTestDetailPage.tsx:412-440` يدير sources/history و`InternationalTestAdminRouter.ts:427-463` يدعم official-links/availability/evidence، بينما `InternationalTestsAdminPage.tsx:125-181,276-288` بلا مؤشر freshness/stale review queue لقواعد التسجيل والرسوم.
- **حالة الاستخدام وسبب الحاجة:** سعر ورسوم ومواعيد اختبار تتغير سنويًا ولا يظهر للمسؤول أن آخر تحقق من الرابط الرسمي تجاوز سياسة تحديثه.
- **الإصلاح التقني المحدد:** Freshness policy per content category (fee, registration link, window, test center) مبنية على verifiedAt/sourceEvidence لا على updatedAt العام، مع stale facet وبند مراجعة دون تعديل الحقائق تلقائيًا.
- **Acceptance + negative/regression:** تحديث حقل غير متعلق لا يعيد ضبط freshness؛ مصدر متقادم يظهر Needs Verification؛ زمن التقرير محدد UTC/timezone؛ الروابط الرسمية غير المستجيبة تسجل failure لا زعم صحة.
- **الأقسام المتأثرة:** P9 / Review Queue / University admissions.

### شروط إعادة مراجعة هذا القسم

1. راجع جميع الصفحات/التبويبات المذكورة وكل نتيجة من API في source+browser عند توفر runtime؛ لا يعتبر وجود زر وحده نجاحًا.
2. افحص search/filter/sort/paging/bulk مقابل owner API؛ أية عملية جماعية جديدة يجب أن تحمل permission وdry-run وversion/conflict checks، ولا تطبق bulk بلا حاجة.
3. اختبر loading, empty, partial failures, denied RBAC, duplicate/concurrent operations، اللغة العربية/الإنجليزية، وعدم كشف مسودات Public أو بيانات Student الخاصة.
4. لا توسع نطاق Domain أو API بلا اختبارات contract، ولا تعدّل قاعدة إنتاج أو ملفات تطبيق ضمن هذه المراجعة.

# 09 — التخصصات والتخصصات الأكاديمية / Majors & Disciplines / P10

> **معيار الإغلاق المحدّث للقسم 09:** إصلاح الأكواد والثغرات والنواقص + اختبارات source/contract/security خفيفة مستهدفة + رفع Commit. **لا يلزم هنا E2E حي أو قاعدة بيانات/مزود تشغيل فعلي**؛ اختبارات التشغيل في الملحق الأخير بعد القسم 28، مع بقاء إطلاق الإنتاج محظورًا دون أدلته.
> **الاختبار الأساسي المختصر:** Majors: التحقق من هوية التخصص والنسخة والحالة وروابط الاستيراد والنشر.


> **Source review baseline:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-`, branch `main`, commit `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca` (2026-10-07). **Review only; no code, GitHub, database, worker, production or provider mutation performed.** Findings below refer to actual source paths and line ranges at this commit. Do not treat a source finding as proven production behavior until separately verified.
>
> **Section status:** **REVIEWED — CRITICAL FIXES REQUIRED / ADMIN EDIT + CONTENT-REVIEW CONTRACT BLOCKERS; NOT CLOSED.** Next section **10 — Universities & Institutions / P11** remains PENDING until the user says «أكمل».

## 09.1 Scope, users and workflow (Phase A: Product)

**Purpose.** P10 is the canonical academic identity and degree-profile owner for Bachelor, Master, Doctorate and Fellowship majors. It must give administrators an intelligible workflow from source import/discovered candidate to canonical identity, P8 references, reviewed content version, publication and eventual retirement, while downstream P11/P12/P13/P15 and Public consume owned facts without duplicating authority. **Do not merge a “Major root”, “Level Profile”, “Content Version”, and “source-only catalog record” into one apparent editable record.**

**Administrative users.** Academic catalog curators, import/reconciliation reviewers, subject editors, publication approvers, and authorized platform administrators. RBAC currently uses the shared `admin:majors:manage` entry guard. More granular maker/checker roles are a product recommendation, not evidence of current enforcement.

**Actual source-confirmed path:** P6 source parsing and staging (`MajorImportStagingUseCase`) → unresolved university/scholarship queue (`PrismaNewMajorCandidateRepository`) or existing canonical Major → Major root + P8-linked `MajorLevelProfile` → source / versions / sections / mappings → `READY_TO_REVIEW` → `READY_TO_PUBLISH` → publish profile/version under a transaction → Public API cursor listing / profile detail → public search/details. The staging-to-owner-promotion bridge is **not registered** in the active dispatcher (finding 09-005); source-only catalog entries are not canonical rows.

**Product/UX inventory verified:** Admin list has search, degree/status/completeness/taxonomy filters and pagination (`MajorAdminPage.tsx:137-208,290-405,548-568`), a discovered-candidate queue (`NewMajorCandidatesPanel.tsx`), multi-profile navigation, content block editor, classification review, alias/relationship read views, versions/readiness and lifecycle confirmations (`MajorDetailPage.tsx`). Public has a localized list/detail API and a content-section component (`MajorPublicRouter.ts`; `PublishedMajorSections.tsx`). **Deficits**: edit HTTP mismatch, approval-state mismatch, profile-vs-root field confusion, source-only catalog disclosure, real source timeline, full counts, existing-major picker, server search, locale-sensitive edit, robust errors and no bulk review operations. Bulk mutation is **deferred** unless justified by actual admin workload and safe approval semantics.

**Mature-platform comparison, principle not feature copying:** Higher-education subject catalogs need stable identifiers, degree-aware profiles, provenance, curated bilingual titles, traceable revisions and predictable discovery. Editorial CMS, job-market databases and university program catalogs are separate truth owners. Useful now: owner-scoped version approval, authoritative references, visible publish status and safe list filters. Important: historic release diff, source aging, precise sibling profile distinctions. Optional/deferred: speculative skill predictions, salary estimators and auto-generated course recommendations; do **not** implement in P10 simply because a foreign catalog shows them.

## 09.2 Relationship map (Phase B)

```text
Depends on / upstream                         Canonical P10 owner                              Downstream consumers
P5 IAM + Audit + Outbox + Assets               Major root identity                             P11 University Programs
P6 raw acquisition + import staging            MajorLevelProfile (P8 DegreeLevel ID)           P12 Scholarship major/eligibility mappings
P7 source country/language reference           Classification mapping (P8 taxonomy ID)        P13 Courses / projections
P8 Academic Taxonomy + DegreeLevel             Source evidence / aliases / versions            P15 Student favorites / hydration
P16 editorial translations where contracted    Reviewed content/version publication            Search / public major catalog
                                              ↕ Cross-domain read projections                  P16 CMS / P21 Careers projections
```

- **P8 → P10**: active canonical references validated in `CanonicalMajorReferenceService.ts:31-76`; profiles link DegreeLevel and taxonomy in `schema.prisma:1961-2003`. P10 MUST NOT create competing P8 entities. `MajorLevel` intentionally covers only four supported profile levels (`majors.ts:9-11`); do not auto-expand to all P8 codes.
- **P6 → P10**: `ImportAdminRouter.ts:334-524` stages catalog/dossier; `MajorImportPromotionUseCase.ts` exists. `container.ts:534-541,797-798` wires handoffs only for scholarships, universities and tests. No evidence of a P10 consumer registered there. The exact runtime execution of promotion remains PENDING.
- **P11/P12 → P10**: candidate queue gathers unresolved university/scholarship references and commits owner resolution through `PrismaNewMajorCandidateRepository.ts:77-104`; transaction-scoped adapters are constructed at `43-55` and used by `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:547-563`.
- **P10 → Public**: source-only catalog is not a public source. `PrismaMajorRepository.listPublished:337-382` requires published Profile and current version pointer; `LocalizedPublicMajorUseCases.ts:28-71` scopes detail; `listContentSections(...publishedOnly:true)` requires that pointer. Preserve these invariants.
- **P10 ↔ P16/P21/P13**: `docs/phases/phase-10-majors/major-ownership-and-read-model-contract.md:3-11` says P16 owns long editorial content, P21 career/market truth and P13 owns course truth; currently P10 admin PATCH still accepts editorial and career-like optional JSON (finding 09-012).

**Cross-section follow-ups, NOT reopening earlier audits:** `CROSS-09-05` P10↔P6 handoff missing; `CROSS-09-07` P10↔P8 active reference governance + profile identity; `CROSS-09-16` P10↔P16 locale/editorial publication; `CROSS-09-21` P10↔P21 careers ownership; `CROSS-09-11/12` P10↔Universities/Scholarships unresolved mapping; `CROSS-09-08` use P10 version-pointer publication pattern as a reference for future P9 repair without copying P10 defects.
