## 09.6 Codex implementation tasks (TASKS ONLY — no implementation in review)

### MAJOR-ADM-001 — Fix basic Major editor method contract
- **Priority:** P0 / Critical.
- **Title:** Align detail-save HTTP method with Admin API.
- **Problem:** Major basic edit sends `PUT /admin/majors/:id` while only `PATCH /:id` is registered for basic metadata.
- **Evidence / Files:** `apps/admin/src/pages/MajorDetailPage.tsx:1555-1567`; `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/MajorAdminRouter.ts:277-330`.
- **Required Change:** Use `PATCH` for root metadata; preferably centralized typed API client method; send only changed, permitted root fields. Expose honest server-error feedback and verify server re-fetch before showing success.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Preserve canonical admin auth/idempotency/audit; no compatibility PUT unless explicitly justified and tested.
- **Do Not Change:** Existing content-section PUT endpoint; stable major identity or DB rows.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Authorized save returns 200 and changed root field persists; readonly unsupported field is not claimed saved; no accidental profile edit.
- **Required Tests:** Admin UI submit contract; API PATCH success / PUT not-found or explicitly documented compatibility; successful reload; permission denial.

### MAJOR-ADM-002 — Unify content review status vs completeness
- **Priority:** P0 / Critical.
- **Title:** Make new content blocks approvable and publishable.
- **Problem:** Repository accepts reviewStatus `NEEDS_REVIEW/COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE` but publication requires `APPROVED/PUBLISHED`; Domain explicitly defines review lifecycle `DRAFT/NEEDS_REVIEW/APPROVED/PUBLISHED/SUPERSEDED`.
- **Evidence / Files:** `packages/domain/src/majors/majors.ts:32-44`; `packages/infrastructure/src/majors/PrismaMajorRepository.ts:213-228,630-635`; `apps/admin/src/pages/MajorDetailPage.tsx:1299-1311`; `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/MajorAdminRouter.ts:196-208`.
- **Required Change:** Use one domain-owned section-review enum; separate profile completeness; require an approved review action with actor, evidence and reason before APPROVED; reject invalid states at Zod + use case + persistence; review current historical values and produce a non-executed, gated remediation plan.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Published version must remain immutable; profile publish only after all release sections are approved; audit/outbox atomic.
- **Do Not Change:** P8 completeness or P6 validation semantics; migrate/reset existing data in this review.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Reviewer can set APPROVED through governed flow; unreviewed content blocks publish; COMPLETE is never accepted as section review status; old values handled via explicit plan.
- **Required Tests:** Domain status matrix, API 400 invalid state, reviewer authorization/negative, repository transaction guard, publish green/red paths, legacy-state compatibility audit.

### MAJOR-ADM-003 — Govern canonical identity instead of silently ignoring it
- **Priority:** P0 / Critical.
- **Title:** Remove fake editable canonicalName or provide a dedicated correction workflow.
- **Problem:** Modal offers editable `canonicalName`, but update schema doesn't accept it; Zod `.object` strips the field and server could claim save success after method correction.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorDetailPage.tsx:1586-1593`; `MajorAdminRouter.ts:80-111,277-330`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:168-200`.
- **Required Change:** Default: render immutable canonical identity read-only. If explicit correction needed, separate endpoint with evidence, reviewer reason, duplicate-key collision check, published-state guard, CAS and atomic audit. Do not silently change dedup key/slug.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Canonical identity P10-owned, no accidental rebuild of profiles or cross-domain links.
- **Do Not Change:** Public ID/classification code or aliases automatically.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** No successful UI save implies canonicalName changed when it did not; approved correction handles collisions deterministically.
- **Required Tests:** UI read-only, unknown-field rejection or safe clarification, corrected-name conflict, permission, published-identity immutability.

### MAJOR-ADM-004 — Separate Root Major and Level Profile editors
- **Priority:** P1 / High (architecture integrity; treat as blocker before broad edit rollout).
- **Title:** Prevent degree/profile codes being written as root legacy optional JSON.
- **Problem:** UI fills degreeLevel/classificationCode from selected profile then sends them to root PATCH; repository writes unknown noncanonical update keys to root `optionalFields`, not `MajorLevelProfile`.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorDetailPage.tsx:425-436,492-503,1555-1563`; `MajorAdminRouter.ts:304-317`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:168-200`.
- **Required Change:** Root identity edit excludes profile fields; profile-specific change gets owner-validated contract and governed DegreeLevel ID/P8 node picker; classification code is immutable or corrected through approval + duplicate checks. Reject deprecated compatibility fields for new writes, don't shadow canonical IDs.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Multi-profile major with independent release identity. Use real P8 FK, no degree string treated as authority.
- **Do Not Change:** Historical profile codes, P8 DegreeLevel ownership, legacy source fields without analysis.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Root patch cannot alter or shadow profile degree/code; authorized profile operation updates only expected profile; mixed-profile scenario stays consistent.
- **Required Tests:** Root PATCH negative, profile ownership, canonical P8 validation, existing/published profile rejection, legacy optional overlay regression.

### MAJOR-ADM-005 — Wire P6 staging to a P10-owned promotion consumer
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Close explicit manual canonical import handoff and idempotent promotion.
- **Problem:** Staging/preview routes exist and `MajorImportPromotionUseCase` exists, but current `ImportHandoffDispatcher` DI maps only scholarships/universities/tests; generic P6 semantic promote route intentionally returns 422.
- **Evidence / Files:** `apps/api/src/infrastructure/di/container.ts:534-541,686-688,797-798`; `ImportAdminRouter.ts:334-524,700-735`; `MajorImportPromotionUseCase.ts:45-81`.
- **Required Change:** Design and register P10 owner consumer for `MAJORS` handoffs and manual approved semantic promotion from staged source; validate source ownership/version/duplicate and replay idempotency, persist source/version, produce atomic audit/outbox and human-reviewed result. Confirm separate FEL path/fellowship compatibility. No implicit promotion simply from staging.
- **Architecture Constraints:** P6 is generic; Major semantic matching/creation remains P10-owned; deployment and DB mutation gated.
- **Do Not Change:** Disabled generic Phase6 `/promote` semantics; never auto-publish or invent missing Major IDs.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Approved staged record has discoverable P10 review/promote path; replay returns same result; crash/retry does not duplicate canonical identity/version; public remains hidden until explicit publication.
- **Required Tests:** DI handoff dispatch MAJORS, invalid payload/owner, duplicate, replay, transaction failure rollback, worker path in disposable authorized runtime.

### MAJOR-ADM-006 — Public DTO allowlist and profile-safe projection
- **Priority:** P1 / High (security/data contract).
- **Title:** Stop arbitrary optionalFields and internal metadata from escaping through public APIs.
- **Problem:** Both localized and legacy public projections spread optional fields and most of `MajorDto`, leaving arbitrary compatibility/admin keys externally serializable.
- **Evidence / Files:** `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:234-282`; `PublicMajorUseCases.ts:79-96`; `packages/domain/src/majors/majors.ts:182-215,266-272`.
- **Required Change:** Define explicit public DTO fields; sanitize profile child metadata, version/reviewer/source/internal relations; project only approved published information and documented public academic attributes. Reuse one projector for list/detail to avoid divergent exposure.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Preserve canonical publicId/slug, public profile scoping, localized display and review-approved content.
- **Do Not Change:** Admin full DTO or source audit retention; do not hide public educational fields by accident.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Injected optionalFields.privateNotes/sourceHash/adminMetadata are absent from both public list/detail; real public descriptions and degree are retained; never leak draft profile or source-only content.
- **Required Tests:** Public serialization allowlist, malicious optional field, published/draft sibling, localization, archived owner, snapshot pointer.

### MAJOR-ADM-007 — Respect global translation freeze while fixing editor contract
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Remove translation authoring controls that cannot currently save; define later gated workflow.
- **Problem:** Major PATCH and candidate approval schemas accept `localizedNameAr/En`, but `assertNoTranslationPayloadFields` throws while `TRANSLATION_CONTENT_MODE='INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY'`, and Major authoringAllowed=false.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminRouter.ts:51-62,80-83`; `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:84,367-369`; `packages/shared/src/localization/policy.ts:46-81,151-171`.
- **Required Change:** Align UI/API with the **current freeze**: read-only translated fields or explicit `TRANSLATION_CONTENT_AUTHORING_DISABLED`; later open a separate sanctioned content authoring package with owner-review, AR/EN parity and non-destructive storage. If source import carries localized names, distinguish authorized ingestion from editor authoring.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Global localization governance; don't bypass shared guard in P10.
- **Do Not Change:** Global translation mode or contentAuthoringAllowed without separate architectural authorization.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Editors cannot be misled by writeable frozen localized names; imported display still projects appropriately; later planned migration kept separate.
- **Required Tests:** Disabled payload negative; candidate API with/without localized fields; AR/EN projection and fallback; no policy bypass.

### MAJOR-ADM-008 — Published version supersession and audit semantics
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Make previous release lifecycle and rollback state explicit.
- **Problem:** Profile publication sets newest chosen version PUBLISHED and pointer; unpublish clears pointer but doesn't transition previously published version; later publish can leave multiple versions with PUBLISHED historic label.
- **Evidence / Files:** `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:203-238`; `schema.prisma:1927-1959,1961-1986`.
- **Required Change:** Define VERSION historical `wasPublished` vs `currentlyPublished` semantics; on replacement, supersede previous actual published release in one transaction, record supersededAt and reason. On unpublish set an explicit retired/revoked semantic or retain published history with clear non-current indicator. Do not silently overwrite history.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Profile `currentPublishedVersionId` remains read authority; audit/outbox includes old/new pointers.
- **Do Not Change:** Imported source hash or historical reviewed sections; no destructive version deletion.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Multi-release timeline distinguishes current/retired/superseded, public reads one pointer, rollback/republication requires new reviewed action.
- **Required Tests:** publish→unpublish→publish, 2 level profiles, old pointer correctness, transaction rollback, audit event metadata.

### MAJOR-ADM-009 — Show real current published version, not first element
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Correct version badge and editable working version choice.
- **Problem:** Admin marks `versions[0]` as current even if latest source import draft, and uses first version for section writes.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorDetailPage.tsx:619-638,675-700,1503-1521`; `MajorLevelProfile.currentPublishedVersionId` in `schema.prisma:1975-1986`.
- **Required Change:** Badge current publication by exact pointer; separately mark latest draft/working version; choose explicit version ID for edits, never assume row order; if no writable version, create reviewed draft workflow rather than writing to published content.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Preserve profile/version owner guard.
- **Do Not Change:** Version order/history as authoritative state; don't auto-clone published data without user-reviewed workflow.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** v2 draft does not label v2 as published when v1 pointer is current; edits always target declared working version and never published version.
- **Required Tests:** v1 current+v2 draft, v3 superseded, switching profiles, stale version selection, no-working-version UX.

### MAJOR-ADM-010 — Enrich and paginate source catalog within bounded limits
- **Priority:** P1 / High (performance/contract violation).
- **Title:** Apply filters/pagination before DB profile enrichment.
- **Problem:** Current catalog `listCatalog` loads all source and supplemental items, gathers codes from all, then makes one `findMany(code in all codes)` **before** user filters and page slice, contradicting read-model contract promising current-page enrichment.
- **Evidence / Files:** `Phase10CatalogRepository.ts:110-175,178-248`; `major-ownership-and-read-model-contract.md:17-23`.
- **Required Change:** Determine stable, filterable candidate window; apply source-only filters first; batch DB lookups only for current page (or for constrained additional predicate IDs where status filters require it); calculate accurate filtered total without unbounded profile hydration; use chunked and indexed lookups, avoid duplicate source/canonical IDs.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Preserve static source-catalog read model and canonical DB enrichment; don't hide real catalog gaps.
- **Do Not Change:** Source file order/IDs or PRISMA data; do not drop catalog as a shortcut.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Page 1 size 24 does not retrieve every catalog code; status/completeness filters and totals remain correct; source-only and DB-enriched rows labelled distinctly.
- **Required Tests:** Query-count and bounded-IN test (e.g. thousands of entries), multi-filter count, deterministic page ordering, source-only fallback and production-like catalog absence.

### MAJOR-ADM-011 — Explicit source-only records and promotion affordance
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Do not present `cat-*` source data as editable canonical Major.
- **Problem:** Admin default list includes static catalog; `getMajor('cat-*')` synthesizes a MajorDto and source profile when there is no canonical DB row. Canonical mutations do fail closed via `assertMutableCanonicalMajorId`, but UI still presents familiar edit/publish affordances.
- **Evidence / Files:** `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:68-73,239-278,476-481`; `Phase10CatalogRepository.ts:149-174`; `MajorAdminPage.tsx:176-198`; `MajorDetailPage.tsx:974-1098`.
- **Required Change:** Explicit `SOURCE_ONLY/NOT_CANONICAL` read-model flag; UI disables canonical edit/publish and routes to review, canonical link or approved promotion. Show source file + canonical linkage status; handle repository/catalog outage distinctly.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Keep workspace source catalog as provenance, Public still Prisma canonical.
- **Do Not Change:** Source files or automatic promotion rules.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Unlinked source card cannot publish/edit; linked source card navigates to actual DB owner; no deceptive “published” badge from catalog-only status.
- **Required Tests:** Source-only vs linked rendering; malicious POST cat-ID refused; missing catalog read model handled; link/promotion handoff.

### MAJOR-ADM-012 — Make section authoring locale- and identity-aware
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Prevent Arabic-only overwrite and multi-locale sectionKey collisions.
- **Problem:** UI editor state is keyed only by `sectionKey`, request omits `locale`, and repository new-section upsert hard-codes `locale:'ar'`; multilingual blocks with same key can share edit state or mutate the wrong locale.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorDetailPage.tsx:528-540,583-611,614-700`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:659-683`; `schema.prisma:2005-2026`; `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:390-419`.
- **Required Change:** Inside allowed authoring scope, identify `(profileId,versionId,sectionKey,locale)` plus section ID; make locale explicit and validated in API and persistence; version/owner scoping; while localization is frozen, do not unlock translation edits: show source locale and read-only other languages.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Respect global translation mode; review statuses and immutable published pointer.
- **Do Not Change:** P16 CMS content owner or existing EN source records.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Saving an Arabic block never updates English sibling; separate locale blocks display distinctly; unsupported new translated write rejected clearly under freeze.
- **Required Tests:** AR/EN same-key, section ID owner guard, unsupported locale, source-only catalog, published immutable.

### MAJOR-ADM-013 — Cross-domain ownership matrix for editorial and careers
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Stop creating P16/P21/P13 truth in P10 optional JSON.
- **Problem:** PATCH offers `description`, `studentFriendlySummary`, `careerOutcomes`, `typicalCourses`, `acquiredSkills`, etc. and persists them in P10 optionalFields; governance designates P16 owner of long-form editorial and P21 of labor-market truth; P13 of actual course truth.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminRouter.ts:99-110,282-302`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:168-200`; `docs/phases/phase-10-majors/major-ownership-and-read-model-contract.md:3-11`.
- **Required Change:** Field-level ownership table: P10 academic facts vs P16 editorial content vs P21 careers/job-market vs P13 courses, with explicit read projections/links. Deprecate new writes to duplicate owner-like legacy fields without breaking old published pages; plan migration only with gate.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Dependency direction; keep P10 academic identity independent from P16/P21 service availability.
- **Do Not Change:** Existing legacy content/translation flags without approved migration plan.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Newly edited P10 record cannot silently invent a job or course fact; public content reads owner projections once available; previous approved content does not disappear unnoticed.
- **Required Tests:** Contract field owner, rejected/deprecated field, public projection with unavailable downstream service, no P10→P21 persistence coupling.

### MAJOR-ADM-014 — Add optimistic concurrency and stable conflicts
- **Priority:** P1 / High.
- **Title:** Prevent stale editor last-write-wins on root, section and status flows.
- **Problem:** Basic update and section update contain no client expectedUpdatedAt/rowVersion CAS; transactions protect partial writes but alone do not prevent two independent stale editors.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminRouter.ts:80-111,196-240,277-330`; `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:367-396,411-475`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:168-200,610-707`.
- **Required Change:** Add scoped expected version / If-Match for editing; recheck status/version under lock, apply conditional update; return `409 CONFLICT` with sanitized current version; UI preserves dirty changes and lets reviewer reload/diff/merge.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Existing audited transaction, verified record ownership; do not enforce strong consistency via global locks.
- **Do Not Change:** Historical immutable published version; never auto-overwrite.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Two editors A/B: A saves, B stale fails 409 with no partial edit, audit/outbox no success for failed write.
- **Required Tests:** Concurrent root edit, 2 section edits, publish race, same-version retry, UI conflict integration (requires authorized DB for SQL race proof).

### MAJOR-ADM-015 — Source provenance and combined history workspace
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Surface actual MajorSource, changes and release provenance.
- **Problem:** Backend exposes `GET /:id/sources`, but details loader fetches profiles/aliases/relationships/mappings/versions, not sources; tab “Versions & Sources” displays versions only.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminRouter.ts:269-275`; `MajorDetailPage.tsx:455-466,1485-1541`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:860-886`.
- **Required Change:** RBAC-limited source evidence list: type/name/URI/hash/locale/importRef/profile, retrieval/review time (if available), plus sanitized actor/action timeline from existing audit and version releases. Add source freshness and stale policy only if evidence exists.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Read P10 and Audit truth, don't duplicate record history.
- **Do Not Change:** Raw importer evidence or historical audit records.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Reviewer identifies where a field was imported, by whom the content was published, and previous release; unavailable evidence clearly flagged.
- **Required Tests:** Sources route and detail panel; permission negative; timeline chronological/source link; no sensitive raw payload exposure.

### MAJOR-ADM-016 — Govern corrections of alias, relation and taxonomy mappings
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium (P1 if data reconciliation demands it).
- **Title:** Add owner-audited retire/supersede, not destructive freeform editing.
- **Problem:** Major Admin provides read APIs for aliases and relations and reviewed ADD taxonomy mapping, but no symmetric correction/retire route; UI renders stored aliases/relations read-only.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminRouter.ts:68-78,245-275`; `MajorDetailPage.tsx:1423-1483`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:708-856`.
- **Required Change:** Define governed create/retire/supersede actions with reason, evidence, owner/target validation, duplicate/self-link rejection and downstream impact where relevant. Prefer tombstone/history over hard-delete; distinguish canonical mapping from textual alias.
- **Architecture Constraints:** P8 canonical nodes immutable from P10; audit/outbox transaction.
- **Do Not Change:** Existing mapping facts or source identity automatically.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Incorrect alias/relation can be explicitly retired, no orphan/deleted historical evidence, admin read model reflects effective active version.
- **Required Tests:** Unauthorized correction, duplicate, cross-owner/self-link, archived/published owner, transaction rollback, audit reason.

### MAJOR-ADM-017 — Global Major dashboard statistics
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Replace page-local counters with bounded server aggregates.
- **Problem:** `published`, `needsReview`, `complete` computed from current `data.data` page, while `total` may represent the entire filtered catalog.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminPage.tsx:200-206,280-286`; `/admin/majors` list contract in `MajorAdminRouter.ts:29-42,113-120`.
- **Required Change:** Server count by status/completeness/domain and canonical vs source-only; clearly define filtered/global denominator and profile vs root counting semantics. Preserve paged grid.
- **Architecture Constraints:** No client fetching all rows for metrics.
- **Do Not Change:** Source catalog as independent from canonical DB counts.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Page 2 and page size change do not alter global published number; filters update count definitions explicitly.
- **Required Tests:** Multiple pages/status fixtures, root with 2 profiles, source-only vs DB, empty/error/loading.

### MAJOR-ADM-018 — Searchable existing-major picker for candidate resolution
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Replace manually typed existingMajorId with canonical chooser.
- **Problem:** `NewMajorCandidatesPanel` link flow requires technical ID, not a trustworthy search and compare workflow.
- **Evidence / Files:** `NewMajorCandidatesPanel.tsx:35-51,154-170,224-232`; `MajorAdminRouter.ts:64-66,153-160`.
- **Required Change:** Search canonical Major roots/profiles by localized title, code, alias, taxonomy; display degree compatibility and publication state; reviewer confirms selected ID and source resolution impacts before commit.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Reuse P10 canonical repository, not source-only catalog fake IDs; preserve human decision.
- **Do Not Change:** Candidate grouping key or auto-approve on textual similarity.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** No UUID copy required; wrong-degree or archived target is rejected with actionable feedback.
- **Required Tests:** picker search, duplicate-signal display, ambiguous names, permissions, link-negative and approved redirect.

### MAJOR-ADM-019 — Bound unresolved-candidate scans and prove atomic resolution
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium (escalate if scale/performance confirms issue).
- **Title:** Candidate queue query pagination and cross-domain rollback.
- **Problem:** `loadRows()` calls full unresolved University/Scholarship queries then groups/sorts/paginates in memory; `.resolve()` fans out University and Scholarship writes using Promise.all. It is wired to transaction-bound repos, but failure atomicity must be verified rather than assumed.
- **Evidence / Files:** `PrismaNewMajorCandidateRepository.ts:43-55,56-75,77-104,107-207,277-317`; `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:547-563`.
- **Required Change:** Design bounded candidate index or stable DB-backed groups with accurate distinct counts, provider-compatible filters; preserve transaction-bound writers and idempotent/source-specific CAS on resolutions.
- **Architecture Constraints:** No bulk auto-link of label groups; P11/P12 own their row truths.
- **Do Not Change:** Existing confirmed canonical links or University/Scholarship owners.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Massive unresolved queue returns bounded result and accurate `total`; injected mid-fanout failure rolls back all cross-domain writes.
- **Required Tests:** stress query/limit, stable page totals, concurrent resolution/retry, rollback with authorized disposable PostgreSQL, unresolved duplicate levels.

### MAJOR-ADM-020 — Server-side public Major discovery and stable cursor
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Avoid downloading every published major for one search.
- **Problem:** Public list query permits degree/taxonomy/cursor/limit but lacks `search` input, despite repository supporting search; frontend `loadPublishedMajors` collects all cursor pages then filters in browser.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorPublicRouter.ts:13-25`; `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:337-382`; `publicLiveDataSource.ts:509-511`; `MajorsSearchPage.tsx:67-100`.
- **Required Change:** Add validated `search` and selected filters to public list read API; implement debounced/bounded server search while keeping featured/cached views intentionally small; align profile-based cursor/order and counts.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Only published profile rows, no catalog/static fallback on API failure, locale-safe search.
- **Do Not Change:** Public route identity or bookmarked deep links.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** User finds a major without loading entire catalog; unpublished profile never appears in list/search; stable next cursor under a tie.
- **Required Tests:** Search AR/EN, deep pagination, draft exclusion, injection-like search strings, offline fallback unavailable state.

### MAJOR-ADM-021 — Keep partial errors and dirty-block edits visible
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Stop swallowing child API errors as empty data and reset-on-profile-swap.
- **Problem:** Detail loader turns aliases/profiles/relationships and content/versions request failures into empty arrays; `loadProfileData` clears all editedBlocks and dirty keys after network read; profile switching and reload can lose unsaved work.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorDetailPage.tsx:455-468,516-549,528-540,572-611`.
- **Required Change:** Per-panel `loading/empty/error/retry` separation, dirty-navigation guard for tab/profile/version/back, revision-conflict handling, accessible language-aware errors; keep unaffected panels visible on partial failures.
- **Architecture Constraints:** UI must not invent successful writes or bypass owner API.
- **Do Not Change:** Canonical profile selection and route IDs.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Failing versions API shows error, not “no versions”; dirty section preserved until explicit discard/save even if another profile selected.
- **Required Tests:** rejected promise panel states, profile switch unsaved guard, aborted request, screen-reader feedback.

### MAJOR-ADM-022 — Fellowship profile content template and bilingual grouping
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Apply correct approved section mapping for `FELLOWSHIP`.
- **Problem:** Admin section grouping implements BACHELOR/MASTER/DOCTORATE and defaults to Bachelor for unhandled FEL; public modal separately recognizes fellowship labels.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorDetailPage.tsx:197-281`; `MajorDetailModal.tsx:75-88`; `PublishedMajorSections.tsx:9-38`.
- **Required Change:** Add a deliberately approved Fellowship schema or neutral unassigned grouping until taxonomy specifies template; internationalized field headings should resolve from source template, not guess section meaning.
- **Architecture Constraints:** No invented majors or unverifiable headings.
- **Do Not Change:** Existing canonical catalog ordering or stored content IDs.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Fellowship profile never labelled with bachelor-specific sections; source section order and raw content remain intact.
- **Required Tests:** FEL and B/M/D grouping, unknown block rendering, Arabic/English layout, legacy headings.

### MAJOR-ADM-023 — Reasons, actor evidence and downstream impact on lifecycle
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Govern reject/unpublish/archive with recorded cause and impact warning.
- **Problem:** Routes call status mutation without reason payload; review UI confirms action only, despite P11/P12/P13 links and search/public side effects.
- **Evidence / Files:** `MajorAdminRouter.ts:332-378`; `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:449-473`; `schema.prisma:1908-1917`.
- **Required Change:** Request reason and optional replacement/evidence reference, show counts of linked university programs, scholarship targets, published courses and student usage through bounded read models; log reason in canonical audit/outbox; do not require browsing to unrelated P11 UI for basic impact.
- **Architecture Constraints:** Not every mutation requires full global fanout transaction; warn with availability qualifiers; don't change foreign domain rows unapproved.
- **Do Not Change:** Referential historic records or irreversible cascade.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Reviewer understands public/downstream impact and has audit trail explaining why action occurred; invalid state transition rejected.
- **Required Tests:** reason-required, target-specific status, audit metadata, downstream count unavailable warning, permissions.

### MAJOR-ADM-024 — Clarify aggregate vs per-profile publication pointer
- **Priority:** P2 / Medium.
- **Title:** Treat profile pointer as release authority for multi-level majors.
- **Problem:** `Major.currentPublishedVersionId` stores first found published profile version, which cannot represent multiple independently published profiles; current public paths correctly use profile pointer, but other consumers may misinterpret root pointer.
- **Evidence / Files:** `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:229-234,337-382`; `schema.prisma:1883-1905,1961-1986`; `LocalizedPublicMajorUseCases.ts:38-71`.
- **Required Change:** Document root field as representative-only/deprecated or explicit default profile pointer; enforce profile pointer as authoritative; verify P11/P12/P15 and graph consumers use correct scoped profile; align state events and release metadata.
- **Architecture Constraints:** No surprise slug/ID rewrite; no auto-publish sibling profiles.
- **Do Not Change:** Existing profile publication pointers or parent status without approved compatibility plan.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Two published profiles each return own version/content; root aggregate displays correct status without claiming one version represents both.
- **Required Tests:** Multi-profile publish/unpublish, default-profile deep link, cross-domain consumption contract, legacy root pointer compatibility.

## 09.7 Prioritized implementation sequence (not execution)

1. **P0 block:** MAJOR-ADM-001, 002, 003. Repair broken basic save and content review; prevent fake editable canonical identity; freeze any downstream “published” claims until regression tests exist.
2. **P1 source safety and domain consistency:** MAJOR-ADM-004, 006, 007, 012, 014. Explicit root/profile boundaries, public DTO allowlist, translation-freeze adherence, locale/owner section writes and CAS.
3. **P1 publication/import contract:** MAJOR-ADM-005, 008, 009, 010, 011, 013. Manual P6→P10 handoff, release lineage, catalog query boundedness, source-only semantics and P16/P21 ownership.
4. **P2 operator workflow:** MAJOR-ADM-015 through 024 as appropriate; can be batched only where contracts align. Avoid feature bloat and breaking imports.
5. **Cross-section review:** P8, P6, P11/P12, P13/P15, P16 and P21 impact guards. Source re-review before authorizing implementation, and disposable environment only after separate Database Mutation Gate.

## 09.8 Acceptance tests / test gaps

> **تم ترحيل مصفوفة الاختبارات/دليل التشغيل الأصلي كاملًا إلى «ملحق ما بعد 28»، البند `09.8`.** ليست هذه المصفوفة شرطًا لإغلاق إصلاح المصدر الآن. المرجع: سياسة الإغلاق السريع في بداية الملف.

- **التحقق الإلزامي الآن:** اختبارات unit/contract/security سريعة ومستهدفة لإصلاحات هذا القسم؛ تصحيح كل فشل ذي صلة، ثم تدوين Commit والنتيجة `CODE_CLOSED — RUNTIME_DEFERRED` عند تحقق المعايير.

## 09.9 Security / audit / outbox / ownership evaluation

- **Authentication / RBAC:** `apps/api/src/app.ts:746-755,789-791` enforces shared protected Admin surface and `admin:majors:manage`; hiding buttons in UI is never an authorization control. A more granular `view/edit/review/publish/retire` permission split is recommended only after reviewing identity design (CROSS-09-01), not assumed implemented.
- **Validation:** routes use Zod for accepted fields but many compatibility fields remain unconstrained strings or arbitrary JSON; `MajorAdminRouter.ts:80-111,196-208` should validate strict/public-safe/owner-specific schema and HTTP semantics. New official/source links require a scheme allowlist (`https:` where appropriate) and safe external link behavior; do not build a server-side URL fetcher without SSRF policy.
- **Horizontal / vertical access:** `PrismaMajorRepository.ts:615-644` blocks foreign content section IDs. Any new alias/profile/relationship endpoint must use equivalent owner and permission checks, and avoid cross-owner profile hijacking.
- **Transactions / audit:** `AdminMajorUseCases.ts:566-572` uses atomic coordinator; `AtomicDomainMutationCoordinator.ts:30-64` and `AtomicAuditedOutboxMutationExecutor.ts:18-29` write business+audit+outbox atomically *when configured*. DI includes coordinator (`container.ts:607-613,686-688`). Runtime delivery/retry remains unproven and cannot be inferred from source alone. Do not create duplicate ad-hoc audit calls that generate false success records.
- **Public exposure:** Any major that is not a published profile with valid published pointer must remain absent from read APIs and search. Projection must not serialize raw `optionalFields`, `sources`, `versions` or private graph metadata by default.
- **Race / idempotency:** Root/content updates need CAS; P6 handoff and candidate cross-domain resolution need retry-safe transaction scenarios. No DB worker or write can be executed without separate authorization.

> **تم ترحيل مصفوفة الاختبارات/دليل التشغيل الأصلي كاملًا إلى «ملحق ما بعد 28»، البند `09.10`.** ليست هذه المصفوفة شرطًا لإغلاق إصلاح المصدر الآن. المرجع: سياسة الإغلاق السريع في بداية الملف.

- **التحقق الإلزامي الآن:** اختبارات unit/contract/security سريعة ومستهدفة لإصلاحات هذا القسم؛ تصحيح كل فشل ذي صلة، ثم تدوين Commit والنتيجة `CODE_CLOSED — RUNTIME_DEFERRED` عند تحقق المعايير.

## 09.11 Definition of Done (post-Codex, not today)

> **تفسير 2026-10-09:** بنود الاختبارات التشغيلية والـE2E أدناه أصبحت Post-28 وليست شرط `CODE_CLOSED`؛ راجع السياسة المعتمدة أعلاه. يمنع الادعاء بأنها نُفذت دون دليل.


- [ ] Basic Major save method and payload agree with server; no phantom canonical-name edit.
- [ ] Content review lifecycle is separate from completeness; APPROVED blocks can publish; unreviewed blocked.
- [ ] Root Major vs each Level Profile vs Version have distinct owner-validated edit workflows and stable public IDs.
- [ ] Correct AR/EN section projection, no locale overwrite, translation authoring freeze respected until separately authorized.
- [ ] Published profile read uses explicit immutable current version; previous/superseded history explained; source-only catalog never becomes Public truth.
- [ ] Public Major DTO has strict allowlist and rejects arbitrary internal JSON.
- [ ] P6→P10 handoff is connected only through approved manual owner workflow; retry/idempotency and outbox proven.
- [ ] Canonical P8 DegreeLevel/Taxonomy and source evidence validated; mixed free text cannot override canonical IDs.
- [ ] No P10 authoritative CMS/career/jobs/course duplicates created contrary to ownership contracts.
- [ ] Catalog enrichment and candidate discovery bounded; global stats accurate; profile cursor/search stable.
- [ ] Aliases, academic relations, source history, lifecycle reason/impact and “new candidate” picker usable by admins without technical IDs.
- [ ] Auth + negative RBAC + validation + concurrency + audit/outbox tests pass; draft never leaks on public list/detail/search.
- [ ] Approved runtime E2E demonstrates profile publication/unpublication and consistent downstream relationships, with applicable explicit Database Mutation Gate.
- [ ] Regression evidence and final re-review recorded; section remains REVIEWED (not CLOSED) until then.

## 09.12 Do Not Do

- **DO NOT** push, commit, edit GitHub main, alter production data, run `db push`, `migrate dev`, reset, destructive seed, backfill, import, unapproved workers or historic migration edits.
- **DO NOT** call canonical source catalog a database catalog, delete it or publish source-only `cat-*` records.
- **DO NOT** move P8 DegreeLevel or Taxonomy ownership into P10; do not add unrelated degrees outside four-profile compatibility contract.
- **DO NOT** disable translation freeze to make an edit button pass. Treat authoring as a separately approved cross-section work package.
- **DO NOT** auto-merge or auto-publish imported or candidate majors; human review, evidence, identity and publication controls remain required.
- **DO NOT** turn P10 into the owner of P16 editorial, P21 labor-market or P13 course truth; projections are not ownership.
- **DO NOT** leak arbitrary optional JSON, source hashes or internal audit metadata via public read model.
- **DO NOT** overwrite reviewed/published versions, delete source provenance or rewrite stable profile codes to fix UI.
- **DO NOT** claim PostgreSQL transactions/indexes/runtime workflows are proven by source tests alone.

# 10 — Universities & Institutions / P11 — Admin ↔ Public Deep Source Review

> **معيار الإغلاق المحدّث للقسم 10:** إصلاح الأكواد والثغرات والنواقص + اختبارات source/contract/security خفيفة مستهدفة + رفع Commit. **لا يلزم هنا E2E حي أو قاعدة بيانات/مزود تشغيل فعلي**؛ اختبارات التشغيل في الملحق الأخير بعد القسم 28، مع بقاء إطلاق الإنتاج محظورًا دون أدلته.
> **الاختبار الأساسي المختصر:** Universities: ملكية الجامعة/البرنامج والعلاقات الأكاديمية وصلاحية النشر وخصوصية العقود.


> **Date:** 2026-10-08. **Scope:** review only; no code fixes or DB/network mutations. **Execution Truth:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-`, branch `main`, commit `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca`. **Architectural authority:** constitution → Roadmap v6 → ADRs → domain specs → governance documents. **Review classification:** 🟢 verified source control; 🟡 improvement; 🔴 source-confirmed defect; ⚪ RUNTIME PENDING. These symbols do not claim successful browser/DB tests.

## 10.1 Scope, Product / Functional Completeness & Overall Verdict

**Product purpose:** manage canonical international University/Institution identities (`INS-*`) and institutional profiles: location, campus, internal schools/departments, academic programs, Degree Levels, mapped Majors, test-based admissions, languages, tuition and accommodation, rankings, accreditation, international admissions, source provenance, publication and localized public discovery. Primary actors are editors, institutional-data verifiers, admissions/content reviewers, and publishing administrators; students consume published profiles and program links. **The university is not the owner of P7 geography, P8 degree/taxonomy, P9 tests, P10 major identities, P12 scholarship authority, or P16 editorial content.**

**End-to-end expected:** ingest/source verification → canonical identity/dedup review → resolve country/region/city → curate campuses/organization units and programs → resolve Degree/Major/Test relationships and review evidence → verify completeness/source freshness → submit for review → approve → publish coherent read model → public AR/EN search/detail → downstream universities/majors/scholarships/student tools → unpublish/archive when warranted. No implicit bulk auto-publish.

**Overall verdict: 🔴 REVIEWED — CRITICAL FIXES REQUIRED.** The module has a substantive normalized domain, two admin surfaces, controlled program upsert/archive, normalized relations, a publication-readiness policy, production-bound permission middleware, and transactional Audit+Outbox coordinator. Its public paths reject non-`PUBLISHED` university roots and filter non-`ACTIVE` programs. But live updates to published institutional information, pre-transaction publish checks, and the dangerous `replaceNormalizedDetails` program-replacement path require remediation before calling the flow enterprise-safe. The admin list additionally mis-filters valid server search results, while multiple child records lack a revision/conflict workflow and program test requirements can reference unpublished canonical Tests.

**Current product functions established in source (do not mark absent):**

- `apps/admin/src/pages/UniversityAdminPage.tsx:53-185,200-639`: list, search, status/completeness filter, country deep link, accurate *server-total* overview counts (five bounded count requests), loading/error/429 handling, page navigation, import entry point.
- `apps/admin/src/pages/UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:74-285` and `apps/admin/src/components/UniversitySectionsEditor.tsx:12-95,218-347`: canonical location pickers, profile sections, individually saved programs with Degree/Major/Test and campuses, review/readiness and publish/unpublish buttons; translation write path is deliberately frozen.
- `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/UniversityAdminRouter.ts:30-430`: owner API for listing, profile update, translations (guarded), normalized details, programs, readiness and lifecycle.
- `packages/application/src/universities/use-cases/AdminUniversityUseCases.ts:36-290`: application use cases with managed Audit/Outbox coordinator; `packages/infrastructure/src/universities/PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:92-864`: Prisma implementation.
- `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/UniversityPublicRouter.ts:16-55`, `packages/application/src/universities/use-cases/LocalizedPublicUniversityUseCases.ts:17-37`, `apps/web/src/features/public-template/publicLiveDataSource.ts:118-165,505-507`: canonical published list/detail → localized projection → live web.

**Maturity comparison (selective, not feature-copying):** Borrow the identity and provenance discipline common to institutional registries, the verifiable programs/admission structure of university directories, and editorial draft-to-publish controls of mature content management systems. DO NOT implement applications/enrolments, rankings crawlers, live fee quoting, payments, an independent accreditation authority or custom student CRMs inside P11. Immediate necessities are safe publishing, record/version conflict protection, managed source evidence, accurate admin search, and typed canonical filters. Advanced analytics and bulk editing are deferred until core invariants pass.

## 10.3 Evidence-backed findings grouped by severity

### P0 — immediate publication and data safety

**UNI-ADM-001 🔴 P0 — Published University profile can be edited in place.** `AdminUniversityUseCases.updateUniversity` rejects only country/region/city relationship updates while `status=PUBLISHED`; it permits displayName, officialWebsite, description via optionalFields, contacts, logo and other current-profile changes (`AdminUniversityUseCases.ts:89-125`; `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:50-75,277-325`). The public list/detail use that same current `University` data (`LocalizedPublicUniversityUseCases.ts:17-37`; `PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:363-385`). Result: already published profiles may expose unreviewed edits with no new publication approval. The root has no `currentPublishedVersionId` field in Prisma (`schema.prisma:1218-1264`). **Remedy:** draft/review/publication revision contract, or strict unpublish→edit→reapprove while a publication snapshot is designed; preserve stable INS-/slug identity and audit.

**UNI-ADM-002 🔴 P0 — Publish/readiness TOCTOU across transactions.** `AdminUniversityUseCases.markReadyToPublish`/`publish` obtains `getUniversity()` and evaluates status/completeness/policy before `this.mutate(...)`; inside the coordinator callback it calls only `repository.updateStatus` (`AdminUniversityUseCases.ts:209-245`, `PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:241-246`). No locked re-read, compare-and-set `READY_TO_PUBLISH`, persisted revision, or invariant recheck in the write boundary. A racing update or unpublish can invalidate the checked state. **Remedy:** re-read under lock or conditional update inside the same audited transaction, assert policy against current row+active relationships, return explicit conflict, and enforce single publication action.

**UNI-ADM-003 🔴 P0 — Normalized bulk replacement deletes stable AcademicProgram identities.** `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:327-336` exposes `PUT /:id/normalized-details` accepting `academicPrograms`. `PrismaUniversityRepository.replaceNormalizedDetails` executes `universityAcademicProgram.deleteMany({universityId})` whenever that array is included and creates new records (`PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:653-677,765-807`). This route contradicts the safe dedicated `upsertAcademicProgram`/archive ID-preserving routes (`:570-648`), can cascade test requirements/campus links and undermine scholarship/cross-domain program references. **Remedy:** prohibit academic-program replacement in the generic section PUT; provide reviewed, transactional, identity-preserving diff operations with explicit archive semantics. Require separate DB Mutation Gate before any repair/backfill; NEVER delete existing production records as a review action.

### P1 — correctness / security / workflow

**UNI-ADM-004 🔴 P1 — Draft/unpublished Test references can be exposed as approved admission requirements.** `UniversityCanonicalRelationshipValidator.validateTest` only blocks `ARCHIVED` and `REJECTED` Tests and checks variant/version ownership (`UniversityCanonicalRelationshipValidator.ts:137-158`), not `PUBLISHED`/`isPubliclyVisible` or approved published version. An admin may mark a requirement `ACTIVE`, and the university public projection copies active requirements with Test IDs/name/status (`ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:198-209`, `PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:27-31,890-902`). Readiness checks existence of IDs, not published source status (`UniversityPublicationReadinessPolicy.ts:41-46`). **Remedy:** validate published, publicly visible Test and compatible published version at *publish time* and sanitize/filter public DTO accordingly; keep genuine draft candidate requirements internal until reviewed.

**UNI-ADM-005 🔴 P1 — Public University projection is allowlist-incomplete.** `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.projectUniversity` spreads `...sanitizeUniversityOptionalFields(optionalFields), ...publicData` into public output (`ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:162-182`), and nested `academicPrograms`/requirements carry `metadata`, internal owner and source mapping IDs (`PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:877-905`). Filters omit root `sourceRecords` but do not use a strict public field whitelist. There is an equivalent projection in `PublicUniversityUseCases.ts:33-67`. **Remedy:** one explicit, typed, shared public DTO mapper (allowed keys per nested entity) excluding operational provenance, reviewer comments, unapproved metadata and internal cross-domain identifiers; regression test negative and locale cases. Do not remove canonical cross-platform link IDs required by public graph.

**UNI-ADM-006 🔴 P1 — Search can hide correct backend matches.** Backend `PrismaUniversityRepository.list` matches `canonicalName`, slug, `publicId` and translated names (`:277-285`), but `UniversityAdminPage.tsx:175-185` filters returned page AGAIN using only displayName/country/city. Searching INS IDs, canonical English names or approved translation may return a nonzero total yet show the page as empty; pagination/count become misleading. **Remedy:** render server-returned page directly, with server-side query as single truth; optionally show matched-field metadata later.

**UNI-ADM-007 🔴 P1 — Requirement child identity is destroyed on normal program edits.** `PrismaUniversityRepository.upsertAcademicProgram` deletes all `universityProgramAdmissionRequirement` rows for the program and recreates them on every save (`:570-634`), even unchanged rows. This replaces canonical requirement IDs, source audit continuity and any downstream references and turns a small edit into a full replacement. **Remedy:** key by the existing requirement ID or stable composite (with ownership and version guards), diff add/update/archive, and retain IDs for semantically unchanged rows; dedicated tests for campus update without touching requirements.

**UNI-ADM-008 🔴 P1 — No University/version optimistic-concurrency contract.** Admin editor posts changes without `expectedVersion`/`If-Match`; program editor sends an entire array of requirements and campuses (`UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:130-180`) and repository uses last-write-wins updates, without a caller-supplied revision (`PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:180-238,570-634`; `schema.prisma:1218-1244,1322-1335`). **Remedy:** add a stable revision/`updatedAt` precondition for both root and each mutable program; 409 Conflict, refresh+diff UI, tests for two editors. Migration planning only; runtime DB mutation gated.

**UNI-ADM-009 🔴 P1 — Geographic admin edits do not enforce a complete canonical active location on every change.** `UniversityCanonicalRelationshipValidator.validateCampus` checks country/region/city IDs for existence and consistency when present (`:21-59`) but can accept location-less updates, and `AdminUniversityUseCases.updateUniversity` computes completeness with textual location fields (`:105-125`) rather than an active canonical resolver. On publish, readiness checks country presence and city requirement only conditionally (`UniversityPublicationReadinessPolicy.ts:25-30`). **Remedy:** ensure current country/region/city state is active, consistent and reviewed inside publish transaction; source geographic review must remain explicit. Keep legacy source-text as evidence, never identity.

**UNI-ADM-010 🔴 P1 — Official web links accept non-HTTP schemes.** `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:50-75` validates official website/source and URLs with generic `z.string().url()` without `http/https` scheme allowlist. Public UI uses `websiteUrl` as `href` (`publicLiveDataSource.ts:151-158`, `UniversityDetailModal.tsx:205-208`) and several official links as external anchors. **Remedy:** normalized HTTPS/HTTP allowlist and explicit external-link safety for all owner-produced public URLs; block javascript/data/file/custom scheme, sanitize pre-existing sources with a non-mutating report; require evidence for official status.

**UNI-ADM-011 🟡 P1 — Publication readiness does not validate all important current publication facts.** Current policy enforces status, completeness, INS ID, country, conditional city, basic program Degree/Major fields and Test IDs (`UniversityPublicationReadinessPolicy.ts:7-49`). It does not require verified official source freshness for critical student-facing tuition/rankings or validate cross-domain Test visibility; fee periods and currency references are not evaluated. **Remedy:** scoped blockers for canonical/published-link failures, warnings for optional nonessential profiles and stale financial/ranking evidence, audited reviewer override policy only where governance allows; avoid blanket requirements for every optional dataset.

**UNI-ADM-012 🔴 P1 — Finance-like metadata can be stored without P7 canonical currency validation.** `normalizedDetailsSchema` accepts arbitrary `currencyCode` for tuition/accommodation (`UniversityAdminRouter.ts:175-209`) and `replaceNormalizedDetails` passes it to Prisma without resolving `currencyReferenceId` (`PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:810-847`), although schema supports reference foreign keys (`schema.prisma:1387-1426`). **Remedy:** resolve active P7 currency per code, reject code-ID mismatch, attach canonical reference (no payment execution), and include currency/time-window validation tests. CROSS-10-01 (P11↔P7).

**UNI-ADM-013 🟡 P1 — Admin cannot add campus/organization unit through its sections editor.** `UniversitySectionsEditor.tsx:30-51` omits `canAdd` for both structural collections, while tuition, accommodation and rankings can add rows; page has no comparable managed create flow for campus/school. Operators must rely on source import or technical API manipulation. **Remedy:** structured create/archive UI with canonical geography and hierarchy pickers, preserving stable IDs; avoid manual JSON/technical UUID entry and reuse the same owner use cases.

**UNI-ADM-014 🟡 P1 — Source/history review inadequate for an institutional registry.** `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:229-283` exposes readiness, location, sections and programs, but no dedicated Source Evidence/History review (sources are included by repository), no reviewed diff or source validity/freshness decision, and no last-verification source badge on the admin list. **Remedy:** add one Source & Change History tab with source artifact URL, hash, retrieved/verified times, reviewer, conflicts and non-destructive source comparison; require no new crawler or import auto-promotion.

**UNI-ADM-015 🟡 P1 — Import stages and release gate must be made administratively explicit.** P6 University handoff is registered, returns staged review only (`UniversityImportHandoffService.ts:48-116`, `container.ts:534-540,682-683`); `UniversityImportPromotionUseCase.ts:8-19` intentionally always rejects bulk automatic promotion. Separately, `PrismaUniversityImportChangeExecutorGateway.ts:16-104,518-565` supports transactional reviewed change sets and rollback. **Not proof of missing functionality**: the safety gate is deliberate. **Required:** expose a trustworthy capabilities/read-only gate status and a traceable approval process for one pilot; do not wire bulk source ingestion to writes merely to eliminate the REJECTED result. Execution remains RUNTIME PENDING until separately approved DB Mutation Gate. CROSS-10-02 (P11↔P6).

**UNI-ADM-016 🟡 P1 — Public performance: full normalized graph fetched per page item.** `PrismaUniversityRepository.ts:27-37` defines `universityDetails` with campuses, units, all programs with admission tests, fees, accommodation, rankings, sourceRecords, translations and localizedTexts; `listPublished` uses it for up to 100 universities (`:363-385`). This is bounded in parent count but unbounded by children per parent and retrieves internal source data only to discard it. **Remedy:** summary-specific `select` with bounded child aggregations, separate detail-only graph, supporting query plans/indexes after approved runtime; no N+1 and no full sourceRecords for public list.

### P2 — useful but not blockers

**UNI-ADM-017 🟡 P2 — No first-class sort and richer canonical list filters.** Admin list offers status, completeness, search and deep-link country, but no visible region/city/institution type/source-age sort (`UniversityAdminPage.tsx:387-467`; router only partially exposes canonical filters `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:30-39`). Introduce selected canonical region/city, institution type and `lastVerifiedAt` only if grounded in owner data; default stable server sort.

**UNI-ADM-018 🟡 P2 — Missing safe batch actions and export of reviewed list.** There are no clearly exposed multi-select verified mark-review/archive/export actions on the admin list (`UniversityAdminPage.tsx:495-639`). Add *only* bounded authorized batch actions with per-item result and audit, never batch auto-publish or silently merge identities. Defer bulk actions if P0/P1 unfinished.

**UNI-ADM-019 🟡 P2 — University list is client-side re-requested on each keystroke.** `UniversityAdminPage.tsx:139-145,395-396` sends server searches on every `searchTerm` change, risking spiky API traffic and 429 with no debounce. Add 250–400 ms debounce/cancel and preserve server pagination; `listRequest` counter prevents stale commits but doesn't cancel outbound requests.

**UNI-ADM-020 🟡 P2 — UI claims public link without ensuring root published.** `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:271` offers 'عرض الجامعة في الصفحة العامة' for any record with a slug, although public detail correctly 404s if status is not PUBLISHED (`LocalizedPublicUniversityUseCases.ts:28-37`). Show link only for published roots; allow explicitly authenticated preview separately.

**UNI-ADM-021 🟡 P2 — No explicit pagination strategy for globally large public catalog in browser UX.** Web loads all cursor pages (`publicLiveDataSource.ts:505-507`) and `UniversitiesSearchPage.tsx:106-147,393-491` filters/render-maps results in memory. Preserve bounded canonical public API, but introduce progressive/cursor-backed discovery, accessible pagination and large-list performance proof before global rollout; never fake totals.

**UNI-ADM-022 🟡 P2 — Backend error contract collapses distinct failures into 400.** `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:433-443` maps generic use-case errors to 400, including missing entities, publish conflicts, disabled translation content and transactional unavailable states. Define 404/409/422/403/503 typed errors, keep sanitized production messages; UI should distinguish conflict, validation and retry cases without leaking details.

**UNI-ADM-023 🟡 P2 — Tests do not yet cover cross-layer enterprise invariants.** Existing tests verify component use cases, HTTP validation, canonical relationships, source stage, and mocked atomic pilot, but do not prove in one integrated PostgreSQL/browser run: published-root edit isolation, concurrent publish/edit, identity preservation under normalized replacement, active published-test admission visibility, query/result parity or full AR/EN read. Do not equate existence of `*.spec.ts` with those verified behaviors.

- **DO NOT** modify GitHub, push/commit, edit historic migrations, use `db push`, `migrate dev/reset`, seed, import, delete/backfill records, run data-changing workers or access secrets as part of this review.

- **DO NOT** solve identity problems by recreating `INS-*`, University IDs, AcademicProgram IDs, admission test links, or scholarship joins.

**Inventory التفصيلي:** `UniversityAdminPage.tsx` (list, country/status/completeness/search, stats, import link); `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx` (canonical location, campuses, programmes, degree/major/test requirements, lifecycle); `UniversitySectionsEditor.tsx` (identity/campuses/tuition/admissions/accreditations).
**موجود ويجب عدم تكراره:** توجد الجامعات/programmes/campuses/organization units/tuition/admission tests/normalized sections والنشر؛ الفلاتر الجذرية وتصحيحات API/حالات النشر موثقة في 10.
**معيار مقارنة منضبط:** DAAD programme directory / UCAS and Studyportals — programme-level subject, degree, language, location, intake/deadline and study-mode filters. لا يستدعي ذلك بناء CRM مستقل.
**مصادر المقارنة الخارجية:** [www.daad.de](https://www.daad.de/en/studying-in-germany/universities/all-degree-programmes/)؛ [www.ucas.com](https://www.ucas.com/explore/search/courses-beta). هذه benchmarks لا تثبت نقص المشروع بحد ذاتها؛ الدليل هو مسار Source الموضّح بكل مهمة.
**حد تبنّي المقارنة:** نقلنا: program-level filters، لغة الدراسة، مدة البرنامج، نمط الدراسة، موعد التقديم المخصّص للفئة؛ لا حاجة الآن إلى ranking تجاري أو نظام قبول/دفع خارجي كامل.
**قرار التسجيل:** جميع المهام أدناه نواقص **جديدة غير مكررة** في سجل هذا القسم، مع فصل `CONFIRMED_UI_GAP` (غياب وظيفة في الصفحات ومسارات المصدر المفحوصة) عن `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED` (تحسين مطلوب وليس bug مثبت). لا تعيد فتح أخطاء المراجعة الأصلية؛ اتبع أرقامها.

### الفجوات والمهام القابلة للتنفيذ — شرط قبول مستقل لكل مهمة

#### FGA-10-001 — P1 — فهرس إداري قابل للتصفية لكل البرامج الجامعية عبر الجامعات

- **الحالة والتفسير:** `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED`؛ أهمية P1 وظيفية/معلوماتية بحسب الأثر، وليست إعلان ثغرة أمنية مؤكدة إلا إن أثبت اختبار مستقل ذلك.
- **دليل الكود الحالي:** `UniversityAdminPage.tsx:74-77,114-118,387-450` يفلتر جامعات root فقط؛ `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:270-284` يعرض برامج جامعة واحدة؛ `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:29-49,229-245` يقدّم university/organization-unit list، ولا يقدّم listAcademicPrograms عبر جميع الجامعات؛ `schema.prisma:1322-1345` يحفظ program→major/degree/university.
- **حالة الاستخدام وسبب الحاجة:** استخراج كل برامج الماجستير الطبية في تركيا التي تتطلب IELTS أو مرتبطة بمنح، بغض النظر عن الجامعة.
- **الإصلاح التقني المحدد:** Owner P11 يقدم cursor/page query على UniversityAcademicProgram بmajorId, degreeLevelId, countryReferenceId, region/city, internationalTestId, programStatus, parentStatus; مع partial joins/P12 summarized links وexplicit missing mapping، وواجهة Programs tab مستقلة عن University list.
- **Acceptance + negative/regression:** 10000+ program fixtures تُصفّى server-side مع total/cursor مستقر؛ نتائج programme واحد لا تضاعَف بسبب test/campus joins؛ صلاحيات Admin تحافظ على draft، Public published-only؛ روابط تفصيل الجامعة والبرنامج صحيحة.
- **الأقسام المتأثرة:** P7 / P8 / P9 / P10 / P11 / P12 / Public / Student.

#### FGA-10-002 — P1 — سجل قبول Intake/Application Window لكل برنامج مع المواعيد بحسب شريحة المتقدم

- **الحالة والتفسير:** `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED`؛ أهمية P1 وظيفية/معلوماتية بحسب الأثر، وليست إعلان ثغرة أمنية مؤكدة إلا إن أثبت اختبار مستقل ذلك.
- **دليل الكود الحالي:** `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:273-284` يحرر program status/major/degree/test فقط؛ `UniversityAdminRouter.ts:92-114` يعرّف program authoring دون intake/deadline typed؛ `schema.prisma:1322-1345` فيه metadata Json لكن لا model أو تاريخ admissionCycle canonical.
- **حالة الاستخدام وسبب الحاجة:** برنامج ماجستير يفتح قبول سبتمبر 2027 بموعد مختلف للطالب غير الأوروبي؛ لا يمكن الاكتفاء بحقل نص عام في `internationalAdmissions` للجامعة كلها.
- **الإصلاح التقني المحدد:** Entity/DTO UniversityProgramIntake (programId, intakeStart, applicationOpen/Close, applicantSegment, timezone, sourceEvidence, verificationStatus, status) مع validation date ranges وعدم الخلط مع Scholarship deadlines؛ إشعارات وتفاصيل Public/Student تستمد من owner.
- **Acceptance + negative/regression:** موعدان لطلاب محليين ودوليين يظهران صحيحين وتغلق النافذة حسب المنطقة الزمنية؛ نافذة منتهية لا تعرض open؛ direct API يمنع closing<opening؛ تغيّر الموعد يرسل event يخضع idempotency.
- **الأقسام المتأثرة:** P11 / P12 Scholarships / Student Tracker / Notifications.

#### FGA-10-003 — P1 — متطلبات ولغة وشكل الدراسة على مستوى البرنامج وليس الجامعة كلها

- **الحالة والتفسير:** `NEW_FEATURE_REQUIRED`؛ أهمية P1 وظيفية/معلوماتية بحسب الأثر، وليست إعلان ثغرة أمنية مؤكدة إلا إن أثبت اختبار مستقل ذلك.
- **دليل الكود الحالي:** `UniversitySectionsEditor.tsx:115-122,238-266,386-396` يحرر internationalAdmissions على مستوى الجامعة؛ `UniversityRelationshipEditorPage.tsx:273-284` يحرر degree/major/test/campus فقط؛ `schema.prisma:1322-1345` يعتمد metadata Json للبرنامج بلا structured language/studyMode/duration/entryEligibility fields.
- **حالة الاستخدام وسبب الحاجة:** جامعة تقدم بكالوريوس الطب بالصينية وماجستير الذكاء الاصطناعي بالإنجليزية؛ الفلترة بلغة الجامعة العامة تعطي للطالب تطابقًا خاطئًا.
- **الإصلاح التقني المحدد:** Program-level typed/canonical languageIds (P7), studyMode, teachingDelivery, durationUnit/value وeligibility rule provenance بvalidation، مع unknown state بدل false/no؛ تحديث UniversityPublic/Student search projections ومنع draft leakage.
- **Acceptance + negative/regression:** فلتر الإنجليزية يعيد البرنامج الإنجليزي دون الطب الصيني؛ مستويات الدرجة والدولة سليمة؛ unknown language لا يُعرض كEnglish؛ Student eligibility يأخذ متطلبات البرنامج وليس global university.
- **الأقسام المتأثرة:** P7 Languages / P9 Tests / P10 Majors / Public / Student.

### شروط إعادة مراجعة هذا القسم

1. راجع جميع الصفحات/التبويبات المذكورة وكل نتيجة من API في source+browser عند توفر runtime؛ لا يعتبر وجود زر وحده نجاحًا.
2. افحص search/filter/sort/paging/bulk مقابل owner API؛ أية عملية جماعية جديدة يجب أن تحمل permission وdry-run وversion/conflict checks، ولا تطبق bulk بلا حاجة.
3. اختبر loading, empty, partial failures, denied RBAC, duplicate/concurrent operations، اللغة العربية/الإنجليزية، وعدم كشف مسودات Public أو بيانات Student الخاصة.
4. لا توسع نطاق Domain أو API بلا اختبارات contract، ولا تعدّل قاعدة إنتاج أو ملفات تطبيق ضمن هذه المراجعة.

# 11 — Scholarships / P12 — Admin ↔ P6 ↔ Canonical Links ↔ Public Deep Source Review

> **معيار الإغلاق المحدّث للقسم 11:** إصلاح الأكواد والثغرات والنواقص + اختبارات source/contract/security خفيفة مستهدفة + رفع Commit. **لا يلزم هنا E2E حي أو قاعدة بيانات/مزود تشغيل فعلي**؛ اختبارات التشغيل في الملحق الأخير بعد القسم 28، مع بقاء إطلاق الإنتاج محظورًا دون أدلته.
> **الاختبار الأساسي المختصر:** Scholarships: قواعد أهلية الطالب وحالات النشر، عدم كشف المحتوى الداخلي، owner references وفشل آمن.


> **Branch / immutable evidence baseline:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-` — `main` @ `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca` (reviewed 2026-10-08). **SOURCE ONLY**: لا توجد تجربة تشغيل DB/Web، ولا إثبات state production؛ جميع نتائج runtime موسومة `RUNTIME PENDING`. هذا القسم إضافة إلى الملف ذاته، ولا يُعيد فتح 01–10.

## 11.1 Executive finding / نطاق الحكم

**الحكم:** `REVIEWED — CRITICAL FIXES REQUIRED`. توجد بنية قوية لقسم P12 أكثر نضجًا من CRUD: `Scholarship` domain يفصل `status`, `verificationStatus`, `publicationStatus`؛ نموذج normalized للمنحة والمزايا والأهلية والوثائق والجامعة/البرنامج والمصدر والإصدارات والدورات، وUniversal P6 handoff + source registry + screening/dedup/canonical resolution + import-center atomic transfer + Business Audit/Outbox + public cursor read + Catalog Detail/Admin relationship editor. لكن هذه البنية لا تساوي readiness إنتاجية دون معالجة findings أدناه.

**Critical verified risks:** cross-domain P6 source-status mutation تحت Permission المنح، unscoped legacy P6 imported-records read، Public Scholarship nested DTO leakage، عدم استخدام published version snapshot في public reads، سباق state check→publish، وفجوة مسار verification للمنح اليدوية. **Do not conflate** Source Code proof with confirmed exploitation; 403/500 outcomes and concurrency effects require isolated integration/runtime tests.

**Task count:** 30 (`P0` = 6، `P1` = 15، `P2` = 9). Priorities are remediation order and risk ranking, not assertions that production data were compromised.

These are acceptance dimensions—not mandates for payments, applicant-CRM, visa workflows, speculative AI scoring, or scraping beyond P6.

## 11.4 Architectural good parts to **preserve**

- 🟢 `PUBLISHED` read requires `publicationStatus=PUBLISHED` and `verificationStatus=VERIFIED` in Prisma list/detail, not merely workflow status (`PrismaScholarshipRepository.ts:102-106,438-442`).
- 🟢 Admin generic PATCH and canonical replacement reject when publicationStatus PUBLISHED (`AdminScholarshipUseCases.ts:190-197,230-239`).
- 🟢 Import handoff does **not auto-promote or auto-publish**, and AtomicTransfer is designed around one transaction for P6 record + P12 mutation + business audit + outbox (`ScholarshipImportAtomicTransferUseCase.ts:90-100,170-258`).
- 🟢 `source allow origins` + paths/rate policy exist at `ScholarshipSourceScopePolicy.ts:7-67` and P6 acquisition; future fixes must preserve SSRF guard at actual connection/network layer, not merely a form validator.
- 🟢 Explicit ReviewFingerprint and transfer receipt + ownership canonical gateway/unique keys exist; do not undo them.
- 🟢 The Web `resolvePublicTemplateDataMode` defaults to Live API, not demo; prototype mode is opt-in. Admin counts have dedicated repository aggregation (source), albeit semantics need alignment.

> For each task Codex shall locate the named exact source paths first, keep underlying P5/P6/P7/P8/P9/P10/P11/P12 ownership intact, implement fixes **only after explicit execution authorization**, never run production migrations/seeds/backfills, and include proof of negative tests. ### SCH-ADM-001 — P0 — منع تعديل مصادر P6 التابعة لـDomains أخرى من شاشة المنح

- **Problem / Verified source finding:** مسار تغيير حالة مصدر منحة يقبل sourceId اعتباطيًا. خدمة P12 تستدعي updateSourceStatus دون التحقق من metadata.ownerDomain، وبوابة Prisma تعالج أي مصدر موجود؛ إذن صاحب صلاحية admin:scholarships:manage يمكنه إرسال ID لمصدر خاص بقسم آخر.
- **Code evidence / exact paths:** `apps/api/src/app.ts:819`; `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/ScholarshipAdminRouter.ts:484-495`; `packages/application/src/scholarships/source-registry/ScholarshipSourceRegistryService.ts:96-111`; `packages/infrastructure/src/import-foundation/PrismaSourceRegistryGateway.ts:18-31`.
- **Required change:** داخل مالك P12، اقرأ المصدر أولاً، افشل مغلقًا إن لم يكن `ownerDomain === SCHOLARSHIPS`، واستعمل تحديثًا مشروطًا ذرّيًا على الهوية والملكية الحالية؛ حافظ على منع إعادة تفعيل `BLOCKED`. أضف سياسة صلاحية مستقلة لمصادر P6 إن لزم، ولا تعتمد على إخفاء ID في UI.
- **Acceptance criteria & required tests:** Negative API + service + Prisma transaction: scholarship admin attempts to disable UNIVERSITY/TEST source => 403/404 without changing anything; own source transition succeeds; concurrent owner switch fails; auditable action.
- **Architecture constraints / Do not change:** لا تمنح صلاحية `admin:imports:manage` تلقائيًا ولا تعدّل P6 generic registry ownership. No DB/runtime mutation during this review.
- **Remediation status:** `OPEN — NOT FIXED`؛ **Proof:** `SOURCE CONFIRMED`, actual reproduction/test outcome `RUNTIME PENDING`.

### SCH-ADM-002 — P0 — عزل مسار imported-records القديم على SCHOLARSHIPS

- **Problem / Verified source finding:** `GET /admin/scholarships/imported-records` يمرّر {batchId,status,page,pageSize} فقط إلى `ImportAdminUseCases.listRecords`؛ الطبقة العامة تنفّذ `normalizeLegacyFilters` ولا تضيف P12 dataType بنفسها، فيصبح عرض سجلات P6 متعدد الأقسام ممكنًا لمستخدم مخوّل للمنح فقط.
- **Code evidence / exact paths:** `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/ScholarshipAdminRouter.ts:691-703`; `packages/application/src/import-foundation/use-cases/ImportAdminUseCases.ts:431-436`; `apps/api/src/app.ts:768,819`.
- **Required change:** إما إزالة المسار القديم بعد ترحيل المستهلكين أو فرض `dataType=SCHOLARSHIPS` من الخادم مع فحص batchId يخص P12 ومنع أي override؛ استخدم Contract P12 المملوك وPagination validated بالـZod.
- **Acceptance criteria & required tests:** سجل SCHOLARSHIP وسجل UNIVERSITY في test DB: endpoint يرد الأول فقط؛ batchId أجنبي => منع؛ malformed page/status => 400؛ لا كشف rawPayload لأقسام أخرى.
- **Architecture constraints / Do not change:** لا توسّع وصول مستخدم المنح إلى P6 global data لاستيعاب legacy UI. No DB/runtime mutation during this review.
- **Remediation status:** `OPEN — NOT FIXED`؛ **Proof:** `SOURCE CONFIRMED`, actual reproduction/test outcome `RUNTIME PENDING`.

### SCH-ADM-003 — P0 — Public DTO صريح يحجب sourceEvidence والحقول الداخلية

## 11.10 Definition of Done — closure gate

> **تفسير 2026-10-09:** بنود الاختبارات التشغيلية والـE2E أدناه أصبحت Post-28 وليست شرط `CODE_CLOSED`؛ راجع السياسة المعتمدة أعلاه. يمنع الادعاء بأنها نُفذت دون دليل.


- [ ] P12 source-only users cannot read/mutate foreign-domain Import P6 records/sources (API + transaction proof).
- [ ] Public list/detail/graph return reviewed allowlisted fields only; internal metadata/provenance/IDs hidden; no draft children or unpublished linked institutions/tests.
- [ ] Publication uses a stable, immutable approved version read model; lifecycle and source verification checked inside commit boundary with optimistic/row lock.
- [ ] Manual scholarship can reach VERIFIED by authorized evidence review; no self-certified/fake evidence; maker-checker where required.
- [ ] Child stable IDs retained across ordinary PATCH, matching native P11 Program/P10 Major links; audit/outbox rolled back with business transaction on failure.
- [ ] Funding/eligibility/deadline/cycle and P7/P8/P9/P10/P11 canonical links behave consistently across Admin and Public and AR/EN.
- [ ] Import screening decisions are provenance-fingerprinted and durable, replay-safe, with explicit truncated/pending runtime state.
- [ ] Security, source validation, reference lifecycle, API errors, UI and integration regression tests pass in isolated environment.
- [ ] Proposed schema/rollout/rollback/production migration is reviewed and gated separately. No fix is CLOSED without code changes plus independent Codex re-review.
