- **حدود التحقق:** نتائج المهام أدناه استنتاجات من ملفات المصدر وعقود API/Prisma؛ لم تُختبر الأزرار في متصفح مهيأ، ولم تُنفَّذ طلبات كتابة، ويجب عدم تحويل «متوقع/مقترح» إلى عطل Runtime مثبت.
- **الموجود/يُحفظ:** قائمة المنح تتضمن search، status، completeness، بلد، تمويل، تخصص وصفي، درجة وصفية، لغة وموعد؛ تفاصيل المنحة فيها إدارة معقّدة للأهلية والدورات والربط، ويوجد مركز استيراد متخصص. **الحد:** إضافات هذا الملحق لا تعيد فتح عيوب الهوية/النشر المسجلة في SCH-ADM-001…030.

**مقارنة عالمية موجَّهة:** UCAS يعرض تصفية الجامعة/الموضوع/نوع الدراسة والسنة؛ DAAD يعرض الدرجة/لغة البرنامج/التخصص/موقع الجامعة. التوصية هنا إدارة Canonical links الموجودة وليس نسخ البحث العام. المراجع: https://www.ucas.com/explore/search/courses-beta ؛ https://www2.daad.de/deutschland/studienangebote/international-programmes/en/result/

### سجل الفجوات الجديدة — 3 مهام

### FGA-11-001 — P1 — فلاتر الجامعة والبرنامج الأكاديمي والاختبار بمعرّفات Canonical وليس التسميات فقط

- **تصنيف الدليل/الحالة:** موجودة جزئيًا؛ API يدعم العلاقات، Admin لا يرسلها.
- **الفجوة وسبب الحاجة:** قائمة المنح تعرض البلد/التمويل/الدرجة/التخصص/اللغة/الموعد بواسطة قيم وصفية، ولا تعرض محدد الجامعة أو البرنامج الأكاديمي أو الاختبار الدولي على الرغم من أن API يقبل universityId وacademicProgramId وinternationalTestId وmajorId وdegreeLevelId. هذا نقص وظيفي محدد، وليس غيابًا لكل الفلاتر.
- **مثال تشغيلي:** المسؤول يطلب منح جامعة معيّنة لبرامج ماجستير علوم الحاسب المشروطة بـIELTS؛ يجب الحصول على تقاطع Canonical صحيح ولو تشابهت الأسماء المترجمة.
- **الكود المرتبط:** `apps/admin/src/pages/ScholarshipListPage.tsx:106-180,467-570`؛ `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/ScholarshipAdminRouter.ts:99-126`؛ `packages/infrastructure/src/scholarships/PrismaScholarshipRepository.ts`؛ `packages/infrastructure/prisma/schema.prisma` (ScholarshipUniversityLink/AcademicProgram relationships).
- **العمل الهندسي المقترح (Owner → API → Admin/Public/Student):** إضافة canonical pickers مع dependent facets (جامعة→برامج الجامعة، تخصص→درجات/برامج) وربط المفاتيح المدعومة فعليًا في owner query؛ إبقاء label fallbacks للبيانات المستوردة غير المحسومة في وضع مستقل مع شارة `UNMAPPED`؛ URL-search state قابل للمشاركة وpaging موحد. لا تكتب جدول علاقات موازيًا.
- **الترابط/التأثير:** P7/P8/P9/P10/P11/P12، وStudent matching لاحقًا؛ معيار موحّد للمعرّفات.
- **معايير القبول القابلة للاختبار:** في DB اختبارية تحتوي منحة A مرتبطة بالجامعة U والبرنامج P واختبار T، يرجع فلتر (U,P,T) A فقط؛ تغيير U يمسح P غير المتوافق؛ نتائج الصفحات وtotal/server-side facet counts ثابتة؛ unmapped لا يدخل canonical filter خطأً؛ صلاحية الإدارة مطبقة خادميًا.
- **منع التكرار:** ليس تكرار SCH-ADM-022 (ثبات الفلاتر) أو SCH-ADM-015 (صحة فلتر الدولة): يتناول عناصر Relational selectors غير الموجودة داخل القائمة رغم عقد API الموجود.

### FGA-11-002 — P2 — مساحة تصفية مراجعة المصدر والترجمة والتحقق في سجل المنح

- **تصنيف الدليل/الحالة:** موجودة في API فقط / ناقصة في قائمة Admin.
- **الفجوة وسبب الحاجة:** الـAPI يدعم `verificationStatus` و`translationState` و`sourceType` و`sponsorName` لكن القائمة لا تتيح لهذه السمات فلاتر قائمة؛ يحتاج المراجع فرز المنح غير الموثقة أو التي تنتظر ترجمة، دون المساس بمنطق التحقق.
- **مثال تشغيلي:** مشرف جودة يريد «منح مستوردة تحتاج تحققًا من مصدرها، ولم تترجم إلى الإنجليزية» ثم يفتح سجل المنحة المعنية للمراجعة.
- **الكود المرتبط:** `ScholarshipAdminRouter.ts:99-126`؛ `ScholarshipListPage.tsx:106-180`؛ `ScholarshipImportCenterPage.tsx`؛ `AdminScholarshipUseCases.ts`.
- **العمل الهندسي المقترح (Owner → API → Admin/Public/Student):** تعريض فلاتر owner-backed ذات قيم enum مسموحة، مع روابط واضحة إلى حالة المراجعة ومركز الاستيراد؛ عدم اعتبار غياب verification دليلًا على التحقق؛ مراعاة حماية P6 والـRBAC.
- **الترابط/التأثير:** P6/P12 ومنظومة Localization/Translation Governance وعمليات مراقبة النشر.
- **معايير القبول القابلة للاختبار:** استعلام بعاملين verificationStatus+translationState يعيد exact total وrows بعد paging؛ رابط صف يفتح سجل المنحة والمصدر دون السماح بمراجعة غير مخوّلة؛ حالة UNKNOWN ظاهرة ومستقلة؛ غير المترجم لا يظهر كمنشور مترجم.
- **منع التكرار:** لا يعيد تنفيذ SCH-ADM-009/018 (توثيق ومشروعية قرار التحقق)، بل يضيف لوحة العثور على العناصر التي تحتاج القرار.

### FGA-11-003 — P2 — ترتيب نتائج المنح حسب قرب الموعد وتاريخ التحديث والجاهزية

- **تصنيف الدليل/الحالة:** تحسين جديد مضبوط النطاق بعد فحص خيارات الفرز.
- **الفجوة وسبب الحاجة:** القائمة تستخدم paging وفلاتر كثيرة، لكنها لا تتيح ترتيبًا ظاهريًا للمسؤول، والـlistQuerySchema لا يعرض sort enum. يحتاج الفريق فرز الإغلاق القادم بدل التقليب يدويًا عبر عشرات الصفحات.
- **مثال تشغيلي:** موظف محتوى يعرض «المفتوحة والتي ستُغلق أولًا» لمراجعة الروابط والتواريخ قبل إقفال التقديم.
- **الكود المرتبط:** `ScholarshipListPage.tsx:145-180`؛ `ScholarshipAdminRouter.ts:99-126`؛ `PrismaScholarshipRepository.ts`.
- **العمل الهندسي المقترح (Owner → API → Admin/Public/Student):** إضافة whitelist لخيارات sort مع `id` tie-breaker وفصل حالة OPEN_ALL_YEAR وdeadline null؛ إجراء sort ضمن query DB قبل paging، مع رابط/URL حالة الفرز؛ مراعاة timezone UTC للموعد.
- **الترابط/التأثير:** P12 + دليل المنح Public؛ ترتيب القوائم لا يغيّر حالة الدورة.
- **معايير القبول القابلة للاختبار:** مجموعتان متطابقتا الفلاتر لكن sort مختلفة تُظهران تسلسلًا صحيحًا ومستقرًا عبر الصفحات؛ NULL deadlines في آخر ترتيب «الأقرب»؛ اختبارات نهاية اليوم/المنطقة الزمنية؛ لا تغيير بيانات.
- **منع التكرار:** لا يكرر SCH-ADM-012 (مصدر حقيقة المواعيد أو eligibility)، بل يضيف ترتيب قراءة وإدارة فقط.

### بوابة إغلاق الملحق الخاصة بهذا القسم

1. قبل البرمجة، يراجع Codex تنفيذ الـOwner APIs وPrisma schema/migrations الفعلية ويبيّن الحقول الموجودة مقابل المستلزمات الجديدة؛ لا يعدّ تصميم الواجهة إثباتًا لحقيقة DB.
2. لكل وظيفة: أثبت GET/search/filter/total/page ثم mutation (إن وجدت)، RBAC deny وaudit reason، owner/public/student consistency، loading/empty/error/conflict/refresh.
3. أي إضافة تحتاج migration تُكتب Migration Source وخطة rollback فقط؛ **لا تُنفّذ على DB الإنتاج**، ولا يُنشر أو يُرسل إشعار أو يُخصم مبلغ في المراجعة.
4. الشروط أعلاه Acceptance مستقبلية، وليست نتائج اختبار تم تشغيلها؛ لا تُغلق المهام تلقائيًا.

# 12 — Study Destinations / دول الدراسة — Admin ↔ P7 ↔ Public ↔ Owner-Domain Graph — Deep Source Audit

> **معيار الإغلاق المحدّث للقسم 12:** إصلاح الأكواد والثغرات والنواقص + اختبارات source/contract/security خفيفة مستهدفة + رفع Commit. **لا يلزم هنا E2E حي أو قاعدة بيانات/مزود تشغيل فعلي**؛ اختبارات التشغيل في الملحق الأخير بعد القسم 28، مع بقاء إطلاق الإنتاج محظورًا دون أدلته.
> **الاختبار الأساسي المختصر:** Study Destinations: صدق معلومات وجهة الدراسة وربط البيانات المعتمدة وإخفاء مسودات النشر.


> **Review date:** 2026-10-08 · **Repo:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-` · **Branch:** `main` · **Inspected commit:** `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca` · **Review modality:** GitHub source inspection only, no repository or DB mutations, no runtime E2E certification.
>
> **Owner boundary:** `ReferenceCountry` (P7) is authoritative for ISO identity, active status, localization and geographic metadata. `StudyDestinationProfile` owns independently authored country-study editorial/visa/cost/evidence/publishing facts. Links to universities/P11, scholarships/P12, majors/P10, international tests/P9, CMS, services, careers and courses must remain derived owner-domain read models, **never** copied to editable country JSON.
>
> **Scope warning:** Some identified conditions are deterministic in source (e.g. hard-coded featured counts and malformed link serialization); others concern workflow assurance/design contracts requiring formal confirmation. **No runtime user-data leak, exploit, database corruption, or failed test was demonstrated.** The docs' source-only 90/90 verifier is not equivalent to permissioned API/DB/browser verification.

## 12.1 Result and evidence map

**Overall: REVIEWED — CRITICAL TRUST/PROVENANCE AND PUBLIC CONTRACT FIXES REQUIRED.** 26 specific Codex tasks: **2 P0; 15 P1; 9 P2**. Do **not** close or auto-fix; write/tests/implementation are separate authorized phases.

| Layer | Inspected code & core contracts | Observed state |
|---|---|---|
| API / admin permissions | `apps/api/src/app.ts:776-777`; `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/StudyDestinationAdminRouter.ts:10-107,109-198`; `apps/admin/src/App.tsx` | Manage/read guarded by `admin:reference-data:manage` at mount. `PUT profile`, `submit-review`, `verify-source`, `publish`, `archive` live in same router; Zod schemas defined. |
| Application | `packages/application/src/study-destinations/StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:55-479` | Lifecycle `DRAFT → IN_REVIEW → PUBLISHED → ARCHIVED`, readiness validation; source-sensitive changes of already-published record demote to DRAFT and UNVERIFIED; explicit `expectedUpdatedAt` optimistic check. |
| Domain | `packages/domain/src/study-destinations/index.ts:1-354` | Canonical DTO, bilingual field families, source evidence and readiness checks, no explicit durable reviewer/source-proof identity in DTO. |
| Prisma | `packages/infrastructure/src/study-destinations/PrismaStudyDestinationRepository.ts:24-225`; `packages/infrastructure/prisma/schema.prisma:3754-3806` | One profile per canonical country, stable ISO2 slug, language join, currency reference, transactional `updateMany` compare-and-swap where `expectedUpdatedAt` supplied. |
| Public API | `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/StudyDestinationPublicRouter.ts:1-35`; Application `:255-329` | List uses `PUBLISHED`/active canonical country; detail checks status. Public DTO currently spreads complete admin profile. |
| Admin UI | `apps/admin/src/pages/StudyDestinationsAdminPage.tsx:97-181,280-424`; `StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:165-285,302-589,1270-1400` | Seven-tab editor, relation graph, save-before-action guard, confirmation, editable raw pipe-separated links and sources. |
| Public site | `apps/web/src/features/public-template/publicLiveDataSource.ts:269-335,494-520`; `PublicTemplateApp.tsx:1553-1568,1754-1775`; `CountriesSearchPage.tsx:198-214`; `CountryDetailModal.tsx:148-155,650-677`; `FeaturedCountries.tsx:1-182` | Public country cards use published data, but featured homepage remains independent static data with fixed scholarship counts. Country images/cities not projected from profile. |
| Cross-domains | `packages/application/src/read-models/CrossDomainGraphReadService.ts:389-494`; `StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:1071-1266` | Country graph composes published owner-domain entities by canonical country ID/ISO2. No duplicate Scholarship/University entities in Study Destination. |
| Source-only closure documentation | `docs/STUDY_DESTINATIONS_FINAL_CLOSURE_2026-09-05.md:1-108`; `scripts/verify-study-destinations-source-closure.mjs` | Historical source-only assertions including `90/90 PASS`, explicitly **runtime pending** for Prisma/DB/browser; the present review found contracts not covered by that assertion. |

### Confirmed positive controls to preserve

- Canonical country is a separate reference owner; the public catalog does **not** automatically display every country (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:255-281`).
- Country must be active on admin create/read and public fetch; linked language/currency is checked for active status on new authoring (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:331-334,416-425`).
- Core content/visa/cost and supporting official links/evidence are gating requirements, and `verify-source` is not a generic form field (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:381-389`; `index.ts:199-351`).
- Source-sensitive content updates to published profiles transition to `DRAFT + UNVERIFIED` in one repository update with a stale-write guard (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:139-168`; `PrismaStudyDestinationRepository.ts:127-156`).
- Direct save/UI changes preserve `expectedUpdatedAt` and display concurrency failure; `POST publish` performs an `IN_REVIEW` + ready check (`StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:441-487,496-586`; `StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:224-241`).
- HTTP(S) URL scheme is enforced by Application (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:470-477`); external public anchors include `noopener noreferrer` (`CountryDetailModal.tsx:661-667`).
- Country graph cross-domain read model does not write to universities, grants, jobs, exams or courses (`CrossDomainGraphReadService.ts:389-494`).

## 12.2 Findings in remediation order

**P0 — integrity/trust gates:** STD-ADM-001/002. **P1 — DTO, links, home discovery, image, localized completeness, canonical lifecycle, review changes/audit:** STD-ADM-003 through STD-ADM-015. **P2 — performance, summaries and coverage:** STD-ADM-016 through STD-ADM-022; supplemented by STD-ADM-023/024 (P1), STD-ADM-025/026 (P2).

### STD-ADM-001 — P0 — تزوير توقيت التحقق من أدلة المصدر من محرّر المحتوى

- **Proof:** Admin Zod accepts `evidenceSources[].verifiedAt: z.string().datetime().optional()` at `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/StudyDestinationAdminRouter.ts:39-54`; `normalizeAndValidateInput` preserves arbitrary `verifiedAt` inside the submitted evidence objects (`packages/application/src/study-destinations/StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:369-373`). `verifySources()` uses `verifiedAt: source.verifiedAt ?? verifiedAt` (`:193-219`), **preserving an editor-supplied timestamp** rather than replacing it with a server-generated verification event.
- **Impact:** The user-editable source payload can masquerade as a prior verification timestamp; verified provenance/time is not trustworthy even if the operator must call `verify-source` separately. This is a source-level integrity bypass; actual abuse not tested.
- **Codex fix:** Remove `verifiedAt` from authoring schema; write verification event/time exclusively inside authenticated server-side verification path. Preserve prior verified event history in append-only proof records; do not accept client-provided actor/time for certification. If historical import requires timestamps, use separate trusted ingest and mark as *reported*, not *verified*.
- **Acceptance/test:** Attempt `PUT /profile` with forged past/future `verifiedAt` => rejected or stripped; untrusted input cannot appear as certified evidence. Authorized `verify-source` uses server time and actor, and changing evidence invalidates the prior verification. Unit + Supertest + isolated DB transaction.
- **Forbidden:** Don't hide the field in React as the only fix, and don't rely on client date input validation.

### STD-ADM-002 — P0 — توثيق المصادر ثم النشر دون إثبات مراجعة بشرية مستقلة

- **Proof:** All admin mutation verbs in `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/StudyDestinationAdminRouter.ts:139-178` have no endpoint-level separate reviewer permission or reviewer/evidence decision payload; mount uses only `admin:reference-data:manage` (`apps/api/src/app.ts:776`). `verifySources()` only checks evidence list, `sourceAuditDate`, HTTP URL syntax, then switches `sourceVerificationStatus` to `VERIFIED` (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:193-221`). `publish()` trusts this marker (`:224-241`; domain `index.ts:299-320`).
- **Risk/qualification:** This cannot prove actual staff misconduct. It proves a *single authorized P7 editor* can save official-looking links, self-verify and publish with no durable explicit independent approval. For visa/education information, verification should not mean merely that URLs exist.
- **Codex fix:** Define a Maker-Checker / review decision for source-sensitive publication at owner service. Persist actor ID, evidence identifiers/content fingerprints, verification time, reviewer identity, review outcome, and publish version. Distinct RBAC permission or policy-validated reviewer separation per governance, no bypass by direct API call; safe re-review on source change. Gate publish on current verified evidence fingerprint and independently approved revision.
- **Acceptance/test:** Creator cannot self-certify if separation policy demands independent reviewer; editor-only token cannot verify/publish; reviewer identity and signed decision available to Audit; stale verification rejected; after approved review same unchanged source can publish; concurrency/replay tests.
- **Boundary:** Do not make outbound live scraping or site availability a substitute for human source verification.

### STD-ADM-003 — P1 — استجابة Public StudyDestination تكشف كائن Profile الإداري كاملًا

- **Proof:** `packages/application/src/study-destinations/StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:318-329` `publicDto()` returns `{ ...profile, country, studyLanguages, livingCostCurrency }` with internal `id`, `countryReferenceId`, `completenessStatus`, `sourceVerificationStatus`, raw `evidenceSources`, `sourceAuditDate`, image asset identifier, created/updated timestamps. `PublicStudyDestinationDto extends StudyDestinationProfileDto` at `:46-53`; public GETs at `StudyDestinationPublicRouter.ts:16-22`. The web DTO in `apps/web/src/api/client.ts:29-64` expects much of this. `CountryDetailModal.tsx:650-651` comment even says source/audit are admin-only while printing audit date.
- **Impact:** Overbroad public contract with unreviewed source-evidence metadata, internal identifiers and editorial statuses; future internal fields would be exposed automatically. Internal IDs are not secrets by definition, but disclosure should be intentional.
- **Codex fix:** Introduce explicit `PublicStudyDestinationDto` **allowlist projection** on API/Application boundary, declare reviewed public evidence/last-verified semantics separately, remove internal Audit/proof fields, avoid spreading persistence DTO. Narrow public country/language/currency snapshots to needed safe fields. Align `apps/web/src/api/client.ts` and mapper.
- **Acceptance/test:** Public GET list/detail snapshots have only allowed keys; no internal evidence proof/DB IDs unless explicitly approved for graph identity; no draft profile; bilingual detail still renders. Security negative test with synthetic internal field added to repository DTO must not leak it.

### STD-ADM-004 — P1 — محرر الروابط الرسمية يفسد تصنيف الرابط بـ `$`

- **Proof:** `apps/admin/src/pages/StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:239-263` serializes each official link using ``${item.category}$ |`` instead of ``${item.category} |``. `parseLinkLines` at `:249-263` parses the malformed token as `category`. API limits category to strict enum `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/StudyDestinationAdminRouter.ts:19-38`.
- **Impact:** On editing any existing line of the official-links textarea, the malformed category is re-sent and strict API validation fails; unchanged text is conditionally preserved on ordinary save (`StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:471-474`), therefore the defect specifically manifests on an edit, not every save.
- **Codex fix:** Remove accidental `$`, add roundtrip serializer/parser tests for links with/without optional English labels/notes; ideally replace pipe protocol with controlled structured row editor preserving escape and order.
- **Acceptance/test:** Existing category `GOVERNMENT_STUDY` edits, saves, reloads without 400; unchanged fields retain values; required labels/URLs still validated; destructive or malformed separators receive readable input errors.

### STD-ADM-005 — P1 — الواجهة الرئيسية تعرض دولًا وأعداد منح ثابتة، ولو غير منشورة

- **Proof:** `apps/web/src/features/public-template/components/FeaturedCountries.tsx:11-77` contains static `DESTINATION_BUBBLES`, including hardcoded counts `45,38,32,...`, independent of owner `isFeatured`, status, country graph, or published scholarship data. `PublicTemplateApp.tsx:1553-1568` mounts it without dynamic `countries` prop. Meanwhile canonical published list is loaded from `/study-destinations` (`publicLiveDataSource.ts:513-516`).
- **Impact:** False scholarship counts and apparent destination availability even where no approved/published study profile exists; directly contradicts P7/P12 owner/publication contract.
- **Codex fix:** Drive home featured grid exclusively from published `StudyDestinationProfile` with `isFeatured` and owner-derived verified counts (or omit count if unavailable). Use configured imageAsset, locale/country identity and deterministic empty fallback; no fake statistics. Do not merge prototype data into API mode.
- **Acceptance/test:** Draft/archived/unverified/profile-absent country never appears in live featured grid; counts match published Scholarship owner result or are omitted, not hardcoded; `isFeatured` toggle reflected after cache invalidation; prototype works only behind explicit dev flag.

### STD-ADM-006 — P1 — نقر بطاقات الدول المميزة لا يطابق هوية الدولة

- **Proof:** `FeaturedCountries.tsx:13-77,114-130` calls `onSelectCountry(item.id)` with Arabic names (e.g., `المملكة المتحدة`, `الصين`). `PublicTemplateApp.tsx:1557-1566` stores name in `countryNavigationName`; `CountriesSearchPage.tsx:198-214` looks up only `country.id`, `publicId`, `slug`, or ISO2, not localized name. `mapCountry` produces country UUID, `std-XX`, ISO2 slug (`publicLiveDataSource.ts:286-296`).
- **Impact:** Clicking featured tile generally takes user to countries section but does not open its detail; for any formerly known country with no matching published profile it should not open it anyway.
- **Codex fix:** Pass canonical `countryReferenceId` or published destination `slug` from actual data for all links; eliminate localized-name navigation identifiers.
- **Acceptance/test:** Each featured tile opens exact published country in AR and EN on desktop/mobile, reload/deep link retains identity; unpublished countries do not resolve.

### STD-ADM-007 — P1 — صورة الوجهة محفوظة لكنها لا تُعرض في العرض العام

- **Proof:** Admin `StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:790-797,441-444` authors `imageAssetId`; Prisma persists it (`schema.prisma:3783-3790`). Public `mapCountry()` at `publicLiveDataSource.ts:269-335` hardcodes `imageUrl: ''` (`:300-310`), while `FeaturedCountries.tsx:15-77` uses unrelated static Unsplash thumbnails.

- **Codex fix:** Resolve approved/publicly deliverable asset through Asset Platform reader (not raw asset ID to URL concatenation), require appropriate status/licensing and fallback; use across featured tiles and country cards/detail. Preserve immutable image provenance and source-sensitive review policy.
- **Acceptance/test:** A valid published image appears for selected country; invalid/private/deleted asset is not served; changing asset follows approved editorial workflow; featured fallback is safe, no remote fixed thumbnail leak.

### STD-ADM-008 — P1 — بوابة نشر المحتوى الثنائي لا تشترط قوائم الإنجليزية الأساسية

- **Proof:** `packages/domain/src/study-destinations/index.ts:209-321` checks both Arabic and English overview/system/visa summaries, but readiness checks `admissionHighlightsAr` only (`:239-244`) and `visaRequirementsAr` only (`:266-272`); no corresponding checks for `admissionHighlightsEn`, `visaRequirementsEn`, other localized cost/student-life highlights or official link English labels. Enforce mandatory English structures for bilingual public fields, or label fallback transparently and require explicit locale coverage before READY_TO_PUBLISH. Do not invent translations.

### STD-ADM-009 — P1 — المرجع النشط أثناء الإدخال لا يُعاد فحصه كاملًا في الاستجابة المنشورة

- **Proof:** `StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:416-425` checks study language and living-cost currency `isActive` when authoring and `:224-231` revalidates at publish; public `aggregate()` at `:296-314` resolves language and currency with `?.record` but **does not check `isActive`**; public `publicDto()` exposes returned names/rates (`:318-329`). `PrismaStudyDestinationRepository.ts:75-80` guards published primary country, not these child refs.
- **Impact:** A currency or study-language subsequently deprecated/inactivated in P7 may continue being presented as a current study option/valid cost currency in P12. Public country may remain published while its references go stale.
- **Codex fix:** Guard inactive/superseded languages and currency in the public projection, add controlled reference-change subscriber/health visibility and editorial revalidation. Do not mutate P7 from study-destination owner; preserve historic evidence separately.
- **Acceptance/test:** Reference becomes inactive after publication -> public view safely removes/warns about affected field and flags admin re-review; P7 historical aliases not silently treated active; no source reset of Reference Data.

### STD-ADM-010 — P1 — تسمية «مصدر رسمي» لا تعني تحققًا من رسمية النطاق

- **Proof:** `StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:470-477` URL validation accepts any HTTP(S) host. `StudyDestinationAdminRouter.ts:19-54` has enum source labels including GOVERNMENT/IMMIGRATION but no approved-origin/agency binding. `verifySources()` does not compare origin to authority or stored evidence hash (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:193-221`); public UI titles links «روابط رسمية» (`CountryDetailModal.tsx:650-667`).
- **Risk:** A URL pointing to any HTTP server may be certified as "official"; user-facing visa links are trust-sensitive. This is **missing assurance**, not a claim that malicious URLs currently exist.
- **Codex fix:** Introduce reviewed `officialAuthority`/country/approvedOrigin evidence contracts, normalized HTTPS-first validation, redirect/allowlist policy where appropriate, explicit exception review for official non-gov domains, and link review at publish. Separate citations vs application/action URLs. Keep P6 SSRF protections intact; do not fetch arbitrary URLs during GET.
- **Acceptance/test:** `https://example.invalid/visa` cannot automatically gain official-authority status merely via string enum; approved government/university domains and documented exceptions are accepted; scheme spoofing, redirects and mixed-domain cases tested.

### STD-ADM-011 — P1 — تغيير صورة أو إبراز Profile منشور دون إعادة اعتماد محتوى العرض

On existing `PUBLISHED`, only source-sensitive changes demote to `DRAFT`/`UNVERIFIED` (`:139-168`); admin sends both fields (`StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:441-487`). This is intentional-looking editorial bypass and needs policy review.
- **Impact:** Public visual/promotional representation may change directly without the source-approved content transition, distinct from ordinary metadata edit.
- **Codex fix:** Classify publication-affecting fields by governance: at minimum image and public prominence should have approved moderation/audit behavior. Either route through an independently approved lightweight marketing workflow or through normal draft/review. Keep URL/image asset validation on save.
- **Acceptance/test:** Published profile edit of image/featured records actor/reviewer, publishes approved version only; no silent unexpected visual change; low-impact internal fields remain editable per policy.

### STD-ADM-012 — P1 — غياب سجل مراجعة أصلي وذرّي لدورة ملف وجهة الدراسة

Prisma `StudyDestinationProfile` at `schema.prisma:3754-3796` stores current record and timestamps only; no owner-specific publication version/history entities. Compare P12 scholarship review/versions for governance, without copying incompatible schema.
- **Risk:** A current profile can be published/archived without append-only actor-attributed mutation reason, diffs, approved version and transactional integration event guaranteed by this owner flow. Logging elsewhere may exist but is not established as an atomic owner guarantee.
- **Codex fix:** Use P5 transaction-bound audit/outbox primitives for all study-destination business mutations, persist approved revision/source fingerprint and reviewer. Introduce minimal version/read-model only after ARB approved design; do not create schema migration or trigger outbox worker during this review.

Currency/visa requirements are time-sensitive, but status does not expire automatically.

Reject future dates, require reviewed reason for old verified sources, surface `STALE_REVIEW` to admin, and apply safe public freshness disclaimer/deferral. Do not make network polling mandatory without approved legal/ops policy.

## 12.3 API–Application–Domain–Infrastructure reconciliation / trace

| Journey | API | Application decision | Persistence/owner | Public/UI result | Fix gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country found | `GET /admin/study-destinations/:iso2Code` | P7 active country resolution; profile optional | `ReferenceCountry` → `StudyDestinationProfile` by unique FK | Unconfigured country opens editor; not public automatically | STD-ADM-017 |
| Edit | `PUT /:iso2Code/profile` | normalize source content, validate P7 links, reset verification/demote if sensitive; optimistic updatedAt | Prisma `$transaction`, status/currency/language | Admin reloads, published state may disappear | STD-ADM-004/011/012 |
| Review | `POST /:iso2Code/submit-review` | readiness `readyForReview`, move `IN_REVIEW` | profile current status | operator workflow | STD-ADM-002/008 |
| Verify | `POST /:iso2Code/verify-source` | **Only** existence/date/URL and sets `VERIFIED` | profile + evidence JSON; no immutable reviewer event | UI green source label | STD-ADM-001/002/010/013 |
| Publish | `POST /:iso2Code/publish` | must `IN_REVIEW`, `readyForPublish`; update CAS | `status=PUBLISHED` | public GET list and detail | STD-ADM-002/003/012 |
| Archive | `POST /:iso2Code/archive` | lifecycle archive | current profile status | public GET excludes archived | STD-ADM-012/019 |
| Public cards | `GET /study-destinations` | published P7 active only; per-record resolution | 100-item offset pages | `mapCountry`; custom client search | STD-ADM-003/007/018/019 |
| Featured home | homepage component | **Static 8-entry table, not API** | none | mock counts and Arabic name ID navigation | STD-ADM-005/006 |
| Related objects | `GET /:iso2Code/relationships` | `CrossDomainGraphReadService` composite | each domain read owner only | admin deep links, public graph | preserve owner boundary; no duplicate CRUD |

## 12.4 Important cross-section decisions — avoid replaying old findings

1. **P7 Reference Data:** authority of ISO2/ISO3 names, country lifecycle, currency/language active states and canonical city identities stays P7; no duplicate country tables, no direct write to reference-owned rows. This section identifies consumer freshness and profile UX only.
2. **P11 Universities/P12 Scholarships:** graph uses `listPublished` owner constraints (`CrossDomainGraphReadService.ts:389-455`), so a study-destination edit must never directly publish/unpublish University or Scholarship rows. Counting by eligible international students/nationalities requires Scholarship-specific eligibility query, not simplistic country joins.
3. **P6 Import:** the inspected owner includes no direct auto-import or transfer endpoints for StudyDestination; do not invent an "automatic country publication" fix or execute existing Import transfers.
4. **P5 Assets:** `AssetReferencePolicy` is checked on `upsertProfile()` for image use (`StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:115-123`); the defect is **public image presentation and review policy**, not a claim that asset checking is absent.
5. **P5 Audit / events:** owner mutation lacks an explicit atomic Audit/Outbox coordinator in the inspected `StudyDestinationUseCases` constructor. Any central middleware audit logging is not automatically equivalent to transaction-bound per-action business audit. Proposal must integrate existing primitives without duplicating audit system.
6. **Localization:** do not auto-insert machine translations or violate established locale authoring rules; decide mandatory bilingual content with ARB before strengthening readiness.
7. **Public routes:** `StudyDestinationPublicRouter.ts:16-29` enforces published owner data via use case and status, whereas homepage `FeaturedCountries` bypasses that by using static data. Do not treat every country card as leaked draft; distinguish two paths.

## 12.6 Codex implementation order and Definition of Done

> **تفسير 2026-10-09:** بنود الاختبارات التشغيلية والـE2E أدناه أصبحت Post-28 وليست شرط `CODE_CLOSED`؛ راجع السياسة المعتمدة أعلاه. يمنع الادعاء بأنها نُفذت دون دليل.


1. **Containment before cosmetics:** STD-ADM-001/002 (evidence proof and reviewer integrity) + STD-ADM-003 (public allowlist) + STD-ADM-004 (broken editor round-trip), with negative API tests. Coordinate source policy with P5 IAM/Audit and P7 Reference Data.
2. **Publication-consistent experiences:** STD-ADM-005/006/007 (real featured data, correct canonical navigation, image asset delivery); eliminate hardcoded counts; preserve public-only gating.
3. **Country content accuracy:** STD-ADM-008/009/010/011/013/014/015 (bilingual completeness, active refs, proof of official link, featured/image review, freshness, localization and genuine cities) with cross-domain contract review.
4. **Durable governance:** STD-ADM-012/021 (transactional audit/version and privilege separation), source-only schema plan if ARB approves; never apply migration automatically.
5. **Operator scale and regression:** STD-ADM-016/017/018/019/020/022 (dashboard scoping, batch query/paging, test suites, reliable ratings).

**Closure criteria:** all accepted fixes merged by authorized Codex process; no P0 remaining; published read-model and source evidence are independently approved; all relevant unit/API/Prisma/browser E2E tests pass with documented environment; P7/P11/P12 owner-domain invariants preserved; explicit reviewer and staged runtime proof. **Source analysis alone cannot mark task CLOSED.**

No claim of exploitation or deployed defect from this source audit.

## 12.8 Deep-dive supplement — additional source-confirmed Codex tasks

The following **nonduplicate** findings emerged from the second pass on owner-graph pagination, asset lifecycle, monetary projection and Prisma type safety. These extend Section 12; **do not** create another Section 12 or re-number STD-ADM-001…022.

### STD-ADM-023 — P1 — Country graph pagination silently repeats university/scholarship first page

- **Concrete source:** `packages/application/src/read-models/CrossDomainGraphReadService.ts:389-450` accepts the country graph `{page, pageSize}`, but queries `universityRepository.listPublished({ countryReferenceId: country.id, limit: pageSize })` and `scholarshipRepository.listPublished({countryReferenceId: country.id,limit:pageSize})` without any cursor/offset. In the same graph function `page` is supplied to international tests and careers. `apps/admin/src/pages/StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx:403-418,730-743` sends `graphPage` via `/admin/study-destinations/:iso2Code/relationships?page=N`. Cursor-based P11/P12 owner repositories consequently return their initial page for every `N` in the country graph; this is a **source-level deterministic defect in cross-domain pagination**, not confirmation of a particular runtime dataset containing more than pageSize.
- **Remediation:** Model per-owner cursors in `CountryGraphReadModel` rather than pretending cursor collections share the same page index; if retaining page-number UX, add a stable, budgeted cursor adapter that advances correctly for P11/P12. Do not make StudyDestination own or mutate Scholarship/University data. Preserve independent P9/Services/Career paging.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 12:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 10962 من الخطة الأصلية.

### STD-ADM-024 — P1 — Asset reference can be revoked between save and publish

- **Concrete source:** `StudyDestinationUseCases.upsertProfile` calls `assertAssetReferenceUsable(this.assetReferences, input.imageAssetId, {purpose:'STUDY_DESTINATION_IMAGE'})` at `packages/application/src/study-destinations/StudyDestinationUseCases.ts:115-124`, but `publish` at `:224-241` calls `normalizeAndValidateInput(profile)` (which checks URL, P7 language/currency, costs) and `publishingPolicy.evaluate` **without** checking the current state of `imageAssetId` in P3. Persistence stores `imageAssetId` as nullable string (`schema.prisma:3784`) and the current public mapper does not yet project a public image (STD-ADM-007); once proper projection is added, this missing publication boundary must not become a path to serve a deleted/private/quarantined image.
- **Remediation:** Revalidate AssetPlatform eligibility at owner publication, and ensure public media delivery independently checks published accessibility or omits unsafe asset. Optionally subscribe to P3 lifecycle events for invalidation. Coordinate with STD-ADM-007/011; this is distinct from the currently working pre-save image policy.
- **Acceptance/test:** safe asset at save that becomes quarantined before publish results in blocked publish or approved safe image omission per policy; safe asset publishes; private/revoked asset never yields a public URL; image optional does not block complete text-only destination.

### STD-ADM-025 — P2 — Local-currency amounts are placed in USD-named UI field

- **Concrete source:** `apps/web/src/features/public-template/publicLiveDataSource.ts:269-307` derives `currencyCode` from `livingCostCurrency?.isoCode` (or canonical country default), then assigns `${min}–${max} ${currencyCode}` to `CountryDestination.averageLivingCostUsd`. For EUR/CNY/GBP this string is NOT in USD and may be misinterpreted by later components/reporting. The source mapper makes no FX conversion, which is correct; the defect is the inaccurate contract name.
- **Remediation:** Introduce typed `monthlyLivingCostRange { min, max, currencyReferenceId, currencyCode, period:'MONTH' }` and format in the selected locale. Deprecate the legacy USD-named property without silently converting or relabeling figures. Coordinate with P7 canonical currency and P19 finance, but do not build FX pricing here.
- **Acceptance/test:** CNY remains CNY, EUR remains EUR, USD remains USD; no consumer infers USD when currency differs; null/unknown min/max handled safely; locale formatting tests.

### STD-ADM-026 — P2 — Prisma repository `any` bypasses schema / relation type checks

- **Concrete source:** `packages/infrastructure/src/study-destinations/PrismaStudyDestinationRepository.ts:27-28,69-99,183-222` uses `(this.prisma as any).studyDestinationProfile`, `where: any`, `(row:any)` and maps DB relations dynamically. This avoids compile-time checking of fields/relations when Prisma clients are updated, increasing accidental drift risk.
- **Remediation:** Replace with typed Prisma delegate, `Prisma.StudyDestinationProfileWhereInput` and `Prisma.StudyDestinationProfileGetPayload` matching include/select shapes, preserving `transaction`+CAS and source JSON mapping; verify with actual generated client in isolated CI. Do not introduce inaccurate handwritten shadow Prisma types or run against production DB.
- **Acceptance/test:** TypeScript fails on renamed schema fields/relation selection; Prisma validate/generate and repository integration test pass in authorized test environment; existing public DTO JSON shape remains stable until STD-ADM-003 explicit projection refactor.

## 13.1 Overall judgment and architecture / domain boundaries

**REVIEWED — CRITICAL SOURCE INTEGRITY, CURRICULUM ATOMICITY, AND LEARNER-WORKFLOW FIXES REQUIRED.** The platform already has substantial real foundations: API-level `admin:courses:manage` at `apps/api/src/app.ts:821-827`, student authentication + role guard + idempotency at `CourseLearnerRouter.ts:17-19`, distinct native/external/paid origins, provider/domain verification and controlled import-lineage URL changes, canonical reviewed taxonomy/major/test relations, non-public answer keys in learner workspace, guarded publication using atomic audit/outbox, transactional enrollment/completion, source-state readiness gates, and P3 asset handles. **Preserve these mechanisms; do not replace them with UI checks or generic CRUD.**

Ownership: Course owns catalog/course/learning outcomes, curriculum, learning paths, enrollment and completions; P6 owns staging/raw import; imported-provider identity and source URL provenance remain in controlled P13/P6 handoff; P7/P8/P9/P10 are canonical reference owners; P3 owns asset security/delivery; P19 owns financial clearance; P14 owns certificate issuance. P16 editorial and P11 universities / P12 scholarships must not be copied into Course JSON. Cross-area issues are linked rather than re-reviewing sections 03,05,07–11,20.

**Actual source files examined:** `apps/admin/src/pages/CourseListPage.tsx`, `CourseDetailPage.tsx`, `CourseProviderRegistryPage.tsx`; API routers `CourseAdminRouter.ts`, `ImportedCourseAdminRouter.ts`, `CourseImportOperationsRouter.ts`, `CourseProviderRegistryRouter.ts`, `CoursePublicRouter.ts`, `CourseLearnerRouter.ts`, `apps/api/src/app.ts`; application `AdminCourseUseCases.ts`, `NativeCourseUseCases.ts`, `ImportedCourseAdminUseCases.ts`, `CoursePublicationService.ts`, `CourseCurriculumUseCases.ts`, `CourseEnrollmentPolicyUseCases.ts`, `CourseProgressUseCases.ts`, `LearningPathUseCases.ts`, `PublicCourseUseCases.ts`, `CourseImportCoordinator.ts`, `CourseImportOperationsUseCases.ts`, `CourseProviderContinuationUseCases.ts`; infrastructure `PrismaCourseRepository.ts`, `PrismaCourseCurriculumRepository.ts`, `PrismaCourseProgressRepository.ts`; public `publicLiveDataSource.ts`, `CoursesSearchPage.tsx`, `ImportedCourseDetail.tsx`, `OwnerCourseDetail.tsx`, `CourseLearnerPage.tsx`; associated source tests and source-closure report. **These are source traces, not tests executed in this review.**

Existing enrollment and completion events use atomic coordinator. The open issues are version/scope/transition/race semantics, **not** an asserted total absence of enrollment protection.

## 13.4 Codex implementation tasks — source evidence + scoped fix + acceptance

### CRS-ADM-001 — P0 — Source-owned imported course price/certificate facts are editable outside controlled import

- **Evidence:** `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/ImportedCourseAdminRouter.ts:47-71,82-85` permits editing `accessType`, `isStudyFree`, `isFreeCertificate`, `certificateType`, language/study-level/topic raw facts. `packages/application/src/courses/use-cases/ImportedCourseAdminUseCases.ts:36-65` protects provider identity and direct URL, but forwards remaining fields to `AdminCourseUseCases.updateCourse`. `AdminCourseUseCases.ts:17-23,53-59,83-103` only protects five lineage fields and reclassifies using mostly URL/provider/name. `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:238-251` persists editable free/certificate flags. `CoursePublicationService.ts:55-73` gates external publication on precisely these flags.
- **Required fix:** Classify ALL source-evidence properties, not just URL, as provenance-controlled (`isStudyFree`, `isFreeCertificate`, accessType, certificate kind, provider/official facts, raw study data); require approved P6/P13 diff and field-level reviewer/actor evidence for modifications, including changes from non-free to free. Permit separate admin editorial annotation where provenance cannot be mutated. Fail closed for previously VERIFIED/PUBLISHABLE records after a source-fact change. Do not collapse source records into optionalFields or allow manual fake completeness.
- **Acceptance:** PATCH attempting to change external free-study/certificate without approved import review returns 409; approved transfer updates provenance+version+review state atomically; existing published external records cannot become eligible by direct editor alone; source evidence and reviewer are independently queryable.

### CRS-ADM-002 — P0 — Curriculum mutation and immutable version snapshot are not one atomic unit

- **Evidence:** `CourseCurriculumUseCases.ts:82-85,123-157,165-203,212-245` mutates module, lesson or asset via the curriculum repository, then separately `checkpointCourseVersion(courseId)` -> `courseRepository.update(courseId,{})`. `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:223-268,408-421` captures the snapshot in the later transaction, not in the mutation's transaction. The same split applies to quiz/bank/question mutations in `CourseCurriculumUseCases.ts:254-349`.
- **Required fix:** Add transaction-aware curriculum aggregate authoring that atomically checks editable status+expectedVersion, writes a single scoped mutation, increments version and stores a matching immutable snapshot; audit/outbox where required. Avoid after-the-fact checkpointing and per-row silent Partial Commit; include reorder and deletion, not just create.
- **Acceptance:** injected failure after curriculum DML rolls back both content and version; two concurrent editors yield one successful CAS and one 409; snapshot for each course version matches DB state as of commit; no published course can receive a racing lesson/quiz write.

### CRS-ADM-003 — P0 — Published external course remains visible without live source/provider trust eligibility

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:342-369` public list filters stored `status`, `completenessStatus`, external `accessType/isStudyFree/isFreeCertificate`, not current provider approval, recorded link health, domain approval or freshness. `PublicCourseUseCases.ts:38-46,143-148` detail similarly checks status, completeness and free flags only. `ImportedCourseAdminUseCases.ts:68-106` verifies approved provider/domain and checks links separately; `CoursePublicationService.ts:67-72` checks sourceVerified/linkHealth only **at publish time**.
- **Required fix:** Define a consistent live public-eligibility/withdrawal policy for external courses (provider disabled, allowed domain removed, BROKEN/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN link, stale evidence), using an efficient query/read projection or event-driven demotion; apply in both list and slug detail, with cache invalidation and safe status transitions. Preserve P6 provenance and do not execute arbitrary remote URLs per public request.
- **Acceptance:** disabling a provider or marking link BROKEN removes affected course from list and returns 404 on detail under the agreed service SLO; no stale catalog cache serves it after invalidation; reapproval requires source/link recheck; automated provider bulk-state and detail regression tests.

### CRS-ADM-004 — P1 — Administrative lifecycle allows invalid transitions / archive resurrection

- **Evidence:** `AdminCourseUseCases.ts:106-125` markReadyToReview only checks completeness, then forces READY_TO_REVIEW from any nonmatching status; `:144-154` archive is unrestricted and reject is blocked only for PUBLISHED. `CourseAdminRouter.ts:524-558` exposes these across all origins; native path has stronger `NativeCourseUseCases.ts:308-337` state checks.
- **Required fix:** Centralize explicit legal transition graph by origin, with version guard and reason. Block `ARCHIVED -> READY_TO_REVIEW`, `REJECTED -> PUBLISHABLE`, and `PUBLISHED -> READY_TO_REVIEW` except an authorized workflow. Route both generic and imported endpoints through same invariant. Preserve genuine unpublish/reopen path if product explicitly supports it.
- **Acceptance:** table-driven tests for every origin/status/action, forbidden transitions 409; archive is not silently resurrected by mark-ready; status history contains previous/new values and reason.

### CRS-ADM-005 — P1 — Generic course edits are last-write-wins rather than version-constrained

- **Evidence:** `CourseAdminRouter.ts:48-76,481-520` PATCH accepts no `expectedVersion` or `expectedUpdatedAt`; `AdminCourseUseCases.ts:42-104` fetches existing then forwards update; `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:223-268` does `findUnique` + `course.update({where:{id}})` without expected version predicate and increments version unconditionally. `CourseDetailPage.tsx:229-273,312-326` edits and saves without version conflict handling.
- **Required fix:** Require expected integer version (or ETag/If-Match), perform atomic `updateMany` CAS inside content write transaction, return 409 ProblemDetails with actual version and preserve form. Apply to origin-specific metadata and important enrollment policy/config changes, not merely public publish.
- **Acceptance:** two editors load v3; first writes v4, second receives 409 without overwriting; admin shows diff/reload path; no duplicate snapshot on rejected write.

### CRS-ADM-006 — P1 — Source-verification endpoint is a transient predicate, not a durable approval record

- **Evidence:** `ImportedCourseAdminRouter.ts:87-89` exposes `verify-source`; `ImportedCourseAdminUseCases.ts:68-93` checks approved provider and URL domain then **returns `{verified:true}` without persisting a new reviewer, evidence, source-fact hash, timestamp or approval transition**. `checkLink` at `:95-107` separately persists a link result; publication relies on `detail.sourceVerified` (`CoursePublicationService.ts:67-72`) that this method does not set.
- **Required fix:** Distinguish read-only preflight from persisted verification; require immutable reviewer/actor, provider record/version, URL and source-fact hash, and verifiedAt, linking it to existing import approval. If this endpoint is just a dry-run, rename its response/UI and never imply it changes status. On edit or provider approval change, invalidate prior verification.
- **Acceptance:** UI doesn't claim source verified when durable evidence absent; audit query shows verified version; mark-ready obeys persisted approval policy; repeat verification idempotent for same immutable source version.

### CRS-ADM-007 — P1 — Quiz max attempts can be bypassed by concurrent start requests

- **Evidence:** `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:247-258` counts current attempts then inserts; `PrismaCourseProgressRepository.ts:121-135` `createQuizAttempt` and `countQuizAttempts` execute separately, without shared lock/serializable count+insert boundary. Idempotency key middleware alone does not stop distinct concurrent valid keys.
- **Required fix:** Add atomic quiz+student scoped attempt allocation (transaction and lock/constraint) with maximumAttempts asserted inside; stable attempt number and student-scoped idempotency. Enforce count when resuming in-progress attempt, not creating excess competing attempts.
- **Acceptance:** 20 parallel starts with maxAttempts=1 create ≤1 attempt; duplicate retries resolve same attempt; different students isolated; database integration test exercises contention.

### CRS-ADM-008 — P1 — Quiz grades depend on mutable present-time questions rather than attempt-version snapshot

- **Evidence:** `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:247-257` creates attempt without capturing canonical course/quiz/question version; `:260-293` fetches current `getCurriculumSnapshot`, recalculates grading from current questions/correct answers. `PrismaCourseCurriculumRepository.ts:203-236` stores versioned question changes, yet attempts are not bound to that snapshot in application.
- **Required fix:** Freeze assessment version at attempt start and grade against exactly those question IDs/weights/answers; record gradedVersion and grade-policy fingerprint, especially across course unpublish/republication. Keep correctAnswer server-side; do not leak it in workspace.
- **Acceptance:** attempt started before admin question edit grades using original version; attempts after edit use new version; question removals do not invalidate old legitimate attempts; signed/not-exposed answer projection remains safe.

### CRS-ADM-009 — P1 — Enrollment policy can be changed live for published courses without review

- **Evidence:** `CourseEnrollmentPolicyUseCases.ts:19-34` only validates seat flag/max and self-prerequisite, then unconditionally upserts; there is no check for `PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED`, expectedVersion, prerequisite existence/status/acyclicity, policy change impact on ACTIVE/WAITLISTED learners or approval workflow. API entry `CourseAdminRouter.ts:293-298` accepts broad `eligibilityRules` JSON.
- **Required fix:** Version policy independent of course but tied to published/active enrollment contracts; enforce safe transition matrix; check canonical prerequisite graph, no cycle and no missing/deactivated prerequisite; reject unsupported `eligibilityRules` deterministically; provide explicit migration/waitlist behavior for existing students. P19 financial-clearance check must stay fail-closed.
- **Acceptance:** no silent loss of learner access/capacity/financial entitlement on policy edit; invalid prerequisites 422; concurrent policies 409; learner and payment regression suites green.

### CRS-ADM-010 — P1 — Learning access following archive/unpublish has no explicit entitlement contract

- **Evidence:** `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:40-47,49-74,76-124,193-200,247-263,296-313` checks origin and enrollment status but does **not check current course publication state** for workspace, content delivery, mark progress, attempts or completion. By contrast `enroll` explicitly checks PUBLISHED at `:132-134`; admin can unpublish/archive (`AdminCourseUseCases.ts:136-153`).
- **Required fix:** Write explicit learning-entitlement decision: grandfather valid enrolled students on archived versions, revoke immediately for security/legal takedown, or gracefully retire with immutable entitled version. Implement consistently for workspace, P3 signed grant, progress and certificate readiness; do not blindly block legitimately paid prior enrollments if business contract grants continued access.
- **Acceptance:** matrix by PUBLISHED/UNPUBLISHED/ARCHIVED, learner ACTIVE/COMPLETED and paid/free produces the authorized outcome; takedown revokes grants; no unapproved learning materials from republished draft version become visible.

### CRS-ADM-011 — P1 — Completion assessment requirement is optional author-editable JSON and bypasses quiz pass gate

- **Evidence:** `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:308-325` gates quiz-pass enforcement solely on `course.optionalFields.completionCriteria.assessmentRequired === true`; otherwise 100% lesson progress suffices. `CourseAdminRouter.ts:71,493` accepts arbitrary `completionCriteria` as `z.record(z.unknown())`; `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:193-205,228-238` trusts student-submitted completed lesson progress for tracking. `NativeCourseUseCases.ts:81-158` validates quiz content readiness, but not immutable graded-completion policy.
- **Required fix:** Define typed and versioned completion policy with required lesson, quiz and graded assessment clauses, deriving it from published curriculum if configured. Distinguish attendance/self-report from successful assessment. Freeze criteria at enrollment or defined version; require admin approval to loosen criteria on active/published cohorts.
- **Acceptance:** required quiz cannot be skipped by omitting JSON flag; 100% progress without passed mandatory quiz does not issue completion event; policy changes for existing student cohort versioned; do not implement P14 certificate issuance inside Course.

### CRS-ADM-012 — P1 — Learning path publish transition lacks course-consistent transactional state check

- **Evidence:** `LearningPathUseCases.ts:50-70` markReady simply writes READY_TO_PUBLISH, publish fetches path then checks each referenced course PUBLISHED, then independently calls `repository.updateStatus`. No atomic compare against course versions/status during path publish; the course may be withdrawn concurrently.
- **Required fix:** Introduce version/CAS path publication, lock or consistency snapshot for member courses, archive/dependency invalidation policy and domain audit event. Avoid cross-domain course duplication.
- **Acceptance:** concurrent course withdrawal cannot leave publicly published path claiming an unavailable course without defined compensating withdrawal; 409 conflict and reconciliation tests; learner path membership frozen at chosen version.

### CRS-ADM-013 — P1 — Learning-path enrollment/progress semantics need enrollment-scoped immutable path version

- **Evidence:** `LearningPathUseCases.ts:73-76` records `path.version`, but `:79-87,110-115` calculates progress/unlocks from current `path.courses`; `:94-105` emits an event carrying `enrollment.learningPathVersion` while evaluating the current path. There is no demonstrated snapshot lookup for the enrolled version.
- **Required fix:** Resolve member/prerequisite graph from immutable enrolled path version for `availableCourses` and `refreshProgress`; handle archived/changed member courses consistently and preserve course-completion linkage.
- **Acceptance:** changing path structure after enrollment cannot retroactively remove or add required courses for existing cohort without migration; tests for v1 cohort vs v2 cohort, strict ordering, and completion outbox.

### CRS-ADM-014 — P1 — Imported source-fact changes are not tied to evidence invalidation

- **Evidence:** `ImportedCourseAdminUseCases.ts:36-65` update calls `AdminCourseUseCases.updateCourse` for non-URL fields; `AdminCourseUseCases.ts:83-103` classifies completeness but does not coordinate `ImportedCourseOperationsRepository` provenance/review/link-check rows. Imported URL changes are properly blocked, but **source claims** can still drift independently (`ImportedCourseAdminRouter.ts:47-71`).
- **Required fix:** After CRS-ADM-001 controlled source editing, derive source-fact fingerprint and invalidate `sourceVerified/linkHealth` or review status where affected; use atomic transfer coordinator. Keep manual editorial fields separate and unchanged when permissible.
- **Acceptance:** changing certificate/course-free evidence requires revalidation even if URL unchanged; public eligibility disappears until reviewed; preserved provider identity and URL history.

### CRS-ADM-015 — P1 — Live asset lifecycle and learner grants need publication/version-aware revalidation

- **Evidence:** `CourseCurriculumUseCases.ts:212-239` validates asset status/classification/mime at **attachment time**; `NativeCourseUseCases.ts:118-145` checks active assets at readiness; `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:65-74` returns assetId after validating enrollment/lesson but not asset current lifecycle or entitlement version. `CourseLearnerRouter.ts:30-33` hands it to `ProcessAssetLifecycleUseCase` for delivery grant; downstream asset gate likely performs additional checks and must be inspected before declaring a bypass.
- **Required fix:** Prove by integration that delivery-grant issuance checks actual P3 state/classification/purpose and enrolled course version on every grant; add explicit failure on revoked/quarantined asset, and recheck required references on publication without race. Preserve P3 authorization ownership.
- **Acceptance:** revoked PRIVATE or quarantined asset never yields active grant even if attached earlier; active enrolled student accesses authorized asset; public catalog never exposes private raw storage path.

### CRS-ADM-016 — P1 — Translated course editor and API disagree on write contract

- **Evidence:** `CourseAdminRouter.ts:63-76,484-497` accepts `titleEn` and `localizedNames`, and sends them inside `optionalFields`; `AdminCourseUseCases.ts:42-45` immediately calls `assertNoTranslationPayloadFields('COURSE', updates.optionalFields, ['localizedNames','titleEn'])`; `PublicCourseUseCases.ts:115-140` still reads `optional.localizedNames/titleEn` for display. This is a **deterministic endpoint contract inconsistency**, not merely untranslated UI labels.
- **Required fix:** Remove unsupported translation fields from generic course PATCH and route them to the canonical localization owner/workflow, or implement the approved localized course-content update contract; preserve existing legacy read compatibility until migration. Reflect this in admin UI and OpenAPI/types.
- **Acceptance:** editing English title succeeds via declared supported translation endpoint, or form explicitly indicates read-only; no generic editor renders a field that always fails; ar/en public projections and backward read tests pass.

### CRS-ADM-017 — P1 — Course admin error handler collapses conflicts/not-found into HTTP 400

- **Evidence:** `CourseAdminRouter.ts:560-565` returns HTTP 400 with arbitrary `err.message` for all non-Zod errors, including permission-like business conflicts, missing IDs, stale versions and atomic persistence failures. Compare imported router's partial 404/409 mapping (`ImportedCourseAdminRouter.ts:120-138`).
- **Required fix:** Use stable domain error taxonomy + RFC 7807 ProblemDetails: 400 malformed input, 401/403 auth, 404 missing, 409 state/version conflict, 422 business validation, 429 rate limit, 500 unexpected with no stack/raw secrets. Preserve central middleware/audit instrumentation.
- **Acceptance:** tests for each route & error type, 409 version conflict, 404 unknown course, 500 sanitized infrastructure error, no internal error string leaked.

### CRS-ADM-018 — P1 — Single course-manage permission grants both editorial and publication / source approval

- **Evidence:** `apps/api/src/app.ts:821-824` mounts admin course, imported course and provider registries all under `admin:courses:manage`; `CourseAdminRouter.ts:186-212,481-557` and `ImportedCourseAdminRouter.ts:82-118` do not show independent action authorizer for edit vs publish/reject vs source verify. Course import operations separately use `admin:imports:manage`, which is good.
- **Required fix:** Establish explicit policy split (viewer/author/reviewer/source-trust/publisher) or scoped delegated permission by role; enforce at route/application boundary, not only button visibility. Ensure no self-approval of source changes where maker-checker policy applies and preserve existing admin RBAC from section 01.
- **Acceptance:** author cannot publish or approve own source evidence unless expressly granted; publisher cannot edit unowned import source; API direct requests return 403; access matrix audited.

### CRS-ADM-019 — P1 — Non-publication status transitions are not domain-atomic audit/outbox operations

- **Evidence:** `CoursePublicationService.ts:75-116` uses atomic coordinator for PUBLISHED; `AdminCourseUseCases.ts:106-125,136-153` invokes direct `repository.updateStatus` for review-ready, unpublish, reject and archive; `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:291-295` snapshots version but does not invoke `AtomicDomainMutationCoordinator`. Outer `/admin` has `MutationAuditMiddleware` (`apps/api/src/app.ts:754`), but HTTP audit is **not equivalent** to transactional business event/audit.
- **Required fix:** Route lifecycle commands through versioned atomic domain change with actor+reason and appropriate outbox (withdrawal/deindex, waitlist/learner effects); keep request audit middleware in place; do not introduce duplicate records without idempotency semantics.
- **Acceptance:** DB rollback leaves no orphan status event; unpublish/archive invalidates public discovery and caches; actor + prev/next status + courseVersion recorded; replay idempotent.

### CRS-ADM-020 — P1 — Public course discovery eagerly loads entire published dataset

- **Evidence:** `apps/web/src/features/public-template/publicLiveDataSource.ts:494-515` loops up to 10,000 pages with `collectOffsetPages`/`collectCursorPages` and materializes all published courses (`loadPublishedCourses` in the same source); `CoursesSearchPage.tsx:45-52,96-130` builds options and filters arrays on the client. The public source contract `CoursePublicRouter.ts:16-50` already offers cursor/filter primitives for improved delivery.
- **Required fix:** Move catalog filtering/sorting/search to bounded indexed public API with stable cursor; implement page/virtualized UI and cached aggregate filter facets. Preserve separations for imported and internal paid/native tracks and the published eligibility gate.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 13:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 11210 من الخطة الأصلية.

### CRS-ADM-021 — P2 — Catalog/related-major identity projections differ between detail and list

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:286-288,365-369` deliberately include only APPROVED/PUBLISHED major projections on public detail/list; generic admin list uses `listPage` at `:372-393` without that include, while `mapToDto` at `:423-427` maps relatedMajors from `record.majorProjections ?? []`. Other retrieval shapes may therefore expose empty related majors even when canonical links exist.
- **Required fix:** Specify consistent list/detail/read-model owner shapes for admin and public, using only approved canonical relationships where public; avoid relying on text fallback. Ensure domain relationship read-model can feed filters without N+1.
- **Acceptance:** known linked course yields same canonical major IDs on list/detail as agreed; unpublished majors not shown publicly; pagination total unaffected.

### CRS-ADM-022 — P2 — Admin offset pagination has no unique tie-breaker

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCourseRepository.ts:372-393` uses `skip/take` with `orderBy: {createdAt:'desc'}` alone. Equal `createdAt` values are possible for bulk imports and can cause unstable ties; `CourseListPage.tsx:139-175` drives offset pages.
- **Required fix:** Add stable secondary ID sort or cursor and indexed compound filter; define stability under concurrent new records.
- **Acceptance:** equal timestamps across page boundary never reorder/disappear without explicit snapshot contract; test 500 imported records sharing timestamp.

### CRS-ADM-023 — P2 — Waitlist / manual approval have no complete learner admission control-plane in examined flow

- **Evidence:** `CourseProgressUseCases.ts:135-158` rejects `policy.requiresApproval` or unsupported eligibility evaluator; `PrismaCourseProgressRepository.ts:47-73` can create WAITLISTED enrollment when capacity full; current inspected learner/admin routes (`CourseLearnerRouter.ts:26-45`, `CourseAdminRouter.ts:293-298`) expose no reviewer promotion/approval operations. **Confirm no alternate owner workflow before introducing one.**
- **Required fix:** Complete owner-domain approval/waitlist promotion and notifying student, or keep the switches disabled until supported. Prevent unbounded WAITLISTED state, and test canceled/reopened seats. Coordinate with P15 support and P23 notification later without duplicating their data.
- **Acceptance:** no policy toggle creates an unresolvable learner state; promotion is atomic/capacity safe and audited; learner sees status accurately.

### CRS-ADM-024 — P2 — Browser downloads whole protected media asset into memory

- **Evidence:** `apps/web/src/features/learning/CourseLearnerPage.tsx:148-179` obtains signed grant, fetches all media into `blob()`, builds `URL.createObjectURL`, and revokes download blob URLs after 60 seconds. This is correct for some small documents but unfavorable to large videos/audio, seeking and low-bandwidth usage.
- **Required fix:** Use access-controlled stream/range delivery (or signed playback URL under P3 authorization policy) for large media, conservative blob fallback for small documents, revoke object URLs on unmount/next lesson; no public/unsafe direct links.
- **Acceptance:** video seek works on restricted asset, ≤bounded memory on large file, expired grant fails, unmounted media cleans resources, mobile/bandwidth test.

### CRS-ADM-025 — P2 — Admin course editing lacks robust dirty/conflict and atomic readiness feedback

- **Evidence:** `CourseDetailPage.tsx:135-153,229-294,312-360` uses client snapshots to track edits and saves; `CourseAdminRouter.ts:524-542` responds with only `{success:true}` after transitions; version is not carried as precondition. The detail page loads curriculum/readiness/relationships in distinct calls and can expose an out-of-date readiness relative to just-saved curriculum.
- **Required fix:** Return authoritative version+status+readiness after mutations; show changed timestamp, source/provenance readiness, pending saves by tab, conflict recovery without discarding edits; avoid loading every heavy editor panel on small screens. Align with CRS-ADM-002/005 first.
- **Acceptance:** navigating away with unsaved module/lesson/policy prompts; editor A/B conflict handled, save status accurate, readiness reflects committed version, no false success after failed reload.

### CRS-ADM-026 — P2 — Imported-provider changed-link and review queue bounded scans need backlog reconciliation

- **Evidence:** `CourseProviderContinuationUseCases.ts:247-264` derives changed link queue from bounded review records, capping `limit*2` to 500; `:272-320` operates bounded provider link-health batches. This is operationally sensible for individual jobs, but the queue cannot be assumed exhaustive for providers with thousands of reviewed imports without cursor/backlog tracking.
- **Required fix:** Add owner-scoped stable cursors and queue total/backlog metrics with retry/dead-letter, deduplicate by source identity, and preserve per-provider SSRF/allow-list/link-check budgets; do not enable arbitrary crawling.
- **Acceptance:** >500 changed URLs eventually processed with no silent omission; restart resumes at checkpoint; bounded concurrency; per-provider health dashboard counts reconciled.

### CRS-ADM-027 — P2 — Incomplete bilingual admin/public/learner strings and source-locale contract

- **Evidence:** Course admin detail and list include mixed Arabic literals and translated helper text (`CourseDetailPage.tsx:312-360,570-606,830-892`; `CourseListPage.tsx:262-336`); public learner details and courses search contain Arabic presentation literals (`CourseLearnerPage.tsx:148-181`, `CoursesSearchPage.tsx:40-45,336-399`). `PublicCourseUseCases.ts:115-140` is intentionally localized but uses optional legacy fields.
- **Required fix:** Move UI strings to canonical i18n keys with Arabic/English coverage; respect RTL/LTR for URLs/provider names/numbers, apply source-language fallback disclosure; do not re-create P17 translation store in Course domain.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 13:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 11252 من الخطة الأصلية.

### CRS-ADM-028 — P2 — Runtime contract and integration proof must be explicit, not borrowed from source closure

- **Evidence:** Source tests exist at `apps/api/tests/presentation/api/router/CourseAdminRouter.spec.ts`, `CoursePublicRouter.spec.ts`, `ImportedCourseAdminRouter.spec.ts`, `CourseImportOperationsRouter.spec.ts`; application tests in `packages/application/tests/courses/`; infrastructure tests in `packages/infrastructure/tests/courses/`, including `ImportedCourseRealTransferDatabaseIntegration.spec.ts`; `apps/web/e2e/imported-courses-runtime-closure.spec.ts` and `.github/workflows/imported-courses-runtime-closure.yml`. Closure report `docs/remediation/courses/COURSES_ADMIN_SOURCE_CLOSURE_2026-09-05.md:114-124` states runtime pending. **No test was run in this source audit.**
- **Required fix:** Implement focused failing tests per task, then CI matrix for Prisma generate/typecheck in disposable isolated environment, DB transaction contention, API RBAC/error contracts, external provider disablement, payment approval, full browser learner videos/quizzes, source review, native publication and import owner handoff. Use disposable DB guard; never run migrations against a live user DB.
- **Acceptance:** green controlled CI artifacts attached to issue; known failures and environment dependencies recorded; operator can reproduce in sandbox; runtime cert remains PENDING until genuinely run.

## 13.5 Delivery sequence and cross-section dependencies

1. **P0 provenance and public trust first:** CRS-ADM-001/003/014/006; coordinate with P6 import controls (section 05) and provider registry; no existing published catalog hand-edited into eligibility.
2. **P0 curriculum atomicity:** CRS-ADM-002 then 005/008; finish transactional snapshot and assessment version before refining admin UX.
3. **Learner security/payment/assessment:** CRS-ADM-007/009/010/011/015, keeping P3 grants, P19 financial clearance and P14 certificate owner independent.
4. **Lifecycle and path consistency:** CRS-ADM-004/012/013/018/019; no unauthorized role escalation and preserve original atomic publication design.
5. **Public/admin operation and quality:** CRS-ADM-016/017/020 and P2 backlog 021–028; reconcile API contracts, locale, provider continuation and browser performance.

**Source-confirmed P0 demonstration cases (proposed tests, not executed):** (a) imported certificate/free claims cannot switch via PATCH alone; (b) partial failure after `createLesson` leaves no unversioned content; (c) an externally published course is withdrawn when provider becomes DISABLED or verified link becomes BROKEN. **Full E2E/runtime proof is pending.**

**SECTION 13 REVIEW STATUS:** **REVIEWED — CRITICAL FIXES REQUIRED**, **28 CODEX TASKS OPEN** (`CRS-ADM-001…028`; **P0=3, P1=17, P2=8**), **FIXES NOT APPLIED**, **RUNTIME PENDING**. **NEXT: Section 14 — Certificates / P14 only after user requests «أكمل».**
