# 16 — إدارة المحتوى / Enterprise CMS & Site Experience (P16)

> **إكمال مصدر 14 أكتوبر 2026:** أُكملت نواقص مخطط الكتل وحقوق الأصول وإيقاف snapshot الإعلان أثناء المسودة وتسوية الجدولة ورصد أخطاء الكاش. نجحت148 اختبارات خفيفة في28 ملفًا وTypeScript؛ التفاصيل في [تقرير الإكمال](SECTION_16_COMPLETION_2026-10-14.md). **CODE_CLOSED — RUNTIME_DEFERRED**؛ CMS-ADM-030 مؤجل لما بعد28. الأحكام القديمة أدناه تاريخية وليست حكم المصدر الحالي.

> **معيار الإغلاق المحدّث للقسم 16:** إصلاح الأكواد والثغرات والنواقص + اختبارات source/contract/security خفيفة مستهدفة + رفع Commit. **لا يلزم هنا E2E حي أو قاعدة بيانات/مزود تشغيل فعلي**؛ اختبارات التشغيل في الملحق الأخير بعد القسم 28، مع بقاء إطلاق الإنتاج محظورًا دون أدلته.
> **الاختبار الأساسي المختصر:** CMS: تنظيف المحتوى ضد XSS، فصل المسودات عن النشر، صلاحيات الموافقة وحماية الروابط.


## 16.1 نطاق المراجعة ونتيجتها

- **Frozen source baseline:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-`, `main`, commit `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca` (2026-10-08). No repository/database mutations.
- **Trace:** `apps/admin/src/pages/CmsAdminPage.tsx`, `apps/admin/src/features/cms/CmsOperationsPanels.tsx` → `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/{CmsAdminRouter,CmsPublicRouter}.ts`, `apps/api/src/app.ts` → `packages/application/src/cms/use-cases/CmsUseCases.ts`, `packages/application/src/background-jobs/handlers/CmsScheduledPublishingBackgroundJobHandler.ts` → `packages/domain/src/cms/{services/CmsPublishingPolicy.ts,entities/CmsContent.ts,contracts/ICmsRepository.ts}` → `packages/infrastructure/src/cms/{PrismaCmsRepository.ts,RedisCmsDeliveryCache.ts}` → Prisma migrations 20260824213000, 20260826194500, 20260905014500 → `packages/ui/src/CmsRichText.tsx` and source tests/docs.
- **Verdict:** **REVIEWED — CRITICAL AUTHORIZATION, PUBLISHED-IDENTITY, MAKER-CHECKER AND PUBLIC-DELIVERY FIXES REQUIRED**. Source review ≠ production/runtime verification. Phase 16 owns editorial content/site experience; it MUST NOT duplicate authoritative academic entities, reference countries, scholarships, courses, or identities.
- **Preserve what works:** admin auth and global mutation-audit/idempotency inherited at `/admin` (`apps/api/src/app.ts:740-755,840-841`); author identity comes from `req.authUserId` (`CmsAdminRouter.ts:31-35`); localized states and approval workflow (`PrismaCmsRepository.ts:317-381,404-503`); safe limited rich-text tags and React-node rendering (`CmsPublishingPolicy.ts:7-39`, `packages/ui/src/CmsRichText.tsx:31-68`); revision/audit/outbox transactions (`PrismaCmsRepository.ts:47-63,1401-1461`); internal redirect cycle/unsafe URL rejection (`CmsPublishingPolicy.ts:41-100`, `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:1316-1335`); Redis site-version invalidation (`RedisCmsDeliveryCache.ts:29-44`); public published projection (`PrismaCmsRepository.ts:625-692`); canonical domain-link UUID constraints at source level only.
- **Severity is limited to source-observed behavior.** Concurrency outcomes, deployed permissions, CDN cache, migration readiness, scheduler execution and source-to-runtime asset existence must be tested; do not report them as already reproduced.

## 16.2 Codex remediation backlog — exact source references and acceptance

### CMS-ADM-001 — P0 — A single CMS permission controls authoring, review, publication and operational jobs

- **Evidence:** `apps/api/src/app.ts:840-841` mounts `/admin/cms` through the sole `requireAdminPermission('admin:cms:manage')`; `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/CmsAdminRouter.ts:92-335` does not separately call a permission evaluator for `approve`, `publish`, `archive`, `change-slug`, redirects, menus, announcements, schema creation or `operations/process-due-schedules`.
- **Impact & fix:** a holder of one broad permission can exercise all operational capabilities; maker-checker identity comparisons are not substitutes for independent RBAC. Introduce granular route-level `view`, `author`, `review`, `publish`, `redirects:manage`, `navigation:manage`, `schemas:manage`, `operations:run` checks with separate role grants and fail-closed evaluator. Keep inherited authentication/idempotency/audit. ARB/authorization mapping as separate scoped source change.
- **Negative/regression proof:** author-only actor POST `/approve`, `/publish`, `/operations/process-due-schedules` → 403 without mutation; reviewer-only cannot rewrite content or change redirects; authorized reviewer/publisher succeed with independent audit; verify user-supplied actorId is ignored.

### CMS-ADM-002 — P0 — Approved publication can incorporate unreviewed changes to canonical content-node fields

- **Evidence:** `packages/infrastructure/src/cms/PrismaCmsRepository.ts:68-103` permits updating main-node `title`, `summary`, `categoryId/categorySlug`, `contentType`, `siteIdentifier`, ownership/metadata and featured media on the content root without checking locale workflow approval state or resetting reviews; `:404-500` publishes using the *current* root `contentType`, `siteIdentifier`, `categorySlug` and `featuredAssetId` after checking only the locale review. Only root `slug` has special immutability treatment (`:76-79`).
- **Impact & fix:** a late change to category/site/content type/featured media can reach public copy without being covered by review; moving site/type also risks stale public projections. Define versioned review snapshot spanning the **effective public payload** (root + locale + attachments/tags/SEO/domain refs); block privileged root edits while in approved/scheduled state or explicitly invalidate approval/re-review. Freeze canonical site/type identity after first publish unless governed migration/redirect; preserve historical projection.
- **Negative/regression proof:** after locale approval, mutate each effective root field then try publish/scheduled worker → must reject or require new reviewer approval; already published copy remains stable; test Arabic and English independently.

### CMS-ADM-003 — P0 — Published localized slug/SEO canonical not updated when editor changes the slug

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:765-785` changes `CmsLocalizedContent.localizedSlug`, resets state to DRAFT and inserts old→new redirect. On republish, `:436-483` upserts `CmsPublishedContent` by `(contentId,locale)` but **update branch omits `slug`, `canonicalUrl`, `siteIdentifier`, `locale`, `contentType`** (the create branch sets them). `:675-691` resolves published records by `siteIdentifier_locale_slug`. Thus newly published slug can diverge from stored delivery slug and canonical URL; redirect target may not resolve.
- **Impact & fix:** reconcile canonical identity transactionally for republish: update the published unique slug and canonical URL after collision checks, move/validate redirects atomically, preserve old-path 301 history and SEO semantics; forbid cross-site duplicate IDs and incorrect locale fallback.
- **Negative/regression proof:** publish `/ar/articles/old`, approved `change-slug` to `new`, republish → `/ar/articles/new` serves the updated publication and canonical path, old path returns exactly one valid redirect; duplicate slug fails with no partial redirect.

### CMS-ADM-004 — P0 — Editing live navigation and announcements takes the only public record offline

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:823-849` updates the same `CmsNavigationMenu` to `DRAFT` and deletes/recreates its live nodes; `PublicCmsUseCases` filters navigation status PUBLISHED (`packages/application/src/cms/use-cases/CmsUseCases.ts:382-385`). `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:960-983` likewise changes the live `CmsAnnouncement` row to DRAFT; `:938-940` public read filters PUBLISHED. No separate published snapshot for either while a revision is authored.
- **Impact & fix:** split immutable live navigation/announcement snapshot from authoring draft, publish/replace atomically after independent checker; preserve public live version throughout editing, rejection, concurrent edit and failure. Do not weaken maker-checker on publish.
- **Negative/regression proof:** save edited header/footer/announcement draft and leave unapproved → public response remains identical to last approved version; new copy appears only after authorized review/publish; rollback restores old snapshot after simulated transaction failure.

### CMS-ADM-005 — P0 — CMS workflow reviewer can also be the last effective content editor

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:199-258` stores locale `lastModifiedBy`; `:322-337` checks `assertMakerChecker(review.requestedBy, command.actorId)` but not the actual `lastModifiedBy`; `:412-420` checks `content.authorId` against publisher rather than current effective revision editor; review approval is found by latest APPROVED **without a version/content digest match**.
- **Impact & fix:** bind each approval to exact immutable root+locale version/hash, and require the approver to differ from the effective editor(s), requestor and applicable author. Publication/scheduling must verify approval's bound digest and authorized checker identity. Preserve ability for approved publisher different from editor and reviewer under governance policy.
- **Negative/regression proof:** Alice edits; Bob submits; Alice attempts approve → 403/409; revision changes after approval → publish fails until reapproved; independent actors with unchanged signed review snapshot can publish. Add database integration tests, not just mocked policy tests.

### CMS-ADM-006 — P1 — Optional expectedVersion and read-then-update weaken concurrency guarantees

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminRouter.ts:47-61` does not define `expectedVersion` in `contentSchema`, so `PATCH /content/:id` strips any submitted version; `:18-22,62-75,175-186` make other versions optional. `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:74-75,207-208,1194-1208,1242-1245` checks `expectedVersion` in memory only if supplied and subsequently updates by `id`, not conditional `(id,version)`; similar updates `:823-834,929-933,948-974`.
- **Fix:** require expectedVersion for all updates/workflow mutations; add it to validated root schema; execute atomic CAS (`updateMany` `where:{id,version,state}` or serializable transaction with guaranteed retry) and translate conflicts to HTTP 409; keep idempotency key semantics on retries.
- **Acceptance:** parallel editors with same version: exactly one succeeds; stale root PATCH and stale locale review both receive 409; no lost update of tags, attachments or nav nodes.

### CMS-ADM-007 — P1 — Revisions do not restore the complete approved document graph

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:199-292` saves tags/attachment relation tables separately; `:538-573` restores only title/body/SEO/featured/meta from revision payload and sets DRAFT, leaving tag/attachment relation graph and root fields as currently modified. `:404-480` publication includes tags and attachments in public snapshot.
- **Fix:** version canonical editorial snapshot including tags, attachments and relevant root review facts; restore all applicable components atomically with validation and reconcile missing assets/foreign keys before publication.
- **Acceptance:** restore historical revision with different tags/files and republish → exact historical authorized attachment/tag set, no mixed-era content; missing historical asset fails safely with remediation details.

### CMS-ADM-008 — P1 — Publication readiness does not renew asset authorization at publish time

- **Evidence:** `CmsUseCases.ts:47-58,82-97` validates EAP handles at initial authoring only; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:1211-1221` computes readiness based on title/body/category/SEO and counts; `:404-500` publishes referenced files without rechecking EAP state/classification/ownership or public grant. `CmsPublishingPolicy.ts:198-216` treats featured media as warning only.
- **Fix:** at publication/scheduling/worker boundary, revalidate all referenced EAP media handles, public classification/availability, linked asset purpose and render grant; include OpenGraph, attachments and design assets. Fail closed if revoked/unsafe, with clear readiness reasons.
- **Acceptance:** approved content with asset made PRIVATE/QUARANTINED/deleted before publish cannot expose asset; valid asset passes; active content remains public and safe when previous asset is revoked per defined degrade policy.

### CMS-ADM-009 — P1 — Domain relationship replacement may bypass live review and uses shape-only target checks

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminRouter.ts:136-148` exposes PUT replacement for 50 links; `CmsUseCases.ts:244-265` checks UUID shape/dedup; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:697-725` blindly deletes all and inserts links on already-published root, without owner-domain existence/lifecycle validation or editorial review invalidation. Docs `MANARATAK_CMS_DEEP_RESTRUCTURE_SOURCE_CLOSURE_2026-09-05.md:74-77` explicitly defer existence validation to runtime.
- **Fix:** validate target via P7/P9/P10/P11/P12/P13 owner-read gateways and lifecycle before accepting, and treat change as reviewable editorial change (or prove links don't alter public experience). CAS root revision, enforce editorial permission and audit old/new references.
- **Acceptance:** UUID of nonexistent/private/archived entity rejected; published related-content layout not silently changed without required review; authorized canonical target succeeds.

### CMS-ADM-010 — P1 — Public content lookup silently falls back across locale/slug boundaries

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:670-691`: if exact `(siteIdentifier, locale, slug)` is absent/not PUBLISHED, it queries *same slug from any locale* and then falls back to the node's `primaryLocale`; `CmsPublicRouter.ts:46-54` returns it without indicating language fallback. This can produce Arabic body and canonical URL on an explicit English request.
- **Fix:** for strict locale routes, return explicit `404/availableLocales` or governed redirect with actual locale and canonical URL, never silently mislabel. Keep primary-language fallback only as an opt-in documented contract.
- **Acceptance:** EN request for Arabic-only slug never returns an EN-shaped response containing Arabic canonical without a fallback indicator; archived EN does not expose draft; public alternate-language links remain correct.

### CMS-ADM-011 — P1 — Public cache/redirect invalidation incomplete for site operations

- **Evidence:** `CmsUseCases.ts:175-196,271-276,332-357` calls `invalidateDelivery` only on content publish/archive/change slug and schedules; `:283-330` returns repo calls for `createRedirect`, `saveNavigation`, `publishNavigation`, `saveAnnouncement`, `publishAnnouncement`, `archiveAnnouncement` without explicit site invalidation/outbox consumer proof. Public `CmsPublicRouter.ts:26-35,70-85` sets caching headers for navigation/announcements but not invalidation linkage to CDN.
- **Fix:** connect all public-affecting CMS events to site/locale cache version + CDN purge/ETag strategy; define TTL bounded fallback and test event dispatcher rather than assuming public `max-age` cache will refresh instantly.
- **Acceptance:** publish/archive announcement, update redirect, publish navigation → API/CDN reflects governed change within defined SLA; invalidation event dispatched and failure observable; stale ETag not incorrectly reused.

### CMS-ADM-012 — P1 — Scheduler failed jobs can become terminal without governed retry

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:1041-1117` obtains due jobs using Serializable `SKIP LOCKED`, but `:1107-1117` marks *any* failure `FAILED`; selection at `:1052-1055` fetches only `PENDING`. No retry scheduling/backoff or failure-category distinction in this method. The admin endpoint accepts a caller-provided `now` (`CmsAdminRouter.ts:333-336`) and worker handler uses runtime clock (`CmsScheduledPublishingBackgroundJobHandler.ts:10-14`).
- **Fix:** implement bounded retry/backoff, a dead-letter/repair path, failure categories and monitoring; prevent admin arbitrary future clock from terminally failing legitimate jobs or require operationally privileged dry-run/controlled clock. Keep already correct lease and SKIP LOCKED primitives.
- **Acceptance:** transient database/asset outage → retry then publish once; future `now` from admin cannot permanently fail not-yet-due jobs; poison job escalates with reason and manual replay; no double publish/outbox.

### CMS-ADM-013 — P1 — Scheduled lease expiry and publication are separate atomic boundaries

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:1043-1076` leases pending jobs for 60 seconds; `:1083-1105` calls separate `this.publish()` and only afterward completes job via `:1123-1135`; a long operation can lose/reclaim the lease after external public publication and before marking complete.
- **Fix:** bind job execution to immutable schedule version and claim identity; re-check lease at commit or make publication idempotent on `(localizedId,approvedVersion,jobId)`, heartbeats for long tasks and exactly-once externally visible semantics.
- **Acceptance:** two workers/expired lease/fail after publication each yield one public revision and outbox publication event, with final job COMPLETED; successful reconciled replay doesn't duplicate audit or publish.

### CMS-ADM-014 — P1 — Cancel/restore/change-slug do not consistently reconcile scheduled jobs

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:392-400` explicitly cancels PENDING jobs; `:538-573` restoreRevision sets locale DRAFT/scheduledAt null without cancelling outstanding scheduled jobs; `:765-785` changeLocalizedSlug similarly resets DRAFT with no scheduled-job update; `:1144-1189` scheduling jobs can exist separately.
- **Fix:** centralize all locale-to-DRAFT/identity changes through one transition that cancels/invalidates outstanding jobs in same transaction and records reason. Enforce job target expected version/approval digest even when job was previously claimed.
- **Acceptance:** restore/change-slug while SCHEDULED never causes later stale job to publish; queued/claimed jobs reconcile to CANCELLED/STAL E (separate explicit status) with audit; newer valid schedule still executes.

### CMS-ADM-015 — P1 — Navigation targets are syntax-safe but not proven to exist or be published

- **Evidence:** `CmsPublishingPolicy.ts:41-51,53-79` validates HTTPS and cycle graph; `CmsUseCases.ts:292-303` calls those guards; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:874-902` publishes nav nodes after the same syntactic tests but no owner-backed resolution of `CMS_CONTENT` or `DOMAIN_REFERENCE` targets for locale/site/current publication.
- **Fix:** add owner-bound target resolver, route type mapping, live status and site/locale checks; constrain HTTPS external links to defined policy; preserve cycle and rel protections.
- **Acceptance:** nav link to missing/archived CMS record or unrelated tenant cannot publish; valid canonical domain target resolves to correct public URL; external javascript/http credentialized targets blocked.

### CMS-ADM-016 — P1 — Block schema governance and block lifecycle are not complete public capabilities

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminRouter.ts:304-315` accepts schema `status` as arbitrary string, `fieldSchema` and `assetFields` as generic payload, with same broad manage permission; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:911-935` creates schemas and saves blocks as DRAFT; `CmsPublicRouter.ts:37-85` has no public `/blocks` endpoint; no per-block approval/publish route is implemented in the reviewed router.
- **Fix:** formal reviewed+versioned schema policy, scoped technical schema-authority permission, bounded schema JSON validation, approved block publishing workflow and sanitized public projection or explicitly mark feature admin-draft-only in UI.
- **Acceptance:** non-technical editor cannot register arbitrary ACTIVE schema; draft blocks never appear publicly; approved block resolves for correct site+locale with assets; schema changes don't mutate existing published block interpretation.

### CMS-ADM-017 — P1 — Block nested asset fields are only checked for raw URLs, not ownership and lifecycle

- **Evidence:** `CmsPublishingPolicy.ts:122-136` walks schema-declared `assetFields` and calls `assertAssetHandle` for top-level string/array values only; `CmsUseCases.ts:311-313` saves blocks without `assertAssetReferencesUsable`; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:923-934` only applies schema validation.
- **Fix:** recursively extract declared asset handles and validate active EAP classification/mime, public grant, size and purpose, including nested arrays; revalidate when published. Fail closed for unconfigured EAP.
- **Acceptance:** block with raw URL, private asset, unknown ID or nested malicious handle rejected; valid referenced asset is stored by ID only.

### CMS-ADM-018 — P1 — Main CMS node ownership/site fields can be changed by generic PATCH without scoped governance

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminRouter.ts:47-61,112-121` admits `ownerId`, `siteIdentifier`, `primaryLocale`, `contentType` under same generic root update; `CmsUseCases.ts:61-70` passes partial DTO directly; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:73-103` spreads `values` into database row. No explicit allowed-field list tied to content status/site authority.
- **Fix:** separate immutable/ARB-governed identity from editable editorial fields; prohibit arbitrary owner reassignment/cross-site move; allow owner change only with identity-backed transfer policy, permissions and audit.
- **Acceptance:** actor cannot reassign owner to arbitrary ID or move published article across site; display name/summary changes preserve ownership, safe versioning and audit.

### CMS-ADM-019 — P1 — Announcements need comprehensive publication-window and audience validation

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminRouter.ts:321-332` accepts free-form `audience`; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:943-951,993-1011` verifies `expiresAt > startsAt`, not that `expiresAt` is after publication or that audience is a governed enum; `:938-940` public endpoint filters by active time only.
- **Fix:** define public audience contract and privacy-safe segment resolver; disallow already-expired publication, reject invalid `startsAt/expiresAt`, safely handle evergreen notices, and evaluate the audience at public delivery or narrow to public-only announcements.
- **Acceptance:** expired-before-publish notice rejected; targeted staff-only audience not returned in anonymous API; active public banner appears and expires deterministically under fake clock.

### CMS-ADM-020 — P1 — Public redirect API exposes editorial persistence DTO without explicit public minimization

- **Evidence:** `PublicCmsUseCases.ts:407-410` selects from `repository.listRedirects` and returns entire DTO; `CmsPublicRouter.ts:81-85` forwards the object as JSON. `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:789-798` returns persisted redirect rows containing `reason`, `createdBy`, `contentId` and audit-use metadata.
- **Fix:** create minimal public redirect response (`destinationPath`, `statusCode`) with status path allowlist; don't return creator IDs, internal rationale or foreign keys. Optionally implement safe redirect resolution at edge/router with cycle and no-open-redirect checks.
- **Acceptance:** anonymous redirect response excludes `createdBy`, `reason` and any private metadata; active path resolves properly; loop/unsafe path return safe status.

### CMS-ADM-021 — P1 — Public related-content lookup truncates before filtering published localized articles

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:743-762` first fetches `CmsContentDomainLink` limited to requested N and only afterward filters content to current `siteIdentifier`, locale and `PUBLISHED`; if early links are nonmatching/draft, valid later links are never considered.
- **Fix:** join/filter from published content first or use paginated/overfetch loop with stable unique ordering, preserving link sortOrder and no cross-site leakage.
- **Acceptance:** first six relations draft/archived plus six later published → API returns six eligible published items, not empty; stable order and tenant/locale isolation.

### CMS-ADM-022 — P1 — Admin UI lacks usable publish controls for navigation and announcements despite backend support

- **Evidence:** `CmsOperationsPanels.tsx:151-225,270-384` supports adding nav nodes and creating block/announcement drafts, lists status, but provides no action invoking `POST /navigation/:id/publish`, `POST /announcements/:id/publish` or archive even though `CmsAdminRouter.ts:300-332` has them. Resulting site operations may remain in DRAFT indefinitely.
- **Fix:** add guarded detail and publish/archive controls with explicit `expectedVersion`, review state, maker-checker identity, safe confirmation and 409 conflict UI; do not auto-publish on save.
- **Acceptance:** independent approver can publish nav/announcement from Admin UI, self-publisher blocked; conflict refreshes baseline; content remains draft until approval.

### CMS-ADM-023 — P1 — Canonical redirects and slug changes lack fully evidenced browser/SEO integration

- **Evidence:** `CmsUseCases.ts:271-287,407-410` manages redirects as records and `CmsPublicRouter.ts:81-85` exposes only a resolution JSON endpoint; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:765-784` inserts historical redirect. No guarantee from these source files that web routing/SSR recognizes the 301/308 response or that sitemap/canonical/hreflang updates propagate.
- **Fix:** trace actual public web router and CDN/SSR path middleware, implement status-aware 301/308 with cache purge and sitemap/hreflang rebuild, plus Link-test; do not rely on a redirect JSON API alone.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 16:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 11994 من الخطة الأصلية.

### CMS-ADM-024 — P2 — Read-model/search query needs bounded cost and indexes under realistic CMS volume

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminRouter.ts:36-45`, `CmsPublicRouter.ts:15-24` allow unbounded free-text `q`; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:156-196,625-660` executes `contains` across localized title/summary and public body, uses offset pagination and counts for each page. This is correct functionally but query cost and index plans are not proven.
- **Fix:** clamp query length, tighten indexes/search engine projection, constrain offset depth or cursor pagination, add rate/complexity budgets and EXPLAIN benchmarks; respect P5 Search ownership.
- **Acceptance:** long/empty queries handled correctly, deep page bounded, repeated search under representative content volume meets agreed p95, no cross-site result leakage.

### CMS-ADM-025 — P2 — Current-page review and calendar panels must not be mistaken for global review truth

- **Evidence:** `CmsOperationsPanels.tsx:230-270` derives both panels solely from `contents` supplied by current Admin page; `CmsAdminPage.tsx:209-238` loads one page (`pageSize:20`) of one site. Panel labels correctly say «الصفحة الحالية» but there is no authoritative global Queue/Calendar integration in this UI.
- **Fix:** keep preview explicitly labeled scoped, optionally link to global Review Queue (P24), and use dedicated paginated/permissioned CMS review/schedule endpoint when genuinely needed; never duplicate global Review Queue authority.
- **Acceptance:** 40 queued items across pages aren't misreported as total 0; links route to source-of-truth queue; filtered results remain visibly labeled.

### CMS-ADM-026 — P2 — Content detail and revision history are eager and lack page-bound UX

- **Evidence:** `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:115-153` loads localized tags/attachments/reviews plus up to 30 revisions per locale; `:525-536` listRevisions uses unbounded `findMany`; `CmsAdminPage.tsx:1139-1147` shows only five revisions even if many fetched. This may increase response sizes for long-lived articles.
- **Fix:** explicit revision cursor pagination + minimal list DTO; lazily fetch full revision payload for diff/restore, bound reviews and attachments by policy; cache only safe display data.
- **Acceptance:** article with 10,000 historical revisions opens without loading all; older revisions remain accessible; version-based restore still works.

### CMS-ADM-027 — P2 — Site Operations fetch is all-or-nothing and can leave stale panels on partial outage

- **Evidence:** `CmsOperationsPanels.tsx:85-112` uses `Promise.all` of redirects, navigation, schemas, blocks, announcements then updates all states at once; failure of one request leaves previous results in state and prevents current successful sections from refreshing.
- **Fix:** use per-capability `Promise.allSettled` with loading/error/updated-at per panel, invalidate old locale state when switching AR/EN, avoid misrepresenting stale success after partial failures.
- **Acceptance:** failed announcements request doesn't block fresh navigation, locale-switch never briefly shows wrong-locale redirects, error displays per section.

### CMS-ADM-028 — P2 — English locale/site experience and editor workflow remain Arabic-heavy

- **Evidence:** `CmsAdminPage.tsx:418-458,462-488,1060-1147` hardcodes Arabic workflow prompts and notices; `CmsOperationsPanels.tsx:235-385` hardcodes Arabic controls for both locales. Content supports `ar/en`, but console UI localization is not equivalent.
- **Fix:** extract text/ARIA/validation into approved i18n keys and apply RTL/LTR per input/preview, with consistent ISO datetime parsing, translation status and accessible feedback. Coordinate P17 localization section, avoid a second translation owner.
- **Acceptance:** switch Admin locale to English results in coherent English editor/errors/calendar and LTR slug/URL; Arabic RTL preserved; no duplicate translated content store.

### CMS-ADM-029 — P2 — Background-job audit actor classification is misleading

- **Evidence:** `CmsScheduledPublishingBackgroundJobHandler.ts:10-14` invokes publish with `actorId='system:background-worker'`; `PrismaCmsRepository.ts:1426-1459` persists `auditRecord.actorType: 'USER'` for all actions, including worker executions. This obscures provenance of scheduled operations.
- **Fix:** propagate typed `ActorContext` (SYSTEM vs USER), service identity and job/run id into editorial ledger, outbox, correlation and audit while retaining human reviewer approval identity.
- **Acceptance:** worker-triggered publish audit displays SYSTEM with job correlation; human publish displays USER; both preserve checker identity and source event.

### CMS-ADM-030 — P2 — Runtime migration, CDN, EAP, indexing, scheduler and real-RBAC closure remains pending

- **Evidence:** `docs/implementation-status/MANARATAK_CMS_DEEP_RESTRUCTURE_SOURCE_CLOSURE_2026-09-05.md:4-6,123-166,173-180` records **MIGRATIONS_APPLIED=0**, SOURCE-only verifiers and runtime pending; `MANARATAK-Phase16-CMS-Source-Closure-and-Google-Studio-Runbook.md:17-43` explicitly requires DB/EAP/CDN/worker/prod-role smoke testing. Current `apps/api/tests/presentation/api/router/CmsAdminRouter.spec.ts:59-116`, `CmsPublicRouter.spec.ts:24-67`, `packages/application/tests/cms/CmsUseCases.spec.ts:68-186` are largely mocked contracts, not runtime end-to-end evidence.
- **Fix:** produce separate approval-gated runtime validation matrix: schema migration dry run/recovery, access controls with real principals, localized publisher verification, scheduler failover, EAP revocation, CDN redirects, published snapshot, cross-domain owner validity and live sitemaps; never run migration/seed in audit mode.
- **Acceptance:** each runtime gate documented with independent evidence, environment and rollback; no claims of production PASS based solely on source scripts.

## 16.3 Implementation order, guards and dependencies

1. **Block public operational launch until** `CMS-ADM-001/002/003/004/005` are addressed and re-reviewed. These cover access, approval integrity and public site availability.
2. **Data-integrity sequence:** `006/007/008/009/014/017/018` alongside migration plans; current immutable public snapshots, origin-bound domain facts, EAP policies and audit/outbox remain mandatory.
3. **Public delivery and scheduled operations:** `010/011/012/013/015/019/020/021/023`, with approved integration smoke checks (no live changes from this audit).
4. **Editorial UX and performance:** `016/022/024/025/026/027/028/029`; share approval/translation authority with P24 Review Queue and P17 Localization, rather than cloning subsystems.
5. **Runtime gate:** `030`; keep `source verified` separate from `deployed verified`. Do not change executed DB state or push code during review.

## 16.4 Non-regression baseline

- Preserve `CmsPublishingPolicy.assertSafeRichText`, React-node renderer, asset-handle-only references, domain-owner boundaries, canonical SEO and localized publishing, last-known-good published copy, `assertAcyclicNavigation`, redirect graph safety, transaction-bound editorial ledger + audit + outbox and global admin auth.
- No new CMS-owned copies of scholarships, university/major catalogs, reference data, course content or student identity; CMS may hold canonical IDs only.
- Do not introduce a manual bypass to maker/checker, permit an author to self-approve, or silently republish drafts. Distinguish draft-editing from currently public revision.
- No DB migrations/backfills, external HTTP mutation, scheduler job execution, production cache purge or GitHub commits were performed as part of this review.

## 16.FG — Deep Functional & Feature Gap Audit (ملحق 11–20؛ لا يعيد المراجعة السابقة)

- **حالة الملحق:** SOURCE-CONFIRMED / PARTIAL / PROPOSAL as marked; REVIEWED, NOT IMPLEMENTED, RUNTIME-PENDING.
- **Baseline:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-` / `main` / `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca`. لم تُشغّل هذه الجولة قاعدة بيانات/متصفحًا حيًا أو تغيّر كود التطبيق.
- **فصل النطاق:** هذه الفجوات هي إمكانات الإدارة الناقصة فوق مراجعة الأمن/الترابط السابقة؛ كل أمر جديد يحتاج مقارنة مع مهام المالك السابقة قبل التنفيذ.
- **حدود التحقق:** نتائج المهام أدناه استنتاجات من ملفات المصدر وعقود API/Prisma؛ لم تُختبر الأزرار في متصفح مهيأ، ولم تُنفَّذ طلبات كتابة، ويجب عدم تحويل «متوقع/مقترح» إلى عطل Runtime مثبت.
- **الموجود/يُحفظ:** محتوى AR/EN، محرر + معاينة + مراجعة + جدولة + نشر/أرشفة، taxonomy، كتلة وإعلان وتحويل وتنقل؛ إظهار أدوات تشغيلية موجودة لا يعني اكتمال دورة تعديلها.

**مقارنة معيارية:** إدارة المواقع الاحترافية تحتاج دورة تصحيح redirects ومقارنة جاهزية المحتوى قبل النشر؛ لا نضيف نظام CMS موازيًا.

### سجل الفجوات الجديدة — 2 مهام

### FGA-16-001 — P1 — سجل تحويلات URL مع فتح/تصحيح/إيقاف من واجهة إدارة المحتوى

- **تصنيف الدليل/الحالة:** Create/list موجود؛ دورة تصحيح/تعطيل غائبة في Admin/API المعاينين.
- **الفجوة وسبب الحاجة:** قسم التحويلات في `CmsOperationsPanels` يسمح إنشاء تحويل ويعرض أول 4 فقط، بينما router يعرض GET/POST دون PATCH/retire. الخطأ في redirect منشور يحتاج طريقة تصحيح حوكمي آمنة دون اعتماد على تدخل قاعدة البيانات.
- **مثال تشغيلي:** مدير موقع يتبين أن تحويل `/en/old-scholarship` يؤدي إلى وجهة خاطئة؛ يريد تصحيحه مع التحقق من عدم خلق loop وبقاء أثر مراجعة.
- **الكود المرتبط:** `apps/admin/src/features/cms/CmsOperationsPanels.tsx:255-307`؛ `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/CmsAdminRouter.ts:280-292`؛ `CmsUseCases.ts`؛ `PrismaCmsRepository.ts`.
- **العمل الهندسي المقترح (Owner → API → Admin/Public/Student):** أضف owner API لتعديل/تعطيل redirect بأثر audit وexpectedVersion واختبار collision/loop، واجهة جدول بحث/status/صفحات + عرض target وآخر محرر؛ لا تقم بتحديث التحويل المباشر بلا سياسة cache/redirect-safe ضمن CMS-ADM-011.
- **الترابط/التأثير:** P16 Public SEO/Navigation وأي روابط جامعة أو منحة منشورة؛ يجب ألا تتجاوز author/publisher RBAC.
- **معايير القبول القابلة للاختبار:** يمكن البحث عن المصدر القديم ثم تعديل الوجهة واختبار 301/302 policy؛ loop وchain متكرر يرفض؛ audit يظهر actor/reason/diff؛ public cache يقرأ النسخة المصرح بها؛ مستخدم غير مخول لا يعدل.
- **منع التكرار:** CMS-ADM-011/023 يعالجان صحة SEO/cache والانتشار؛ هنا **أداة الإدارة الناقصة** لسجل redirects الموجود.

### FGA-16-002 — P2 — مقارنة جهوزية نشر نسختي المحتوى العربي والإنجليزي في محرر واحد

- **تصنيف الدليل/الحالة:** تحسين مراجع لفرق المحتوى متعددة اللغات.
- **الفجوة وسبب الحاجة:** `CmsAdminPage` يتيح تحرير/نشر locales بالتبديل بين ar/en، لكن المراجع لا يملك جدول مقارنة side-by-side للحقول المطلوبة والروابط والصور والمواعيد لكل نسخة قبل اعتماد النشر؛ يحتاج رؤية الاختلافات من owner readbacks.
- **مثال تشغيلي:** رئيس تحرير يشاهد أن المقال العربي مستوفٍ للملخص والـSEO والروابط، بينما الإنجليزي لم تكتمل فيه صورة الغلاف؛ يتجنب الموافقة قبل تصحيح الإنجليزية.
- **الكود المرتبط:** `apps/admin/src/pages/CmsAdminPage.tsx:167-292,575-606,829-1117`؛ `CmsAdminRouter.ts`؛ `CmsUseCases.ts`؛ owner readiness by locale.
- **العمل الهندسي المقترح (Owner → API → Admin/Public/Student):** لوحة read-only locale comparison ضمن detail تعرض completeness/revision/preview hash/required fields الحالية، وروابط «تحرير العربية/الإنجليزية» إلى نفس editor؛ لا تنشئ duplicate CMS translation state أو تفترض وجوب الاثنين لكل سجل إلا إذا سياسة النشر تلزم.
- **الترابط/التأثير:** P16 ↔ الترجمة متعددة اللغات ↔ Public؛ يعالج جودة المحتوى لا تكرار مالك الترجمة.
- **معايير القبول القابلة للاختبار:** للمستند ذات ar ready/en missing يظهر اختلاف واضح ومصدر blocker؛ اختيار tab locale يعرض revision الصحيح؛ بعد save/readiness تتحدث المقارنة؛ لا يمكن نشر الإنجليزية بواسطة زر عربية بالخطأ.
- **منع التكرار:** CMS-ADM-007 يتعلق بسلامة revision backend وCMS-ADM-028 بالنصوص المترجمة للواجهة؛ هنا أداة مراجعة المقارنة للناشر.

### بوابة إغلاق الملحق الخاصة بهذا القسم

1. قبل البرمجة، يراجع Codex تنفيذ الـOwner APIs وPrisma schema/migrations الفعلية ويبيّن الحقول الموجودة مقابل المستلزمات الجديدة؛ لا يعدّ تصميم الواجهة إثباتًا لحقيقة DB.
2. لكل وظيفة: أثبت GET/search/filter/total/page ثم mutation (إن وجدت)، RBAC deny وaudit reason، owner/public/student consistency، loading/empty/error/conflict/refresh.
3. أي إضافة تحتاج migration تُكتب Migration Source وخطة rollback فقط؛ **لا تُنفّذ على DB الإنتاج**، ولا يُنشر أو يُرسل إشعار أو يُخصم مبلغ في المراجعة.
4. الشروط أعلاه Acceptance مستقبلية، وليست نتائج اختبار تم تشغيلها؛ لا تُغلق المهام تلقائيًا.

# 17 — الترجمات والتعدد اللغوي / Localization & Translation Governance

> **إكمال مصدر 14 أكتوبر 2026:** أُكملت إصلاحات حوكمة النقل وقراءة المركز وlocale/SEO، وأُغلقت فجوة English gate في CMS HTML/sitemap وخلط لغة الرابط مع reader. نجحت127 اختبارات خفيفة في26 ملفًا و11 Node وTypeScript؛ [تقرير القسم17 الصحيح](SECTION_17_LOCALIZATION_COMPLETION_2026-10-14.md). **English release/translation authoring مقفلان**؛ copy1090 ملاحظة في غرفة الدراسة لا تُعلن مكتملة، وLOC-ADM-024 مؤجل لما بعد28. الأحكام القديمة أدناه تاريخية، وليس هذا إكمالًا للقسم18/AI.

> **معيار الإغلاق المحدّث للقسم 17:** إصلاح الأكواد والثغرات والنواقص + اختبارات source/contract/security خفيفة مستهدفة + رفع Commit. **لا يلزم هنا E2E حي أو قاعدة بيانات/مزود تشغيل فعلي**؛ اختبارات التشغيل في الملحق الأخير بعد القسم 28، مع بقاء إطلاق الإنتاج محظورًا دون أدلته.
> **الاختبار الأساسي المختصر:** Localization: اختيار اللغة دون خلط بيانات AR/EN، قواعد النشر والـRTL/LTR على مستوى المصدر/المكونات.


## 17.1 نطاق التدقيق وحدوده

- **Source baseline:** `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-`, `main`, HEAD `bac768e7fcd76e5702697760669449b39b0e2cca`، مراجعة قراءة فقط في 2026-10-08، دون تعديل للمستودع أو اتصال بقاعدة إنتاج.
- **Trace:** `apps/admin/src/pages/AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx` و`apps/admin/src/i18n/{I18nProvider,ar,en}.tsx/ts` → `packages/shared/src/localization/{policy,locale}.ts` → `packages/application/src/{localization,translation-import}` و`packages/infrastructure/src/translation-import/PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts` → University/Major/Test/Course/Scholarship owner projections → `apps/web/src/{router/index.tsx,i18n,seo,api}` و`PublicTemplateApp.tsx` → `packages/infrastructure/prisma/migrations/20260817010000_translation_phase7_11_extensions/migration.sql` → `tests/translation/*` وsource status docs.
- **Scope/ownership:** مركز الترجمات **واجهة قراءة وتشخيص** وليس صاحب حقيقة جامعات/تخصصات/اختبارات/منح/دورات/CMS. المصدر المركزي يثبت `TRANSLATION_CONTENT_MODE='INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY'`، وجميع `contentAuthoringAllowed=false` (`packages/shared/src/localization/policy.ts:46-128`). **هذا قرار حوكمي صحيح مقصود، لا يجوز إزالته أو تبديله تلقائيًا لإصلاح شاشة غير نشطة**؛ أي تمكين لاحق يستلزم ARB وعملًا منفصلًا مع Review Queue وP6 وملكيّات المجالات.
- **Positive controls to preserve:** locale resolution priority/fallback semantics (`locale.ts:59-132`)، UI read-only and guard (`AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:358,494-500,971-1106`)، API field-level write blocks via `assertNoTranslationPayloadFields`، University PUBLISHED-only filter (`ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:36,137-146`)، source snapshot identity/stale-value checks (`PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:24-43`)، public canonical identity URLs and locale params، tests for dictionary key parity and source safety. Do not report green source-verifier claims as executed runtime tests.
- **Evidence classification:** findings below are source-observed contract gaps; missing runtime wiring/authorization/migrations are **unproven exposure** unless specifically stated. Source-only historical runbooks explicitly list `PUBLIC_TEMPLATE_COPY_MIGRATION_PENDING`, `RUNTIME_DB_PROOF_PENDING`, and DB migrations not executed (`docs/implementation-status/translation/MANARATAK_TRANSLATION_LOCALIZATION_SOURCE_EXECUTION_2026-09-05.md:1-6,79-120,142-149`).

## 17.2 Codex remediation tasks — actual paths, precise fixes and acceptance

### LOC-ADM-001 — P0 — English public route can activate before the documented copy-parity release gate

- **Evidence:** `apps/web/src/router/index.tsx:40-53,76-83` recognizes `/:locale?` and renders `/en` routes without a presentation-copy readiness condition. `apps/web/src/features/public-template/PublicTemplateApp.tsx:987-1014,1023-1036` has Arabic-only loading/error prose inside the live public component; `docs/implementation-status/translation/MANARATAK_TRANSLATION_LOCALIZATION_SOURCE_EXECUTION_2026-09-05.md:79-97,142-149` declares public English activation fail-closed until hardcoded Arabic TSX copy is localized. Shared Web dictionary parity is not equivalent to complete template coverage.
- **Impact/fix:** a crawler or visitor can receive `/en` page shells with substantial Arabic interface content and a declared English canonical. Introduce a centrally governed `publicEnglishCopyReady` release/route gate (source-configured, not inferred from route), reject/redirect or noindex unsupported `/en` shells consistently; extract real public-template literals into semantic dictionary keys, test fully localized content and release English only on proven parity. Retain Arabic route and existing fallback behavior.
- **Negative/regression acceptance:** cold-load `/en` before gate → no indexable mixed-language page; `/ar` remains correct. After gate, visit English main template, loading/error/account/detail/menu/empty states and assert no unexplained Arabic copy; canonical/hreflang reflect only actually enabled locales. No live activation from this review.

### LOC-ADM-002 — P1 — Translation-import transfer can bypass the central infrastructure-only write freeze when invoked

- **Evidence:** `packages/shared/src/localization/policy.ts:46-53,130-163` centrally blocks content translation authoring; `packages/application/src/translation-import/TranslationImportTransferService.ts:11-29` checks approval/dryRun but **does not call** `assertTranslationContentAuthoringEnabled`; `packages/infrastructure/src/translation-import/PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:20-56,202-297` updates owner tables directly. **No public route or active job exposing this transfer has been demonstrated by this review**.
- **Impact/fix:** a future caller/wiring could write imported translation content while governance still says disabled. Add fail-closed feature-mode assertion at the transfer entry **and repository mutation boundary**, with an explicitly governed ARB activation contract for later P6-to-owner transfer. Do not activate imports/seeds/backfills as an audit fix.
- **Acceptance:** `INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY` invocation against service *and* gateway denies before any Prisma writes; dry-run/REJECT remain denied; an authorized future work-package may test source-only transfer under an explicitly enabled, narrowly scoped test policy.

### LOC-ADM-003 — P1 — Translation import approval is not bound to an authenticated checker/review artifact

- **Evidence:** `packages/application/src/translation-import/TranslationImportContracts.ts:44-58` models `reviewStatus:'APPROVED'` in candidate and `{decision:'APPLY', reviewedBy:string}` in a caller-supplied approval; `TranslationImportTransferService.ts:11-29` checks only string nonemptiness and status; `PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:300-332` embeds that reviewer in metadata. The inspected transfer contract has no authenticated principal, immutable approval ID/signature, reviewer separation or reviewer authorization check.
- **Impact/fix:** on eventual enablement, a caller could assert an arbitrary approver. Consume trusted, persisted Review Queue decision with reviewer principal and authorized role, approval version/hash, distinct maker/checker, and idempotent approval identity. Preserve P6 import ownership and no runtime write while frozen.
- **Acceptance:** forged reviewer string, self-approval, replayed/stale approval, missing approved review record → 403/409 with no owner writes; valid independent approved artifact applies exactly once after governed enablement.

### LOC-ADM-004 — P1 — Imported University records marked APPROVED are invisible to PUBLISHED-only public projection

- **Evidence:** `packages/infrastructure/src/translation-import/PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:202-240` writes `UniversityTranslation.reviewStatus='APPROVED'`, but `packages/application/src/localization/ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:36,137-146` publicly selects only `PUBLISHED`. The writer does not perform an approved→published owner workflow.
- **Impact/fix:** a successful import transfer may be reported as completed translation while the English/Arabic public value remains the old source or fallback. Define a **separate owner-controlled publish step** and report `importApplied`, `approved`, `published`, `publicEligible` distinctly. Do not weaken public filter to auto-publish imports.
- **Acceptance:** imported APPROVED value remains nonpublic; authorized owner publication switches public value once; UI differentiates approved-but-not-published; rollback/rejected remains hidden.

### LOC-ADM-005 — P1 — Translation-import gateway bypasses owner audit/outbox and versioned publication choreography

- **Evidence:** `PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:20-56,202-297` performs direct `universityTranslation.upsert`, `major.update`, `majorContentSection.update/create` in Prisma transaction but contains no `auditRecord`, transactional outbox append, owner version event or locale cache invalidation. University and Major owning modules use their own governance boundaries; the transfer gateway is not their audited use-case.
- **Impact/fix:** eventual imports may modify content without activity proof, projection invalidation, search indexing or version events. Send approved transfer through an **owner-approved atomic mutation port** (or co-transaction with owner audit/outbox) with correlation, actor, source hash, previous/new field diff. Do not duplicate canonical data in Translation domain.
- **Acceptance:** each applied transfer produces exactly one owner audit/outbox record with previous hash/source; simulated audit/outbox failure rolls back target write; public/search projections update after committed event; frozen mode produces zero effects.

### LOC-ADM-006 — P1 — Major-name imported translations omit provenance and review lifecycle

- **Evidence:** `PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:244-254` writes only `major.localizedNameAr/En` based on locale, while University and MajorContentSection writes have `withEvidence` and `reviewStatus` (`:202-240,257-298`); `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:234-250` can display major root localized names directly.
- **Impact/fix:** imported major label can lose reviewer, source artifact and approval-version trace and become an indistinguishable public candidate. Add separate canonical major-name translation provenance/status or approved revision relation via ARB; keep stable `Major` identity. Read only owner-approved/published names as policy requires.
- **Acceptance:** trace public label to original reviewed import, timestamp, locale and owner version; nonapproved replacement never overwrites live approved value; frozen import still denies write.

### LOC-ADM-007 — P1 — Stale translation diff checks only the text value, not approval/provenance revisions

- **Evidence:** `TranslationImportPreparationService.ts:49-73` captures `expectedCurrentValue` and `target.currentReviewStatus`; `PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:25-43` validates identity and compares only `currentValue`, not `currentReviewStatus`, source/version or recorded approval digest, before an update; `:38-39` returns `NO_CHANGE` without considering review status.
- **Impact/fix:** an approval may be applied after another reviewer changes state/source while text stays the same, or `NO_CHANGE` masks required status reconciliation. Include owner translation row version/review status/source hash in signed candidate snapshot, CAS in same transaction, and explicit `NO_CHANGE_VALUE_BUT_REVIEW_CHANGED` handling.
- **Acceptance:** two candidates with same text but differing approval/provenance do not silently pass; concurrent review/state changes yield `STALE_DIFF_REVIEW_REQUIRED`, with zero partial target writes.

### LOC-ADM-008 — P1 — University Translation Center counts draft/review-needed labels as complete coverage

- **Evidence:** `apps/admin/src/pages/AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:218-230` counts any nonempty University translation whose status is not `REJECTED` — including `NEEDS_REVIEW` and `APPROVED` — as present; `packages/application/src/localization/ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:36,137-146` only serves `PUBLISHED`. UI disclaimer `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:735-741` correctly notes name presence ≠ publication, but the `COMPLETE`/`MISSING_*` labels still conflate operational readiness if used as launch report.
- **Impact/fix:** maintain separate `hasValue`, `reviewed`, `published`, `publicUsable`, and `sourceFallback` states in coverage read model and distinct metrics; retain raw-name counts only when explicitly labeled.
- **Acceptance:** a University EN `NEEDS_REVIEW` or `APPROVED` label cannot count in public EN readiness; after publish it does. No false global completion from a page-local count.

### LOC-ADM-009 — P1 — Major/Test and Scholarship/Course coverage cannot substantiate bilingual publication readiness

- **Evidence:** `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:225-244` uses nonempty `localizedNameAr/En` for MAJOR/INTERNATIONAL_TEST and compatibility `optionalFields.localizedNames` for SCHOLARSHIP/COURSE; it does not inspect content version, owner publication state or per-field approval. `packages/shared/src/localization/policy.ts:55-110` records different storage owners and `MIGRATION_DESIGN_REQUIRED` for compatibility overlays.
- **Impact/fix:** show storage-specific raw value availability separately from authoritative public translation readiness; fetch owner-published/versioned projection when supported and explicitly mark `UNKNOWN/PENDING_RUNTIME` otherwise. Avoid inferring readiness from legacy optional fields or inventing a new Translation-owned data store.
- **Acceptance:** unapproved explicit/overlay names yield `VALUE_PRESENT_NOT_PUBLIC_READY` or unknown; a real published owner value is counted only via authoritative response.

### LOC-ADM-010 — P1 — Translation coverage filters run only on the fetched page

- **Evidence:** `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:369-399` fetches owner lists with `pageSize=40`, then `:404-425` computes counts and MISSING_AR/EN/COMPLETE filters locally on `records` from that page; page navigation `:868-899` occurs before data-wide coverage filtering. Search is sometimes local when owner has no `searchParam` (`:417-420`).
- **Impact/fix:** filters may show zero missing records despite missing values in other pages; global rollout planning is misleading. Provide paginated owner-side coverage endpoint/facet count (or explicitly relabel as current-page filter); preserve canonical owner pagination and performance boundaries.
- **Acceptance:** with 80 records and missing EN only on page 2, `MISSING_EN` global result/count includes it; cursor/page navigation yields stable totals and respects query/domain filters.

### LOC-ADM-011 — P1 — Source-locale detection chooses first source record rather than authoritative/current provenance

- **Evidence:** `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:247-254` uses `values?.find(...)` to pick first supported sourceLocale from `University.sourceRecords`/Major sources; `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:132-159,492-517` also derives source fallback from source/version information. A historical first record does not necessarily represent active authoritative source-language context.
- **Impact/fix:** establish deterministic owner version/source selection (`current/verified`, then timestamp/id tie-break), present provenance and distinguish missing/ambiguous. Do not edit original source names when switching locales.
- **Acceptance:** two conflicting source locales with archived versus current records resolve to current verified source or `AMBIGUOUS`, never silently to array order; public and admin show the same provenance.

### LOC-ADM-012 — P1 — Public locale fallback is returned as a value without surfaced provenance/readiness

- **Evidence:** `packages/shared/src/localization/locale.ts:84-132` computes resolution with `availability` of requested/source/fallback/missing; `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:43-74` returns `{value,resolution}` but domain projectors commonly consume `.value` only, e.g. university `:148-160`, major `:240-249`, test `:292-300`. The projected DTO does not consistently propagate field-level resolution to public clients.
- **Impact/fix:** English pages may display source Arabic text as though translated. Add non-sensitive `requestedLocale`, `resolvedLocale`, `availability`, and optional `missingTranslationFields` to presentation metadata where domain contracts allow; use to label fallback and drive SEO/activation decisions without hiding valid source data.
- **Acceptance:** EN missing/AR fallback response explicitly says resolvedLocale=ar and availability=FALLBACK/SOURCE; EN published true is correctly distinguished; no domain IDs or numeric facts change.

### LOC-ADM-013 — P1 — Inconsistent public exposure states for Major/Test vs University translations

- **Evidence:** `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:36-38` allows University `PUBLISHED`, Major sections `PUBLISHED|APPROVED`, International Test blocks `APPROVED`; selection code at `:390-465` returns eligible owner content directly. Different statuses might be intentional owner policy, but no single **publicEligibility decision** is encoded, and a Major section also permits `reviewStatus===undefined` (`:395-399`).
- **Impact/fix:** an approved/unreviewed section can be served publicly without a clear release gate when domain publication differs. Ask ARB to codify `publicEligibility` per owner/field/version and replace permissive status checks with owner-lifecycle-aware decisions, retaining owner distinctions (do not blindly require all domains to use the same enum).
- **Acceptance:** Major section `undefined` or APPROVED and Test block APPROVED are tested against owner-specific publication gate; only explicitly eligible content leaves Public API; University behavior remains unchanged unless owner policy authorizes.

### LOC-ADM-014 — P1 — SEO alternates are generated for unavailable English translations

- **Evidence:** `apps/web/src/seo/localeSeo.ts:26-46` emits alternates for both `SUPPORTED_LOCALES` unconditionally; `tests/translation/multilingual-seo.spec.ts:22-59` tests symmetric links, while translation runbook `docs/implementation-status/translation/MANARATAK_TRANSLATION_LOCALIZATION_SOURCE_EXECUTION_2026-09-05.md:22-27,79-96` requires mixed-language English publication fail-closed.
- **Impact/fix:** `hreflang="en"` may identify an untranslated or gated page. Build alternate URLs from actually published/eligible locales for dynamic entities and from enabled public-template locales for static shell; canonical of delivered localized/fallback page must reflect the served approved version.
- **Acceptance:** AR-only publication → no EN hreflang/indexable EN canonical; AR+EN approved published → reciprocal canonical/hreflang plus x-default; fallback direct URL is consistently noindex/redirect as agreed.

### LOC-ADM-015 — P1 — Web language context and URL are separate authorities during locale switching

- **Evidence:** `apps/web/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx:30-41` changes state/storage in `setLanguage` but does not change path; `apps/web/src/router/index.tsx:40-53` independently drives language from `/ar|en` route; `apps/web/src/api/client.ts:3-11` derives requests from `window.location.pathname` first. The code has no guaranteed atomic operation synchronizing all three in the provider.
- **Impact/fix:** when any caller sets language without navigation, UI context can diverge from canonical URL and API locale; route reconciliation may reset selection. Centralize the public language switch as locale-prefixed navigation, preserving search/hash and locale-specific entity slugs, and derive API locale from that one route context.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 17:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 12200 من الخطة الأصلية.

### LOC-ADM-016 — P1 — Localization import coverage does not validate all configured translation domain targets

- **Evidence:** `TranslationImportContracts.ts:4-6` limits import target kinds to `UNIVERSITY|MAJOR`; `TranslationImportPreparationService.ts:13-15,81-84,87-121` classifies only `INS-*` and MJR/MAS/DOC/FEL IDs. `packages/shared/src/localization/policy.ts:55-128` also enumerates Tests, Scholarships, Courses, CMS, Reference and UI as separately owned translation domains.
- **Impact/fix:** do not present P6 translation-import preparation as a generic all-domain importer. Enforce/advertise explicit University/Major-only support in import UX/API and reject unsupported handoffs with precise domain status; later additive adapters require owner contracts, approval and source-only migration design.
- **Acceptance:** supported exact University/Major handoff prepares; Test/Scholarship/Course/CMS etc return `UNSUPPORTED_TARGET_OWNER` without owner writes; coverage dashboard does not claim those imports are supported.

### LOC-ADM-017 — P1 — Public English activation gate does not include field-level content coverage of source data

- **Evidence:** `docs/implementation-status/translation/MANARATAK_TRANSLATION_LOCALIZATION_SOURCE_EXECUTION_2026-09-05.md:79-97` describes UI-copy parity, while `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:225-244,404-425` covers only names; `ApplicationLocaleProjectionService.ts:132-231,285-465` translates descriptive University children, Major sections and Test blocks with fallback. A name-complete record is not a detail-page translation-complete record.
- **Impact/fix:** create owner-provided required-field readiness profiles per public page (name, description, section text, requirements, active versions, CTA and fallback policy); distinguish English shell copy parity from owner-domain data translation; let ARB decide which page types may be published with partial source fallback.
- **Acceptance:** EN page with translated title but missing required sections cannot receive `fullyLocalized=true` or indexable EN release; complete approved content produces positive readiness; no impossible all-domain blanket barrier.

### LOC-ADM-018 — P2 — Non-guarded localStorage read can break public locale initialization in restricted browsers

- **Evidence:** `apps/web/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx:29-36` calls `localStorage.getItem` directly during render initializer; `apps/web/src/router/index.tsx:50-53` does likewise for legacy URL redirect. By contrast admin has defensive `safeGetItem` (`apps/admin/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx:27-47`).
- **Fix:** use safe adapter or try/catch, default to URL locale then Arabic without hydration failure; no storage available should not crash. **Acceptance:** mocked throwing storage with `/en/...`, `/ar/...`, bare legacy route renders safe deterministic path/locale, persists nothing.

### LOC-ADM-019 — P2 — UI dictionary integrity tests cover only two route-shell files for missing keys

- **Evidence:** `tests/translation/ui-i18n-integrity.spec.ts:33-73` checks AR/EN dictionary *key parity* and literal `t('key')` uses only in `apps/web/src/router/index.tsx` and `apps/admin/src/App.tsx`; it does not statically enumerate component/template pages where untranslated inline Arabic/English remains (documented in translation runbook `:79-97`).
- **Fix:** expand semantic key extraction and copy-parity coverage to route components, shared UI and CMS shell; allow approved branded names, proper nouns and cited quotations. **Acceptance:** intentionally missing translation key or untranslated interactive button in a sampled deep public component fails CI with file/line; both language dictionaries pass.

### LOC-ADM-020 — P2 — Locale query parser accepts conflicting repeated locale parameters by taking the last value

- **Evidence:** `apps/api/src/presentation/api/locale/LocaleQueryContract.ts:11-23` normalizes an array query with `.at(-1)`; routes elsewhere may validate `locale` via different Zod schemas. The same URL can contain `?locale=ar&locale=en` with interpretation dependent on parser.
- **Fix:** establish consistent strict request normalization across public APIs; reject multiple conflicting locale params as 400 rather than silently taking last, while retaining normal single-value/default behavior. **Acceptance:** duplicate/conflicting locale query returns clear validation error; single supported locale and default remain unchanged.

### LOC-ADM-021 — P2 — Translation import NO_CHANGE has no durable per-handoff processing receipt

- **Evidence:** `TranslationImportPreparationService.ts:160-168` builds a staging key; `PrismaTranslationImportGateway.ts:25-40` returns `NO_CHANGE` on equal text, and `:300-332` stores evidence only on write of University/section records. No persisted per-handoff receipt is written on NO_CHANGE, and Major name changes omit evidence (see LOC-ADM-006).
- **Fix:** when transfers are activated, persist owner-scoped reviewed handoff receipt (including no-op outcome, approval ID, correlation, target digest) and unique replay constraint, without importing during infrastructure-only mode. **Acceptance:** replay returns stable prior outcome; NO_CHANGE trace exists; repeated event does not duplicate audit/change.

### LOC-ADM-022 — P2 — Translation Center detail readback and selection lifecycle need race-proof tests

- **Evidence:** `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:363-400,428-459,494-575` uses generation counters and a write/readback-failed latch; it also resets selected record on list reload and preserves editable draft portions after save. These safeguards are reasonable but not exercised by a dedicated concurrent locale-switch/selection/mutation integration suite found in the reviewed source tests.
- **Fix:** add RTL/LTR UI tests for stale list/detail response, concurrent page/domain switching, dirty editor guard, save-success/readback-failure recovery and preserving the other locale draft. Do not enable edits while policy frozen.
- **Acceptance:** slow response from old domain never paints new-domain detail; staged but unsaved EN text survives an AR save; no silent repeated mutation after failed readback.

### LOC-ADM-023 — P2 — UI coverage dashboard lacks source-data lifecycle/failure observability

- **Evidence:** `AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:404-425,614-643` reports loaded/missing AR/EN/complete counts on fetched page; `packages/shared/src/localization/policy.ts:55-128` has runtimeRequirement metadata, but data-model state (`migration pending`, `source only`, `unverified`, `published`) is not reflected as separate measurable categories in these counters.
- **Fix:** add non-mutating per-domain cards for `coverageScope=PAGE/GLOBAL`, ownerSourceStatus, runtimeProof, migrationRequired, rejected/pending/published counts; link to owning admin area without cloning approval and import workflows.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 17:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 12244 من الخطة الأصلية.

### LOC-ADM-024 — P2 — Source-only verification cannot establish live localized release integrity

- **Evidence:** `docs/implementation-status/translation/MANARATAK_TRANSLATION_INFRASTRUCTURE_SOURCE_CLOSURE_2026-09-05.md:58-95` reports source gates passed but `MIGRATION_APPLIED=NO`, deferred DB/Runtime and deferred English activation; `tests/translation/*` tests static routing, schema/dictionary predicates and projections, not end-to-end migrated DB → Admin → API → Public under real permissions.
- **Fix:** prepare an approved **future** runtime evidence plan only: schema/backups, read-only localization coverage queries, owner-stage review permissions, transfer frozen-mode checks, AR/EN browser snapshots, sitemap/canonical/alternate checks, CDN/Redis and rollback evidence. Do not execute production DB migrations, seeds or import transfers from this review.
- **Acceptance:** runtime checklist labels each gate `UNRUN` until evidence exists; source test success never auto-marks `TRANSLATION_RUNTIME_CLOSED`; stage read-only smoke proofs documented before any ARB-approved activation.

## 17.3 تنفيذ الإصلاحات وترابط الأقسام

1. **Freeze-first:** `LOC-ADM-002/003/005/007/021` requires coordination with P6 Import, owner applications, IAM/Audit/Outbox and global P24 Review Queue. Keep `INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY` active until an explicit ARB change; no UI button or copied `reviewStatus='APPROVED'` may bypass it.
2. **Public release safety:** `001/004/012/013/014/015/017` determine public eligibility, source fallback, SEO and locale identity; coordinate with P16 CMS, P9 Tests, P10 Majors, P11 Universities, P12 Scholarships and P13 Courses. Do not erase owner-specific publication policy or create secondary canonical entities.
3. **Accurate administration:** `006/008/009/010/011/016/023` distinguish name present / translation reviewed / public published / source fallback / runtime unproven. Preserve the existing read-only cross-domain Translation Center.
4. **Production safety & regression:** `018/019/020/022/024`. Source-only review cannot prove live migrations, external asset availability, language content quality or real SEO crawler behavior.

## 17.4 Non-regression contract

- Preserve official Arabic-first brand and Cairo typography, real locale-prefixed public routes, canonical identity and owner-domain translation policy. English is secondary **and must not be represented as fully released before copy/field parity evidence**.
- Preserve centralized `TRANSLATION_CONTENT_MODE='INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY'`; `canAuthorDomainTranslations` and `assertNoTranslationPayloadFields` fail-closed; no new translation authored, imported, seeded or backfilled during this review.
- Preserve source locale as provenance, not a translation; do not silently count English field fallback from Arabic as English translation. Preserve original names, AR/EN and other multilingual aliases, while avoiding duplicate University/Major/Test canonical records.
- Existing static tests and historical source-verification scripts were **inspected, not executed**. No repository commits, code modifications, database migrations, live API writes or deployment actions performed.

- **حالة الملحق:** SOURCE-CONFIRMED / PARTIAL / PROPOSAL as marked; REVIEWED, NOT IMPLEMENTED, RUNTIME-PENDING.

- **فصل النطاق:** هذه الفجوات هي إمكانات الإدارة الناقصة فوق مراجعة الأمن/الترابط السابقة؛ كل أمر جديد يحتاج مقارنة مع مهام المالك السابقة قبل التنفيذ.

**مقارنة معيارية:** ترجمة منصة عالمية تحتاج queue لمراجعي المحتوى بجانب نسب التغطية؛ owner يظل مسؤولًا عن قرار النشر/الموافقة.

### سجل الفجوات الجديدة — مهمة واحدة

### FGA-17-001 — P2 — قائمة إجراءات ترجمة موزعة حسب مالك المحتوى والمراجع المستهدف

- **تصنيف الدليل/الحالة:** فرز التغطية موجود فقط؛ inbox مسؤولية المراجعة غير موجودة.
- **الفجوة وسبب الحاجة:** واجهة الترجمة تعرض خمسة Domains (منح/جامعات/تخصصات/اختبارات/دورات) مع فلاتر تغطية اسمية، ولكن لا تعرض قائمة «ما الذي يحتاج مني مراجعة» وفق workflow owner-specific/status/evidence. يجب عدم جعل المركز مخزن سلطة ترجمة مستقلًا.
- **مثال تشغيلي:** مدقق الإنجليزية يختار «الجامعات المضافة هذا الأسبوع التي تحتاج مراجعة ترجمة الاسم والوصف»، ثم ينتقل إلى سجل الجامعة المسؤول عن approval.
- **الكود المرتبط:** `apps/admin/src/pages/AdminTranslationWorkspacePage.tsx:64-173,310-425,740-900`؛ `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/UniversityAdminRouter.ts`؛ `apps/admin/src/pages/ScholarshipCatalogDetailPage.tsx`؛ owner translation APIs.
- **العمل الهندسي المقترح (Owner → API → Admin/Public/Student):** إنشاء read-only work queue يستعلم عن owner review states مع cursor/status/locale/domain/updatedFrom؛ action = deep link إلى approval flow للمالك وتفويضه؛ عدم توليد APPROVED/PUBLISHED من مجرد وجود نص.
- **الترابط/التأثير:** P11/P12/P9/P10/P13 ↔ localization release gate؛ فصل تحرير النص عن اعتماده.
- **معايير القبول القابلة للاختبار:** سجلا ترجمة لهما نفس الاسم لكن status مختلف يظهران منفصلين؛ admin reviewer لا يحفظ في domain بلا RBAC؛ pagination total يستند للخادم؛ عدم ظهور saved field يظل NEEDS_REVIEW لا «مكتمل»؛ link ينقل إلى السجل الصحيح.
- **منع التكرار:** LOC-ADM-008/010/023 تتعلق بمقياس coverage ومحدودية page؛ المهمة الجديدة تخص توزيع مهام المراجعين وسياق قرار owner.

### بوابة إغلاق الملحق الخاصة بهذا القسم

1. قبل البرمجة، يراجع Codex تنفيذ الـOwner APIs وPrisma schema/migrations الفعلية ويبيّن الحقول الموجودة مقابل المستلزمات الجديدة؛ لا يعدّ تصميم الواجهة إثباتًا لحقيقة DB.
2. لكل وظيفة: أثبت GET/search/filter/total/page ثم mutation (إن وجدت)، RBAC deny وaudit reason، owner/public/student consistency، loading/empty/error/conflict/refresh.
3. أي إضافة تحتاج migration تُكتب Migration Source وخطة rollback فقط؛ **لا تُنفّذ على DB الإنتاج**، ولا يُنشر أو يُرسل إشعار أو يُخصم مبلغ في المراجعة.
4. الشروط أعلاه Acceptance مستقبلية، وليست نتائج اختبار تم تشغيلها؛ لا تُغلق المهام تلقائيًا.
