### Verified engineering strengths — preserve, don't undo

- Source CI actually declares schema validation/generation, TypeScript typechecking, linting, builds, source/unit tests and SBOM artifacts (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:62-98`), but its failure prevents a green result.
- Security workflow uses pinned actions and performs CodeQL, dependency audit and secret scan (`.github/workflows/security.yml:20-64`); no proposal here to bypass security gates.
- `ProductionReadinessValidator` explicitly checks strict admin mode, production secrets, worker config, asset provider and telemetry (`packages/config/src/ProductionReadinessValidator.ts:30-192`); §§25–26 separately document semantic defects; avoid duplicating them here.
- Prisma uses actual domain FKs for University programs/admission tests, canonical scholarship relationships and scoped student workspace ownership (`packages/infrastructure/prisma/schema.prisma:1322-1385,1557-1796,2770-2868`), albeit incomplete edges already in §27.
- Student routes require principal authentication, student role, idempotency and owner checks (`apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/StudentWorkspaceRouter.ts:112-127`); owner-local privacy risks remain in §15.
- API has separate liveness/readiness contracts (`apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/MonitoringRouter.ts:45-63`) and a dedicated API server with drain hooks (`apps/api/src/server.ts:9-47,56-116`).
- Recovery has source safeguards and a disposable DB test harness (`scripts/database/verify-greenfield-migration-parity.sh:14-39`, `packages/infrastructure/tests/database/WholePlatformPersistence.integration.spec.ts:23-77`); **they must be executed with authorized disposable resources before closing**.

## 28.4 NEW actionable Codex tasks — final release/runtime layer only

### FSA-001 — P0 — Baseline CI is demonstrably red; reject release candidate
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CI.
- **Evidence:** `ci.yml:64-84`; at [run 37688090541](https://github.com/wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-/actions/runs/37688090541), source-closure manifest fails, later schema/typecheck/build/unit/artifacts **skip**; at [run 37688090662](https://github.com/wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-/actions/runs/37688090662) architecture guard fails; at [run 37688090417](https://github.com/wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-/actions/runs/37688090417) unit test fails. Source: `scripts/ci/run-source-closure-manifest.mjs:7-14`, `scripts/architecture/verify-source-architecture-guards.mjs:8-17`, `package.json:24-27`.
- **Impact:** actual repository SHA has no passing integrated source/build baseline; green status from individual unrelated jobs is not release approval.
- **Fix:** capture full failing step logs for all three workflows and Studio environment check, reproduce against **same commit** in isolated CI, assign defects to their actual source owner, amend corresponding earlier section task only if the source failure matches it, rerun every required job; preserve the gates, no bypass/`continue-on-error`.
- **Acceptance:** immutable CI evidence from the exact release SHA: *all mandatory jobs* success; source closure, architecture guards, unit, lint, typecheck, app builds, schema validation, artifact verification each marked executed and passed; no false green via skipped tests.

### FSA-002 — P0 — Canonical repository release workflow skips all environments
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE + CONFIRMED_CI.
- **Evidence:** `.github/workflows/release-promotion.yml:20-23` tests `github.repository == 'wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK_FINAL'`, whereas audited repository is `wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-`. [run 37688217087](https://github.com/wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK-First-/actions/runs/37688217087) shows validation/staging/production all skipped.
- **Impact:** successful CI in the audited repository would still not promote a release via this workflow; all later gates are unreachable.
- **Fix:** ARB/deployment authority must explicitly designate one authorized release repository or secure signed source-to-deployment handoff. Update the trusted repository condition **only after ownership approval**; retain event type, branch, environments and approval controls.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 28:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 14877 من الخطة الأصلية.

### FSA-003 — P0 — Production post-deploy API smoke probes a route absent from the API
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/release/post-deploy-smoke.mjs:2` calls `/api/v1/monitoring/readiness`; `apps/api/src/app.ts:863-864` mounts `MonitoringRouter` at `/api/v1/monitoring`; `apps/api/src/presentation/api/router/MonitoringRouter.ts:45-63` registers `/health`, `/health/liveness`, `/health/readiness`, **not `/readiness`**. `release-promotion.yml:52-56,91-94,127-130` calls this smoke in every stage.
- **Impact:** working application yields HTTP 404 on the advertised smoke endpoint and will fail environment progression; a broken proxy may mask that result via redirect.
- **Fix:** share/version the monitored readiness route constant or directly use `/api/v1/monitoring/health/readiness`; ensure correct API base/path/proxy composition for every environment.
- **Acceptance:** contract test against a built API route manifest plus disposable deployed API: UP→HTTP200 + body `UP`, required-down→HTTP503 + body `DOWN`, misspelt path→HTTP404 and smoke fails.

### FSA-004 — P1 — Database integration/migration parity is not part of mandatory main source CI success
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE, RUNTIME_PENDING.
- **Evidence:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:64-84,122-124` runs source Prisma validation/client generation and unit tests, explicitly deferring DB-backed and browser E2E; `package.json:26-28,125-126` separates `test:database` and `db:greenfield:verify`; `vitest.database.config.ts:7-21` lists isolated DB test entries; `WholePlatformPersistence.integration.spec.ts:23-25` skips suite when integration environment is disabled.
- **Impact:** checked-in Prisma model and TypeScript compiling cannot prove replayed migrations, ownership constraints or real query/update behavior.
- **Fix:** require authorized disposable PostgreSQL ephemeral job with migrations replayed, parity diff, transaction rollback/idempotency/integration tests. Keep DB-destroying commands forbidden outside clearly disposable URLs/roles.
- **Acceptance:** artifact with exact source SHA, migration history count, parity diff empty, FK/unique checks, isolated DB job all passing; production migration remains a separately approved deploy action.

### FSA-005 — P1 — Browser E2E is not a required green CI/promotion stage
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE.
- **Evidence:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:62-98,122-124` omits `npm run e2e`; `package.json:70,75` runs E2E only in `verify:local`; `apps/web/playwright.config.ts:3-26` configures a Vite dev server, not deployed release artifacts.
- **Impact:** a source build can be promoted with no verified multi-app browser journey against actual API/DB at that SHA.
- **Fix:** add separate isolated-browser gate for **built** Web/Admin/API + disposable DB and equivalent staging smoke. Bind browser test artifact and deployment provenance to source SHA.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 28:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 14898 من الخطة الأصلية.

### FSA-006 — P1 — Release does not prove the complete admin→public→student operation
- **Class:** EVIDENCE_MISSING (not claim that feature is absent).
- **Evidence:** `apps/web/e2e/health.spec.ts:3-57` checks home, liveness/readiness, safe CSRF read and one anonymous-university denial; the only other browser spec in `apps/web/e2e/` is `imported-courses-runtime-closure.spec.ts`. `apps/api/src/app.ts:777-832` mounts numerous unrelated domain/public/student routers. §27.6 contains a fixture plan, **not executed release evidence**.
- **Impact:** users could complete discrete pages while publish→search→save→request→notify flows fail.
- **Fix:** implement a fixture-owned E2E canary covering `Country→University→Program→Major→Test→Scholarship→Public→Student tracker`, and `Course→Enrollment→Certificate`, `Service→Invoice→Fulfillment`, `CMS→public`, plus negative authorization, unpublish/archival and outbox retry. Respect privacy and no external-provider real charges.

### FSA-007 — P1 — Smoke marks HTTP redirects successful without checking target/body
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/release/post-deploy-smoke.mjs:2` uses `redirect:'manual'` and only rejects HTTP `<200` or `>=400`; therefore `301/302/307/308` pass. This also affects the intended API probe and Web probe.
- **Impact:** misrouted traffic, SSO/login redirect, CDN/config redirect or wrong health endpoint can satisfy the launch smoke.
- **Fix:** reject any unexpected redirect, require exact health 200/503 contract and content-type/JSON schema, validate final hostname/URL where redirected website content is intentionally allowed.
- **Acceptance:** redirect-to-login/unknown host, 3xx, HTML error, 200-with-wrong-body, JSON `DOWN` and 503 all fail closed; real ready response and expected built Web content pass.

### FSA-008 — P1 — Web server can return HTTP 200 for an unbuilt placeholder; smoke accepts it
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE.
- **Evidence:** `server.js:12-18,38-57` returns HTTP 200 with `MANARATAK Platform is initializing. Please build web assets.` if Web dist does not exist. `post-deploy-smoke.mjs:2` checks only a 2xx/3xx status for Web.
- **Impact:** empty deployment appears healthy even when the public Web application is not built.
- **Fix:** Web app must fail readiness/serve 503 if required build artifact is absent; smoke must assert a verifiable build ID/asset manifest and UI HTML contract.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 28:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 14919 من الخطة الأصلية.

### FSA-009 — P1 — Production routing depends on a separate API/proxy without deployment-level contract
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE (deployment dependency), EVIDENCE_MISSING (actual topology).
- **Evidence:** root `package.json:16` runs `node server.js`; `server.js:21-36` serves Admin static and deliberately returns **503 to all `/api`**. Separate `apps/api/package.json:6-10` builds/runs `dist/server.cjs` and `apps/api/src/server.ts:9-47` starts the API. `post-deploy-smoke.mjs:2` assumes a reachable API base URL.
- **Impact:** an operator deploying only root `npm start` or a misconfigured ingress publishes Web/Admin without a working API. This is a **topology risk**, not proof production routing currently wrong.
- **Fix:** register explicit separate Web/Admin/API immutable units, origin↔ingress mapping, environment API base, TLS/CORS/cookie/CSRF end-to-end and deploy dependency preconditions.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 28:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 14926 من الخطة الأصلية.

### FSA-010 — P1 — API release artifact runtime dependencies are not independently demonstrated self-contained
- **Class:** CONDITIONAL_RISK, EVIDENCE_MISSING.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/release/build-immutable-artifacts.mjs:8-14` API tar includes `apps/api/dist`, Prisma schema/migrations, vendor, root `package.json`/lock, but not a verified node_modules/runtime layer. `apps/api/package.json:9` esbuild explicitly externalizes `@prisma/client`, `bcrypt`, `jsonwebtoken`, `cors`, `express`, `helmet`, `uuid`; workspace deps and generated Prisma client are runtime requirements. `release/verify-release-artifacts.mjs:3` verifies archive digest only.
- **Impact:** release archive may be valid by SHA-256 but fail boot unless deployment control plane reliably provides matching native modules, generated Prisma client, runtime env and migrations.
- **Fix:** define self-contained image or trusted dependency/runtime-layer manifest with pinned Node, lockfile, native target, Prisma engine/client and external modules; test unpack/boot as a fresh isolated environment without source checkout.

### FSA-011 — P1 — Immutable artifact verification checks internal digests but not approved source-identity authority
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE (missing check), CONDITIONAL_RISK (substitution).
- **Evidence:** `scripts/release/build-immutable-artifacts.mjs:7` accepts environment `GITHUB_SHA` or falls back to `SOURCE_SHA_UNAVAILABLE`; `scripts/release/verify-release-artifacts.mjs:3` verifies only `manifest.kind` and file/SBOM hashes, not a required exact SHA, builder identity, signed source provenance or approval provenance. Promotion script `scripts/release/promote-environment.mjs:3` uses manifest-declared `sourceSha`.
- **Impact:** checksum consistency alone does not prove release source corresponds to the authorized reviewed commit.
- **Fix:** demand a nonempty exact git SHA (and expected HEAD), verified workflow/run ID, builder attestation and immutable artifact digest; deploy/control plane independently validates authorization and source provenance.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 28:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 14940 من الخطة الأصلية.

### FSA-012 — P1 — Promotion records transport acceptance, not explicit deployment reconciliation
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE, CONDITIONAL_RISK.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/release/promote-environment.mjs:3` POSTs manifest to `${endpoint}/promotions`, requires only `response.ok`, and writes returned JSON to `release-evidence/${environment}-promotion.json`, without checking returned deployment state, artifact deployment digest or per-service health; the later smoke is itself defective (FSA-003/007/008).
- **Impact:** HTTP 200/202 acknowledgement could be treated as deployment complete even when control plane is still applying or partially failed.
- **Fix:** control-plane promotion API contract must expose immutable deployment IDs and terminal state; wait/verify reconciled artifact digests and all unit endpoints before progressing; fail closed on partial/error/timeout.
- **Acceptance:** accepted-but-pending, partial deploy, wrong artifact digest or failed server→proxy mapping abort promotion; only terminal healthy exact release allows next stage.

### FSA-013 — P1 — Scheduled recovery/restore audit is disabled in the canonical repository
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE and absence-of-execution.
- **Evidence:** `.github/workflows/recovery-restore-audit.yml:3-15` schedules weekly but guards its only `restore-audit` job by `github.repository == 'wegdangamil2022-oss/MANARATAK_FINAL'`, not the reviewed repo. In addition production workflow has not executed (FSA-002). Source `scripts/recovery/verify-recovery-contract.mjs:14-21` checks workflow file existence, **not completed restore proof**.
- **Impact:** a scheduled workflow file is not evidence of recurring restore drills or attained RTO/RPO.
- **Fix:** designate authorized recovery repo/environment with the same secure ownership governance as release; ensure scheduled job actually runs and evidence is immutable, verified and alerted on failure/staleness.
- **Acceptance:** recent successful isolated restore (within policy freshness window) at approved backup restore-point with all datasets/files, and deliberate injected-failure producing alert; ownership guard rejects foreign repos.

### FSA-014 — P1 — Destructive recovery drill guard does not securely prove target is disposable
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE + CONDITIONAL_RISK (potential data loss; no such incident observed).
- **Evidence:** `scripts/recovery/run-whole-platform-restore-drill.mjs:13-19` allows any **local-host database regardless of name** OR any **remote database whose name matches `/restore|disposable|sandbox|test|ci/`**, then executes `pg_restore --clean --if-exists` or `psql -f`. There is no independent database-side disposable sentinel, live/production-denial identity, confirmed database fingerprint or explicit environment authorization.
- **Impact:** wrong credentials or an unfortunately named real database can pass string checks and be overwritten. This is a destructive operational safety defect, **not proof the restore script was run against production**.
- **Fix:** require a strong deny-by-default isolated recovery target: independent signed/disposable environment assertion, literal approved database ID, guarded DB server identity, nonproduction role and namespace allowlist, hard negative production URL fingerprint, two-party approval for restore, and preflight all input assets/hashes **before** DB mutations; never depend on database substring as a safety guarantee.
- **Acceptance:** local production-named DB, remote `test-production`, credentials scoped to real cluster, missing immutable sentinel, same origin/target database, or non-disposable role all abort **before** starting `pg_restore`; only isolated target passes.

### FSA-015 — P1 — Production release requires only recovery source contract; runtime backup proof remains pending
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE, EVIDENCE_MISSING.
- **Evidence:** `.github/workflows/release-promotion.yml:120-126` production job calls only `npm run recovery:source:verify` before promotion. `scripts/recovery/verify-recovery-contract.mjs:3-21` reads static JSON and file existence, ending `RUNTIME_RESTORE_EVIDENCE=PENDING_NON_BLOCKING`. `config/recovery/production-recovery-contract.json:5-9,36` asserts RPO≤5m, RTO≤60m and `runtimeEvidenceStatus: PENDING_NON_BLOCKING`. Runtime backup checker exists separately `scripts/recovery/verify-runtime-backup-readiness.mjs:3-10` but is in the skipped recovery workflow.
- **Impact:** production can meet the source-only recovery policy while having no verified backup freshness/restorability evidence.
- **Fix:** pre-production gate requires recent real provider backup evidence, isolated restore result, asset hash parity and measured RTO/RPO against the approved policy, plus a documented break-glass exception procedure.
- **Acceptance:** missing/stale recovery evidence blocks promotion, recovery timestamp is verified for exact release/data snapshot, destructive operations run only isolated.

### FSA-016 — P1 — Background/event/provider cross-domain effects have no mandatory runtime release proof
- **Class:** EVIDENCE_MISSING (owner defects indexed in §§20/23/27, do not duplicate).
- **Evidence:** `apps/api/src/server.ts:18-38,47` schedules durable background jobs and starts polling workers; `StudentWorkspaceOutboxDeliveryGateway.ts:20-83` maps selected owner-domain events; `ci.yml:122-124` defers DB/browser runtime; `apps/web/e2e/health.spec.ts:3-57` does not exercise notifications, payment provider callbacks, certificates or replay.
- **Impact:** a healthy HTTP process may still not fulfill deadline reminders, invoice reconciliation, outbox delivery, certificates or student projections.
- **Fix:** require disposable E2E fault-injection suite with owner-domain outbox→worker→consumer→projection, provider sandbox stubs, duplicate/delayed/out-of-order event, worker crash/restart, lease fencing, privacy and financial ledger invariant. No actual payment or student notification is sent.
- **Acceptance:** terminal observable side effect confirmed once only, known retry recovery, dead-letter alerts, and no cross-tenant leakage for every mandatory worker before release.

### FSA-017 — P2 — Restore drill records RTO without enforcing the approved RTO upper bound
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE.
- **Evidence:** `config/recovery/production-recovery-contract.json:5-9` targets `regionalLossRtoMinutes:60`; `scripts/recovery/run-whole-platform-restore-drill.mjs:22-25` computes `rtoMinutes`, sets `status:'PASS'` and never compares against 60 minutes or checks actual source backup age against 5-minute RPO.
- **Impact:** an over-SLO restore is recorded as `PASS` even if restore checks work.
- **Fix:** compare measured elapsed time and independently measured point-in-time currency to published objectives, emit distinct structural-restorability vs SLO results, block release if policy required.
- **Acceptance:** fixture takes >60 minutes or backup lags >5 minutes => policy FAIL even if DB consistency checks pass; normal test reports measured values and limits.

### FSA-018 — P2 — Restore validates asset hashes after database has already been overwritten
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE, CONDITIONAL_RISK.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/recovery/run-whole-platform-restore-drill.mjs:15-22` verifies backup/manifest file **existence**, executes destructive SQL restore, *then* iterates files to verify SHA-256. A corrupt asset set therefore causes failure **after** database restoration began.
- **Impact:** unsafe recovery retry behavior and wasted/misaligned restored database; safety must protect even disposable testing environments.
- **Fix:** pre-validate the entire asset manifest path containment, count and hashes, DB backup checksum/source provenance and target assertions before the restore process; then verify cross-resource snapshot epoch after restore.
- **Acceptance:** missing/corrupt/traversal asset or corrupt backup prevents any SQL restore; matching data+asset snapshot succeeds; negative tests assert no `pg_restore` invocation.

### FSA-019 — P2 — Final gate has no reproducible whole-platform load/SLO evidence
- **Class:** EVIDENCE_MISSING.
- **Evidence:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:62-84` and `.github/workflows/release-promotion.yml:47-56,91-94,127-130` run build/unit and lightweight HTTP smoke, no load/soak/burst gate. `scripts/runtime/infra-probe.mjs:10-80` tests connectivity/TLS rather than request-level throughput. `imported-courses-runtime-closure.yml:89-90` runs a 3,663-row parser-memory rehearsal **only in that source workflow** and its current run fails before reaching it.
- **Impact:** no demonstrated p95/p99 latency, worker drain/queue lag, query amplification, 429 behavior, DB pool saturation or client bundle performance for release volume.
- **Fix:** define bounded, reproducible SLOs per API category and queue (user search, scholarship filters, student writes, admin scans, imports, payments); run against ephemeral production-like topology, avoiding live data and provider charges.
- **Acceptance لإغلاق كود القسم 28:** unit/API/negative regression مستهدف لنفس الإصلاح، بلا مزوّد حي أو E2E طويل. **التحقق التشغيلي المفصل المؤجل:** راجع ملحق ما بعد 28 «اختبارات Inline المؤجلة»، المصدر سطر 14996 من الخطة الأصلية.

### FSA-020 — P2 — Canary/rollback criteria are unproven at service+data compatibility level
- **Class:** EVIDENCE_MISSING (not a claim that control plane cannot roll back).
- **Evidence:** `release-promotion.yml:68-130` uses validation→staging→production sequencing but no source-enforced rollback/traffic-shift health policy; `scripts/release/promote-environment.mjs:3` issues only promotion request and stores acknowledgement. `release:smoke` performs simple GET status checks. `db:greenfield:verify` exists outside release gate (`package.json:125`).
- **Impact:** code rollback and irreversible schema/data updates may not be compatible under partial rollout, multi-version traffic, stale worker or cached client assets.
- **Fix:** attach approved canary, error-budget thresholds, expand/contract compatibility proofs, rollback drills and named incident owner to promotion policy; do not programmatically touch the user's live database during audit.
- **Acceptance:** isolated rollback from N+1 to N retains dependent catalog and financial records, previous API/worker versions tolerate migrated schema, requests are not double processed, error threshold reverses traffic automatically or with authorized operator.

### FSA-021 — P2 — Public/Student release truth and locale/indexing parity are not verified by deployment smoke
- **Class:** EVIDENCE_MISSING.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/release/post-deploy-smoke.mjs:2` requests only API health and Web root; `apps/web/src/features/public-template/usePublicRelationshipGraph.ts:31-80` composes multiple public owner services; `apps/api/src/app.ts:777-832` mounts public domain and student routers; `apps/web/playwright.config.ts:3-26` runs development Vite. Existing §17 and §27 have field/state discrepancies.
- **Impact:** healthy homepage/API does not prove that published AR/EN pages, canonical URLs, locale-specific metadata, authorization or student content render correctly in the deployed build.
- **Fix:** add deployed browser/HTTP contract checks of multiple representative domain/public/student paths, English and Arabic, 404 for unpublished or forbidden owners, deep links, no prototype fixture data, correct SEO canonical/hreflang and accessible UI.
- **Acceptance:** verify navigable owner IDs/canonical links in both locales and correct deny responses using disposable fixtures and built release assets; capture trace and response schema evidence.

### FSA-022 — P2 — CI source-closure proof and production proof are not clearly separated as distinct release gates
- **Class:** CONFIRMED_CODE and governance gap.
- **Evidence:** `scripts/ci/source-closure-manifest.json:1-5` declares `runtimePolicy:'PENDING_NON_BLOCKING'`; `scripts/ci/run-source-closure-manifest.mjs:9-14` skips `RUNTIME` gates on `--source-only` and prints `PENDING_NON_BLOCKING`; `ci.yml:66-84,122-124` runs source-only manifest; `config/recovery/production-recovery-contract.json:36` remains runtime pending.
- **Impact:** a future successful `SOURCE_CLOSURE_MANIFEST_RUN=PASS` can be mistaken for *entire system E2E/production closure* despite intentional skips.
- **Fix:** publish **two independently signed/linked statuses**, `SOURCE_VERIFIED` vs `RUNTIME_VERIFIED`, and a release verdict `BLOCKED` until both required suites and DR/security evidence are green. Do not rename pending as passing.
- **Acceptance:** dashboards and release reports show explicit executed/skipped/failed gates, responsible owner, last evidence age and SHA; simulated skipped runtime always yields NO-GO.

### FSA-023 — P3 — Evidence registry must bind the 27 reviewed sections, 26-domain E2E matrix and release SHA
- **Class:** Governance/traceability improvement, NOT a functional bug.
- **Evidence:** this cumulative `MANARATAK_ADMIN_REVIEW_CODEX.md` §§01–27 contains owner findings and `XMI-001…037`; `ci.yml:83-98` uploads release artifacts and a P12-focused source closure result; §28 matrix spans 26 domains without runtime results at this SHA.
- **Impact:** independently repaired findings, green unrelated jobs and stale artifacts may be mixed into a misleading global launch decision.
- **Fix:** maintain release evidence index with `{sha, task IDs, owner, fixture, suite, environment, outcome, timestamp, artifact link, reviewer}`; link every blocking prior task to commit/PR and a post-fix regression assertion, without duplicating defects or changing roadmap.
- **Acceptance:** one generated report verifies all `P0/P1` blockers are independently re-reviewed and closed, all domain/cross-domain gates green, security/dependency/backup evidence fresh and each artifact SHA equals the candidate; no ungrounded global percentage.

## 28.5 Release gates — explicit go/no-go conditions

> **تم ترحيل مصفوفة الاختبارات/دليل التشغيل الأصلي كاملًا إلى «ملحق ما بعد 28»، البند `28.5`.** ليست هذه المصفوفة شرطًا لإغلاق إصلاح المصدر الآن. المرجع: سياسة الإغلاق السريع في بداية الملف.

- **التحقق الإلزامي الآن:** اختبارات unit/contract/security سريعة ومستهدفة لإصلاحات هذا القسم؛ تصحيح كل فشل ذي صلة، ثم تدوين Commit والنتيجة `CODE_CLOSED — RUNTIME_DEFERRED` عند تحقق المعايير.

## 28.6 Prioritized remediation and post-fix verification

1. **Stop-ship first:** FSA-001, FSA-002, FSA-003. Capture CI step logs and fix the *real failing assertions*, restore authorized release workflow eligibility, correct/protect readiness smoke. Until then, even running a release would be misleading.
2. **Runtime safety:** FSA-014, FSA-013, FSA-015, FSA-017, FSA-018. Never run restore/migration on production for diagnosis; disposable DB/environment controls are non-negotiable.
3. **Reproducibility and release trust:** FSA-004, FSA-005, FSA-007, FSA-008, FSA-009, FSA-010, FSA-011, FSA-012. CI, artifact, network and exact build-version parity must all hold.
4. **Functional, privacy and financial proof:** FSA-006, FSA-016, FSA-021; link test cases back to §§01–27 instead of duplicating their owner-local defects. Ensure multi-domain negative cases are tested.
5. **Sustainable production:** FSA-019, FSA-020, FSA-022, FSA-023. Load, rollback, evidence age, reviewer ownership, alerting and a fail-closed operational board.

**Codex constraints:** Preserve modular-monolith owner boundaries; make source edits/isolated tests under a separate corrective change request, not in this review. No production DB schema mutation, `migrate deploy`, `db push`, credential copying, real charges or outbound student notifications. Track individual fixed tasks and re-review, then run a separate explicit `GO/NO-GO` release signoff. GitHub workflow state can change after this reviewed SHA; attach fresh results before signing off.

**SECTION 28 STATUS: 23 new uniquely scoped final-audit tasks (`FSA-001…023`), P0=3 / P1=13 / P2=6 / P3=1; CONFIRMED CI FAIL + RELEASE SKIP + SMOKE PATH BUG; final readiness `NO-GO`; §§01–28 REVIEWED, NOT CLOSED; repair execution is a separate authorized step.**

## 28.FG — مراجعة النواقص الوظيفية التكميلية / Deep Functional & Feature Gap Audit

**الحكم الأصلي محفوظ حرفيًا:** `NO-GO — NOT PRODUCTION READY`. لا تعدل `FSA-001…023` أو G0–G7 أو حالات الفشل الملحوظة في CI؛ المراجعة هنا تحقق **جاهزية تجربة اكتشاف برامج الدراسة والمنح** لا مجرد صحة التنفيذ البرمجي. المصدر الوحيد للكمال الوظيفي هو تشغيل بيئة معزولة مع بيانات اعتماد أصلية مأذون بها عند مرحلة القبول، وليس هذا الفحص الثابت.

### FSA-FG-024 — P2 — لا توجد بوابة قبول محتوى/قابلية اكتشاف تربط النشر بإتاحة مسارات دراسة مفيدة قبل الإطلاق
- **التصنيف:** `NEW_PROPOSED / RELEASE_BUSINESS_ACCEPTANCE`؛ **الدليل:** `AdminDashboardPage.tsx:410-445` يعرض عدادات catalog للنشر/المراجعة، و§28.3 يثبت مصفوفة E2E وحراس التقنيات، لكن لا يوجد بالسطح الذي راجعناه تقرير Release typed يعرض، **حسب الدولة والدرجة ولغة الدراسة**، وجود جامعة→برنامج نشط→تخصص→منحة مرتبطة ومصدر موثق، مع إظهار الحالات غير المكتملة دون إيهام readiness. هذه المهمة لا تكرر `FSA-006` (وجود E2E) ولا `FSA-021` (AR/EN والفهرسة)، بل تحدد **المخرجات التجارية التي يجب أن يثبتها هذا الاختبار**.
- **مثال:** جميع الخدمات وCI خضراء، لكن واجهة «ادرس في ألمانيا — بكالوريوس — الإنجليزية» لا تعرض أي برنامج فعّال بسبب روابط ناقصة أو حالات منشورة بلا برامج؛ لا يجوز تأكيد جاهزية هذا المسار دون وسم التغطية المحتوائية.
- **الملفات والمتطلبات:** `apps/admin/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.tsx` (read-only diagnostics summary؛ اختيار موقع الواجهة يراجع لاحقًا)، `StudyDestinationDetailPage.tsx`, `CrossDomainReadModelRouter.ts`, `PublicUniversityUseCases.ts`, `PublicScholarshipUseCases.ts`, `packages/infrastructure/prisma/schema.prisma`, `scripts/release/*`, owner release evidence registry؛ إعداد coverage scenarios لا **نسب مصطنعة**، تصنيف unavailable/zero/unsupported وفصل `mandatory launch market` عن الأسواق غير المستهدفة حسب خطة الإطلاق المعتمدة، مع provenance/checkedAt/commit/env؛ لا duplicate counts بسبب صفحات جزئية.
- **الأثر:** الأقسام 06–12 و15 و18 Public و26–28؛ **قبول:** يُنشئ اختبار staging disposable بلدًا ببرنامج Bachelor إنجليزي نشط ومنحة منشورة مرتبطة، ومسارًا ثانيًا بوحدة برنامج draft-only؛ تقرير المراجعة يثبت الأول available والثاني zero/incomplete، والواجهة العامة والبحث والعلاقة تعكس الحقيقة؛ لا يؤثر على `GO` إلا عندما يكون السوق/المسار ضمن أهداف الإطلاق المفوّضة، ويفشل fail-closed إذا لم يتوفر دليل المصدر المطلوب.

**المحصلة:** 1 مهمة P2 جديدة مستقلة عن gates التقنية القائمة؛ لا تغيّر قرار الإطلاق إلا وفق أدلة Runtime مستقبلية.

# ملحق ما بعد القسم 28 — الاختبارات والتجارب الثقيلة المؤجلة (ليس قسم تنفيذ رقم 29)

> **توقيت التنفيذ المعتمد:** بعد الانتهاء من إصلاحات الأقسام **01 إلى 28** ورفعها إلى المستودع، وتجهيز بيئة اختبار مناسبة مع Google Studio وقاعدة بيانات اختبار/نسخة قابلة للاستعادة. **لا تُستخدم هذه القائمة لإبقاء الأقسام 01–28 مفتوحة بسبب دليل تشغيل غير متاح حاليًا.** إذا ظهر خلل كود أو ثغرة أثناء هذه الاختبارات، يعاد فتح مهمة الإصلاح المعنية.

> **الأولوية حينها:** أولًا تشغيل تطبيقات Web/Admin/API وربط قاعدة البيانات والمigrations في بيئة معزولة، ثانيًا فحص الهوية/الخصوصية/المال/المحتوى، ثالثًا التكامل الحقيقي وE2E المتدرج، رابعًا الأداء والاستعادة وعمليات الإصدار. لا تُشغّل أوامر مدمرة على الإنتاج أو قاعدة المستخدم بلا إذن وخطة نسخ احتياطي.

## 1. جدول الاختبارات الكبيرة المشتركة بعد إنهاء 28

| الحزمة | متى | أمثلة نطاق التحقق | نتيجة مطلوبة |
|---|---|---|---|
| قاعدة البيانات والترحيلات | بعد رفع جميع الإصلاحات، وقبل اعتبار Runtime جاهزًا | Prisma migration dry-run، قيود FK/indexes، سلوك المعاملات والتزامن، نسخ احتياطي واختبار استرجاع معزول | `DB_RUNTIME_VERIFIED` أو فشل موثق |
| Settings & Secrets | عند وجود مفاتيح ديناميكية ومستهلك حقيقي مُعتمد | مستهلك Settings فعلي، provider Binding، overrides، flags، cache، scope عبر Owner ID | دليل استهلاك حقيقي بلا تسريب أسرار |
| واجهة المتصفح E2E | بعد تشغيل Web/Admin/API | AR/EN، أدوار المستخدمين، صفحات 01–28، النشر والبحث والعودة/التصفية، student/public | نتائج مسارات وScreenshots/Logs |
| تكامل الخدمات | بعد تهيئة Sandbox Providers | Import، AI، Assets، Payments، Notifications، outbox/queue/jobs، retries | عدم تسريب أو ازدواج أو فقدان غير معلوم |
| الأداء والجاهزية | بعد وجود بيانات وتمثيل حمل | bounded pagination، SLO، burst/soak، worker lag وcache | أرقام أداء موثقة لا تخمينات |
| النسخ والاستعادة والإصدار | قبل النشر الحقيقي | restore drill، RTO/RPO، تحقق artefact SHA، staging/rollback، صلاحية release jobs | تقرير بوابات GO/NO-GO حسب §28 |

## 2. البنود الأصلية المنقولة كاملة حسب القسم

**قاعدة حفظ المرجع:** العناوين وأجسام مصفوفات الاختبارات أدناه مأخوذة من النسخة الأصلية قبل التعديل. نقلها لا يعني أن الاختبارات نجحت أو أن النواقص عولجت. أما إصلاحات الـP0/P1 واختباراتها الخفيفة فقد بقيت إلزامية في سياسة البداية.

### من القسم 01.12 — 01.12 اختبارات Acceptance المطلوبة قبل إغلاق القسم

> المرجع الأصلي: `01.12`، محفوظ كما ورد في خطة 8 أكتوبر 2026؛ التنفيذ بعد إنهاء 28.


#### Navigation / UI
- [ ] identity-only admin يستطيع دخول Staff view فقط.
- [ ] authorization-only admin يستطيع إدارة Roles حسب صلاحياته ولا يحصل تلقائيًا على Identity lifecycle mutation.
- [ ] unauthorized admin لا يرى القسم/التبويب ولا يستطيع API call.
- [ ] AR/EN وRTL/LTR يعملان.
- [ ] search/filter/pagination لا يخفي سجلات بسبب client truncation.

#### Delegation
- [ ] لا يمكن تفويض permission لا يملكها actor.
- [ ] non-delegable permissions تبقى محمية.
- [ ] duplicate assignment idempotent/blocked correctly.
- [ ] duplicate role name handled deterministically.

#### Role lifecycle
- [ ] safe role update.
- [ ] stale update rejected.
- [ ] role with active assignments cannot be deleted accidentally.
- [ ] canonical/system role protection.

#### Policy
- [ ] malformed TIME/IP denied.
- [ ] dangling policy fails closed.
- [ ] used policy cannot be silently deleted.

#### Emergency Access
- [ ] actor != approver.
- [ ] approver Active + verified + authorized.
- [ ] max duration enforced server-side.
- [ ] expired grant stops being effective.
- [ ] revoke is immediate.
- [ ] audit contains actor/approver/change ticket/reason.

#### Audit
- [ ] successful mutations audited.
- [ ] failed high-risk mutations audited.
- [ ] Activity view paginates and links to central Audit Center.

---


### من القسم 02.13 — 02.13 اختبارات قبول إلزامية

> المرجع الأصلي: `02.13`، محفوظ كما ورد في خطة 8 أكتوبر 2026؛ التنفيذ بعد إنهاء 28.


#### Query / pagination
- [ ] cursor يعيد الصفحة التالية بلا duplicates ولا gaps ضمن ordering contract.
- [ ] invalid cursor -> canonical validation error.
- [ ] `from > until` مرفوض.
- [ ] limit hard-capped server-side.
- [ ] filters تعمل server-side ولا تعتمد على client-loaded subset.

#### Security / privacy
- [ ] audit routes تتطلب `admin:audit:manage`.
- [ ] Secret Sanitizer يعمل recursive.
- [ ] Authorization/Cookie/token/password values لا تظهر في API DTO.
- [ ] actor لا يؤخذ من user-controlled spoof headers.
- [ ] audit deep links لا تكشف owner-domain detail بلا permission.

#### Audit semantics
- [ ] SourceReference = logical source وليس IP.
- [ ] IP موجود في bounded metadata عند الحاجة.
- [ ] correlation ID موجود لكل Admin request.

### من القسم 03.11 — 03.11 اختبارات قبول إلزامية

> المرجع الأصلي: `03.11`، محفوظ كما ورد في خطة 8 أكتوبر 2026؛ التنفيذ بعد إنهاء 28.


#### Security lifecycle
- [ ] direct activate من QUARANTINED غير المفحوص يفشل.
- [ ] direct activate من MALWARE_SCAN_FAILED يفشل **قبل** استدعاء storage move.
- [ ] sanitize لا يستطيع تجاوز scan policy.
- [ ] scan PASSED محفوظ كevidence قابلة لإعادة التحميل من DB.
- [ ] verified MIME/signature مطلوب قبل activation.
- [ ] checksum policy مطبقة قبل Clean promotion.
- [ ] infected asset لا يصل إلى Clean zone في أي failure path.

#### Upload
- [ ] grant-issued لا يعني uploaded.
- [ ] missing object لا ينتقل إلى validation.
- [ ] actual byte size mismatch يُرفض.
- [ ] client MIME mismatch مع verified MIME يُرفض حسب policy.
- [ ] retry لنفس asset آمن idempotently.
- [ ] أصلان مختلفان بنفس filename/MIME/size لا يشتركان في provider idempotency key أو locator.

#### Permissions
- [ ] Course editor يستطيع اختيار asset مناسب دون `admin:assets:manage` الكامل.
- [ ] Study Destination editor كذلك.
- [ ] asset-use permission لا تسمح archive/delete/purge.
- [ ] preview/use يحترم classification/purpose.
- [ ] owner-domain save يعيد التحقق server-side من AssetReferencePolicy.

#### Usage / deletion
- [ ] soft delete لأصل مستخدم يُمنع أو يتبع policy موثقة لا تكسر consumer.
- [ ] purge لأصل مستخدم ممنوع.
- [ ] Admin detail يعرض usages.
- [ ] consumer inventory guard يفشل إذا أضيف asset field جديد بلا تسجيل/تغطية.

#### Pagination/UI
- [ ] q يبقى مطبقًا مع الصفحة الثانية والثالثة.
- [ ] invalid cursor -> canonical 400.
- [ ] draft filter لا يختلط مع cursor للنتائج المطبقة.
- [ ] duplicate requests لا تضيف rows مكررة.
- [ ] AssetPicker يبحث server-side ولا يقتصر على أول 100.
- [ ] selected asset يمكن rehydrate حتى لو ليس في الصفحة الأولى.

#### Provider/DB consistency
- [ ] storage success + DB failure ينتج recoverable/reconcilable state.
- [ ] DB conflict لا يكرر provider destructive side effect بشكل غير آمن.
- [ ] concurrent lifecycle commands لا تؤدي إلى last-write-wins غير مضبوط.

#### Retention
- [ ] invalid expiry rejected قبل Repository.
- [ ] TEMPORARY policy تفرض expiry.
- [ ] lifecycle-derived retention categories لا تُقبل من upload client.
- [ ] legal hold يمنع purge عند Runtime retention flow.

- [ ] rollback creates new version.
- [ ] clear override restores inheritance without deleting history.

- [ ] bootstrap/provider secrets remain outside Settings DB.

- [ ] history lazy-loaded.

- [ ] no N+1 definition read per assignment key.

#### Events/Audit

- [ ] one command produces intended owner event set exactly once.
- [ ] correlation id matches audit/outbox/domain event chain.
- [ ] retry with same idempotency key does not create duplicate versions/events.

### من القسم 05.36 — 05.36 اختبارات قبول إلزامية

> المرجع الأصلي: `05.36`، محفوظ كما ورد في خطة 8 أكتوبر 2026؛ التنفيذ بعد إنهاء 28.


#### Identity

1. Batch/Record IDs ليست truncated UUID.
2. parallel staging لنفس source key لا ينشئ duplicate identity claim.
3. existing legacy IDs تبقى قابلة للقراءة.

#### Queue / concurrency

4. worker A يفقد lease => لا dispatch جديد بعد ذلك.
5. cancel RUNNING => CANCELLING ثم worker acknowledgement => CANCELLED.
6. pause => no new work بعد safe checkpoint.
7. heartbeat يتجدد حسب الوقت وليس بعد 100 rows فقط.
8. expired worker لا يستطيع complete/update terminal state.

#### Outcomes

9. zero failures => COMPLETED.
10. partial terminal row failures => PARTIALLY_COMPLETED وفق policy.
11. duplicate-skipped batch ينتهي progress=100 وفق accounting الصحيح.
12. DLQ يظهر السبب في Error Report.

#### Replay/idempotency

13. crash بعد successful domain accept وقبل P6 record update لا يكرر owner side effect.
14. resume from checkpoint لا يعيد السجلات المكتملة.
15. fresh replay واضح ومختبر.

#### Large import

16. large artifact لا يحمل كله في Admin browser memory.
17. parser streams chunks.
18. 100K test يمر عبر **actual production import path** وليس parser unit test فقط.
19. memory growth bounded.
20. checkpoint size bounded.

#### Source security

21. MANUAL_ONLY + network connector => reject.
22. BLOCKED => reject.
23. private DNS/redirect remains blocked.
24. robots-restricted source لا يعمل بدون compliance decision.
25. credentials لا تخزن plaintext في source registry.
26. source outside allowed origin/path => reject.
27. multi-instance rate-limit contract test أو runtime-pending proof.

#### HTTP acquisition

28. ETag produces conditional request.
29. 304 is no-change, not error.
30. Retry-After respected ضمن hard ceiling.

#### Retention

31. staged record receives deterministic retention metadata.
32. legal hold overrides purge.
33. retention purge does not remove required audit evidence.

#### Boundary

34. P6 cannot publish.
35. legacy promote/transfer remains disabled.
36. owner-domain consumer owns semantic validation.
37. public page cannot see staged-only record.

### من القسم 28.5 — 28.5 Release gates — explicit go/no-go conditions

> المرجع الأصلي: `28.5`، محفوظ كما ورد في خطة 8 أكتوبر 2026؛ التنفيذ بعد إنهاء 28.


| Gate | Required proof and command class | Current verdict |
|---|---|---|
| G0 — source correctness | Three failed GitHub workflows diagnosed and fully green at same source SHA, manifest/source guard/unit; no ignored failures | **BLOCKED — observed FAIL** |
| G1 — immutable release | Signed/bound source SHA + digest, clean unpacked API/Web/Admin boot, correct backend/proxy route and smoke | **BLOCKED — wrong smoke route, unproven runtime** |
| G2 — persistence | Disposable migration chain parity + DB isolation/FKs/transactions + schema/seed/rollback rehearsal | **BLOCKED — runtime evidence absent** |
| G3 — cross-domain behavior | 26-domain E2E matrix plus §27 owner-link/lifecycle assertions, AR/EN, student privacy and replay | **BLOCKED — runtime evidence absent** |
| G4 — security & finance | CodeQL/secret/dependency scan green **and** runtime RBAC/CSRF/asset delivery/idempotency/provider sandbox controls verified | **BLOCKED — source security success alone insufficient** |
| G5 — operations | Worker/notification/telemetry tests, rate-limit resilience, p95/queue lag/SLO and alerts | **BLOCKED — runtime evidence absent** |
| G6 — backup/recovery | Isolated restore with data+asset hashes, safe target guard, measured RPO/RTO, fresh signed backup evidence | **BLOCKED — recovery workflow repo guard and source-only preflight** |
| G7 — production cutover | Authorized validation→staging→production approvals, deploy ID/digest reconciliation, safe smoke, canary/rollback | **BLOCKED — release workflow skipped** |

**Release decision rule:** `GO` only after **all G0–G7** have independently fresh, exact-SHA, environment-matched proof. No reduction of release requirements because the source contains an endpoint/test; `not executed` and `skipped` are not `PASS`. A `P2/P3` exception requires written ownership, bounded severity and approved time limit; no automatic waiver of a P0/P1 or privacy/payment issue.

## 4. قائمة الاستلام النهائية بعد 28

- [ ] تم تشغيل migrations/القيود في بيئة اختبار آمنة، وتوثيق الإصدار وخطة الرجوع دون التلاعب ببيانات الإنتاج.
- [ ] تم فحص سيناريوهات الهوية والإدارة والطالب والمحتوى مع بيانات وهمية وصلاحيات محدودة.
- [ ] تم إثبات أن إعدادات Runtime التي تدّعي تحكمًا ديناميكيًا تصل إلى مستهلك معتمد؛ وإلا تظل غير مُفعلة/غير معتمدة.
- [ ] تم التحقق من الخدمات الخارجية والمزودين في sandbox، والـidempotency والمعاملات المزدوجة.
- [ ] تم تنفيذ بوابات الإصدار/الاستعادة/المراقبة اللازمة فعلًا وتوثيق نتائجها على SHA/Environment محددين.
- [ ] لا يتم تحويل `CODE_CLOSED — RUNTIME_DEFERRED` إلى `RUNTIME_VALIDATED` أو `PRODUCTION_GO` آليًا؛ القرار النهائي بدليلٍ مستقل وصريح.

**ختام سياسة التنفيذ:** قسم 28 ينهي **حملة مراجعة وإصلاح المصدر**؛ هذا الملحق يُنفَّذ بعد ذلك ضمن **مرحلة التحقق التشغيلي والجاهزية** دون اعتباره القسم 29 من خارطة الأقسام.
